paras.en: One woman told The Times she was shocked by how quickly he changed from the "affable, charming, sort of dandyish persona" he initially appeared to be to a "really crude and direct person" in his hotel room, where she alleges he abruptly groped her and shoved his hand down her pants.
paras.zh: 一名女士告诉《泰晤士报》，她对他在酒店房间里从“和蔼可亲、迷人、花花公子的形象”如此之快地转变为“非常粗鲁和直接的人”感到震惊，她声称他在酒店房间里突然抚摸她，并将手伸进她的裤子里。

paras.en: "At the time, I never really thought about it in the way that I think about it now, as sexual assault. I just pushed it down," she said.
paras.zh: “当时，我从来没有像现在那样真正思考过这件事，将其视为性侵犯。我只是把它推到了一边，”她说。

paras.en: CBC News has reached out to Brand's lawyer for comment.
paras.zh: CBC新闻已联系布兰德的律师征求意见。

paras.en: The Times reported that several women it interviewed reported they feared they wouldn't be believed if they came forward — echoing fears raised by the woman who testified against him at his trial.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，接受采访的几位女性表示，她们担心如果自己站出来，别人不会相信她们——这与在审判中作证指控他的女性所表达的担忧相呼应。

paras.en: One of Brand's victims, whom he anally raped in 2009, said in a statement read by prosecutors in court that "his fame, wealth and influence created a power imbalance, which made me feel powerless."
paras.zh: 布兰德在 2009 年对他进行了肛交，其中一名受害者在检察官在法庭上宣读的一份声明中表示，“他的名气、财富和影响力造成了权力失衡，让我感到无能为力。”

paras.en: Allegations emerged against Brand in 2023
paras.zh: 2023 年出现针对 Brand 的指控

paras.en: Brand first rose to prominence on the comedy circuit in the U.K. in the late 1990s. He became more well known overseas after appearing in movie comedies such as Forgetting Sarah Marshall, Get Him to the Greek and Arthur, and engaging in a highly publicized, if brief, marriage to singer Katy Perry.
paras.zh: 布兰德于 20 世纪 90 年代末在英国喜剧界首次崭露头角。在出演《忘记莎拉·马歇尔》、《带他去希腊》和《亚瑟王》等电影喜剧后，他在海外变得更加出名，并与歌手凯蒂·佩里举行了一段广为人知但短暂的婚姻。

paras.en: Allegations of sexual misconduct against Brand were first reported by The Times, Sunday Times and Channel 4's Dispatches in 2023. After these allegations became public, more women came forward to speak with police and media, and London's Metropolitan Police opened an investigation.
paras.zh: 2023 年，《泰晤士报》、《星期日泰晤士报》和第 4 频道的《快讯》首次报道了针对布兰德的性行为不端指控。这些指控公​​开后，更多女性站出来接受警方和媒体的采访，伦敦警察厅也展开了调查。

paras.en: Brand poses alongside his then-fiancée, singer Katy Perry, at the premiere of the film Get Him to the Greek, at the Greek Theater in Los Angeles in 2010. (Chris Pizzello/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2010 年，在洛杉矶希腊剧院举行的电影《带他去希腊》首映式上，布兰德与他当时的未婚妻、歌手凯蒂·佩里 (Katy Perry) 合影。（克里斯·皮泽罗/美联社）

paras.en: Brand denied all charges during the recent four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court in London, maintaining that any sexual encounters were consensual and describing himself as preoccupied with sex during the years in question.
paras.zh: 布兰德在伦敦南华克皇家法院最近为期四个星期的审判中否认了所有指控，坚称任何性行为都是双方同意的，并称自己在这些年里专注于性行为。

paras.en: He was acquitted of two counts of rape and one count of attempted indecent assault.
paras.zh: 他的两项强奸罪和一项企图猥亵罪被判无罪。

paras.en: Brand is still under investigation for two other alleged rapes, one involving a then-16-year-old girl, according to police.
paras.zh: 据警方称，布兰德因另外两起强奸案仍在接受调查，其中一起涉及一名当时 16 岁的女孩。

paras.en: Documentary dives into Brand's rise to fame
paras.zh: 纪录片深入探讨品牌的成名之路

paras.en: Friday also saw the release of the Netflix documentary Open Secret, which tracks Brand's career from his success on the stage as a controversial comedian known for bawdy jokes, to his acting roles and eventual shift into a far-right religious influencer — unfolding amid growing rumours that his unnerving persona might cloak real-life atrocities.
paras.zh: 周五还发布了 Netflix 纪录片《公开的秘密》，该纪录片追踪了布兰德的职业生涯，从他在舞台上作为一名以下流笑话而闻名的有争议的喜剧演员的成功，到他的表演角色以及最终转变为极右翼宗教影响者——在越来越多的谣言中，布兰德令人不安的形象可能掩盖了现实生活中的暴行。

paras.en: Jordan Martin, an ex-girlfriend who appeared in the documentary, described Brand as controlling and abusive, alleging that he sexually assaulted her after an argument.
paras.zh: 出现在纪录片中的前女友乔丹·马丁（Jordan Martin）形容布兰德具有控制欲和虐待倾向，并声称他在一次争吵后对她进行了性侵犯。

paras.en: The documentary by 72 Films includes archival footage from early comedy shows and appearances, including an on-stage Q&A in which he described himself as a "bloke from Essex," before adding, "I also raped someone once."
paras.zh: 72 Films 制作的这部纪录片包含了早期喜剧表演和露面的档案片段，其中包括一段台上问答，他在问答中称自己是“来自埃塞克斯的家伙”，然后补充道，“我也强奸过某人一次。”

articles.title: Iran targeted US radar system in Bahrain

paras.en: Iran said its forces hit a US early warning radar system in Bahrain on Friday. However, the US military denied the claims and said it shot down two Iranian attack drones.
paras.zh: 伊朗表示，其部队周五袭击了位于巴林的美国预警雷达系统。不过，美国军方否认了这一说法，并表示击落了两架伊朗攻击无人机。

paras.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) initially said in a statement that its air force targeted and destroyed the radar on the island of Bahrain.
paras.zh: 伊朗革命卫队（IRGC）最初在一份声明中表示，其空军瞄准并摧毁了巴林岛上的雷达。

paras.en: They claimed this was a retaliatory attack in response to an US attack on a telecommunications tower in the Iranian county of Sirik, on the shores of the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 他们声称这是对美国袭击霍尔木兹海峡沿岸伊朗锡里克县一座电信塔的报复性袭击。

paras.en: Several hours later, the US military's Central Command, denied the IRGC's claim that the radar was destroyed and said it stopped two "one-way attack drones" targeting Bahrain by the militant group.
paras.zh: 几个小时后，美军中央司令部否认了伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队关于雷达被摧毁的说法，并表示它阻止了该武装组织针对巴林的两架“单向攻击无人机”。

paras.en: Iran war, started by the US and Israeli strikes on February 28, is currently undergoing a de-escalation as main issues remain unresolved.
paras.zh: 2月28日，美国和以色列发动袭击引发的伊朗战争，由于主要问题仍未解决，目前正在降温。

paras.en: Both US and Israel are holding off major attacks as they held elections over the last weeks.
paras.zh: 美国和以色列在过去几周举行选举时都在阻止重大袭击。

paras.en: On the other hand, Tehran has continued seeking to control the Strait of Hormuz, a key transit point for global oil and natural gas supplies, while continuing to attack ships it considers unauthorized users of the waterway.
paras.zh: 另一方面，德黑兰继续寻求控制全球石油和天然气供应的关键中转站霍尔木兹海峡，同时继续攻击其认为未经授权使用该水道的船只。

paras.en: The US Navy, which is enforcing its own blockade of Iranian vessels, has recently escorted tankers through the strait in the area where reports of burning ships came through.
paras.zh: 美国海军正在对伊朗船只实施封锁，最近护送油轮通过该地区的海峡，有报道称，有船只被烧毁的地区。

paras.en: Before the midterm elections, US President Donald Trump said on October, "We may do another little Epic Fury," referring to US-Israeli strikes, without giving any timeframe.
paras.zh: 中期选举前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在 10 月表示，“我们可能会再进行一次小小的史诗般的愤怒”，指的是美国和以色列的袭击，但没有给出任何时间表。

paras.en: Trump is expected to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at an APEC leaders' summit in China next week and discuss ending the war in Iran.
paras.zh: 预计特朗普将于下周在中国举行的亚太经合组织领导人峰会上会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔普京，并讨论结束伊朗战争的问题。

paras.en: Pakistan-mediated peace talks between the US and Iran on April failed to reach a conclusion.
paras.zh: 4月，巴基斯坦斡旋的美国与伊朗和谈未能达成结论。

articles.title: Why does El Salvador's Bukele have troops in Haiti?

paras.en: Haiti has been engulfed in crisis since 2018, with protests, a presidential assassination and widespread gang violence bringing the country to its knees.
paras.zh: 自 2018 年以来，海地一直深陷危机，抗议活动、总统暗杀和广泛的帮派暴力使该国陷入崩溃。

paras.en: But earlier this week, Haiti's Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aime hailed a major win in the battle against the violence, thanks to "the commitment of the Salvadorean forces in the fight against gangs."
paras.zh: 但本周早些时候，海地总理阿利克斯·迪迪埃·菲尔斯-艾梅称赞打击暴力的斗争取得了重大胜利，这要归功于“萨尔瓦多军队在打击帮派方面的承诺”。

paras.en: El Salvador's President, Nayib Bukele had earlier said a joint task force between the countries had "destroyed" what he called "the house of Lanmo San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters." He also tweeted out an as-yet unverified video of helicopters firing on a sprawling property.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多总统纳伊布·布克莱早些时候表示，两国之间的联合特遣部队“摧毁了”他所谓的“Lanmo San Jou 的房屋和 400 Mawozo 帮派的总部”。他还在推特上发布了一段未经证实的视频，显示直升机向一片广阔的土地开火。

paras.en: Why are troops from El Salvador in Haiti?
paras.zh: 为什么萨尔瓦多的军队驻扎在海地？

paras.en: A number of Salvadoran troops have been stationed in Haiti, nearly 2,000 kilometers from their homeland, since the beginning of 2025, mostly in an attempt to curb gang influence.
paras.zh: 自2025年初以来，多支萨尔瓦多军队驻扎在距离祖国近2000公里的海地，主要是为了遏制帮派影响。

paras.en: Last month, Bukele dispatched more than 2,000 troops and special forces to Haiti, ostensibly to rescue four Salvadorans who were ambushed on October 18 and have not yet been found.
paras.zh: 上个月，布克莱向海地派遣了2000多名士兵和特种部队，表面上是为了营救10月18日遭到伏击、至今尚未被发现的四名萨尔瓦多人。

paras.en: Writing on social media platform X, Fils-Aime thanked the Salvadorean military for helping "the fight against gangs." The two nations are, he added, working alongside the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF), in an attempt to "regain control of the territory and restore state authority."
paras.zh: 菲尔斯-艾梅在社交媒体平台 X 上撰文，感谢萨尔瓦多军方帮助“打击帮派”。他补充说，两国正在与联合国支持的镇压部队（GSF）合作，试图“重新控制领土并恢复国家权威”。

paras.en: The GSF has been operating in Haiti since 2016. But there are doubts to the legitimacy of El Salvador's presence.
paras.zh: GSF 自 2016 年以来一直在海地开展业务。但萨尔瓦多存在的合法性存在疑问。

paras.en: "Where the lines are and where the coordination begins and ends between a bunch of distinct entities and security forces is a huge concern about how this actually plays out, and El Salvador are trying to frame it as their choice, their action," Jake Johnston, a Haiti expert and director of international research at the Center for Economic and Policy Research (CEPR) in Washington, told non-profit news agency The New Humanitarian this week.
paras.zh: 海地问题专家、华盛顿经济与政策研究中心（CEPR）国际研究主任杰克·约翰斯顿（Jake Johnston）本周对非营利新闻机构《新人道主义》表示：“一群不同实体和安全部队之间的界限在哪里，协调从哪里开始和结束，这实际上是如何发挥作用的一个巨大问题，萨尔瓦多正试图将其视为他们的选择、他们的行动。”

paras.en: A UN report about Haiti released on Thursday described "bloody turf wars, sexual violence and other horrors, noting that serious violations and abuses continue to be committed across the Port-au-Prince metropolitan area and in the Artibonite and South-East departments."
paras.zh: 周四发布的一份关于海地的联合国报告描述了“血腥的地盘争夺战、性暴力和其他恐怖行为，并指出太子港大都市区以及阿蒂博尼特省和东南部省继续发生严重的侵犯和虐待行为。”

paras.en: It further found that between July and September 2026, at least 1,167 people were killed and 459 injured, with more than half of that violence stemming from "ground or aerial operations carried out by security forces against gangs, sometimes with the support of a private military company using drones."
paras.zh: 报告进一步发现，2026 年 7 月至 9 月期间，至少有 1,167 人死亡、459 人受伤，其中一半以上的暴力事件源于“安全部队针对团伙开展的地面或空中行动，有时在私营军事公司的支持下使用无人机”。

paras.en: For many observers, this chaos is a major part of the appeal for Bukele, who appears to wish to export his mano dura (iron fist) policy on to foreign soil. The policy saw gang members jailed on a huge scale and a significant drop in the murder rate of a country once notorious for homicide. But Romain Le Cour Grandmaison, a Haiti expert from the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime, told DW earlier this month that Haiti's gang problem is more entrenched. He says using the same tactics as in El Salvador may not have the same result.
paras.zh: 对于许多观察家来说，这种混乱是布克莱的主要吸引力，他似乎希望将他的马诺杜拉（铁拳）政策输出到外国领土。这项政策导致帮派成员大规模入狱，这个曾经因杀人而臭名昭著的国家的谋杀率大幅下降。但全球打击跨国有组织犯罪倡议组织的海地专家罗曼·勒库尔·格兰德梅森(Romain Le Cour Grandmaison)本月早些时候告诉德国之声，海地的帮派问题更为根深蒂固。他说，使用与萨尔瓦多相同的策略可能不会产生相同的结果。

paras.en: "Haiti does not currently have the conditions to replicate the Salvadoran model: Its prisons were emptied in 2024, its justice system is largely paralyzed and criminal groups resemble militias more than gangs, with territory, taxes, weapons of war and political networks that protect them," Le Cour Grandmaison said.
paras.zh: “海地目前不具备复制萨尔瓦多模式的条件：其监狱在 2024 年被清空，司法系统基本瘫痪，犯罪集团更像民兵而不是帮派，有领土、税收、战争武器和政治网络来保护他们，”Le Cour Grandmaison 说。

paras.en: Despite El Salvador being on Donald Trump's list of "shithole countries" that the US president disparaged in 2018 in notorious remarks which he later partially denied, relations between the US and El Salvador have improved markedly during Trump's second term.
paras.zh: 尽管萨尔瓦多被列入唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)的“粪坑国家”名单，美国总统在2018年发表了臭名昭著的言论，他后来部分否认了这一名单，但美国和萨尔瓦多之间的关系在特朗普第二任期内显着改善。

paras.en: The number of migrants deported to El Salvador from the US rose by 98% at the start of 2026 and Le Cour Grandmaison said the US plays "a central, albeit very discreet, role in public life" in El Salvador.
paras.zh: 2026 年初，从美国驱逐到萨尔瓦多的移民人数增加了 98%，Le Cour Grandmaison 表示，美国在萨尔瓦多的“公共生活中发挥着尽管非常谨慎的核心作用”。

paras.en: Bukele's move to position himself as an ally of Trump has seen the US president offer him a level of endorsement and autonomy to do what Bukele deems necessary to protect El Salvador's security and that of its troops.
paras.zh: 布克莱将自己定位为特朗普的盟友，美国总统向他提供了一定程度的支持和自主权，让他可以做布克莱认为必要的事情，以保护萨尔瓦多及其军队的安全。

paras.en: "He said that he has a big problem with Haiti. I said: 'Look, you're running your country. You have to do what you have to do,'" Trump said in November.
paras.zh: “他说他对海地有一个大问题。我说：‘听着，你在管理你的国家。你必须做你必须做的事，’”特朗普去年 11 月表示。

articles.title: The dangers of revising Europe's security architecture

paras.en: European leaders have so far found compromises in response to many of US President Donald Trump's demands.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，欧洲领导人已找到妥协方案来回应美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的许多要求。

paras.en: But they were surprised to hear Trump say that he raised Europe's security framework with Russian officials.
paras.zh: 但他们惊讶地听到特朗普说他向俄罗斯官员提出了欧洲安全框架。

paras.en: "It's going to be a big agreement and it's going to involve more than Ukraine," Trump said after meeting Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev at the White House last week.
paras.zh: 特朗普上周在白宫会见俄罗斯总统特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫后表示：“这将是一项重大协议，涉及的不仅仅是乌克兰。”

paras.en: He said that deal might include all of Europe. But what he meant by "all of Europe" was not clear.
paras.zh: 他表示，该协议可能包括整个欧洲。但他所说的“整个欧洲”是什么意思并不清楚。

paras.en: US envoy Jared Kushner also wrote that Europe and Russia had struggled to establish a sustainable security framework for more than 30 years.
paras.zh: 美国特使贾里德·库什纳还写道，30多年来，欧洲和俄罗斯一直在努力建立可持续的安全框架。

paras.en: Kushner said he was looking at a "broader" European architecture before he flew to meet with Russian and Ukrainian representatives in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，在飞往阿布扎比与俄罗斯和乌克兰代表会面之前，他正在研究“更广泛”的欧洲建筑。

paras.en: European diplomats immediately pushed back on Washington's approach to secure a peace deal in Ukraine because they feared that a peace settlement could restore Russia's sphere of influence and undermine NATO.
paras.zh: 欧洲外交官立即反对华盛顿在乌克兰达成和平协议的做法，因为他们担心和平解决方案可能会恢复俄罗斯的势力范围并削弱北约。

paras.en: "We already have European security architecture in place. NATO and the European Union both have their respective roles. We must make sure Ukraine is integrated into this architecture," said Kaja Kallas, the European Union's foreign policy chief.
paras.zh: 欧盟外交政策负责人卡贾·卡拉斯表示：“我们已经建立了欧洲安全架构。北约和欧盟都有各自的角色。我们必须确保乌克兰融入这一架构。”

paras.en: The issue with revising Europe's postwar security framework
paras.zh: 修改欧洲战后安全框架的问题

paras.en: Russia made clear during talks in Abu Dhabi earlier this week that they were keen to discuss a broader European security framework before tackling the specifics of the war.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯本周早些时候在阿布扎比举行的会谈中明确表示，他们热衷于在解决战争细节之前讨论更广泛的欧洲安全框架。

paras.en: "Phrases about the European security architecture are certainly Russian talking points and not only talking points but, to a degree, part of a media propaganda effort that Russia makes to frame the war as it wishes to frame the war," said Michael Kimmage, a historian of the Cold War.
paras.zh: 冷战历史学家迈克尔·金马奇表示：“有关欧洲安全架构的言论肯定是俄罗斯的谈话要点，而且不仅是谈话要点，而且在某种程度上，也是俄罗斯为塑造这场战争而进行的媒体宣传努力的一部分，就像它希望塑造这场战争一样。”

paras.en: Russian leaders, including Vladimir Putin, have long alleged that the US and NATO repeatedly violated pledges they made in the early 1990s not to expand the alliance into the former Soviet bloc.
paras.zh: 包括弗拉基米尔·普京在内的俄罗斯领导人长期以来一直声称，美国和北约一再违反他们在 90 年代初做出的不将联盟扩大到前苏联集团的承诺。

paras.en: They have seen NATO's enlargement during this period as having put them in a humiliating position in which they could do very little.
paras.zh: 他们认为北约在此期间的东扩使他们处于一种屈辱的境地，他们无能为力。

paras.en: At the same time, in the 1990s, the European project saw the birth of the European Union, the single market that ensured the free movement of goods and people across member states, the Schengen agreement for border-free travel, and the euro.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在 20 世纪 90 年代，欧洲项目见证了欧盟的诞生、确保成员国之间货物和人员自由流动的单一市场、无国界旅行的申根协议以及欧元。

paras.en: The core idea was to extend peace across the continent.
paras.zh: 其核心思想是将和平扩展到整个非洲大陆。

paras.en: "Europe can mean so many things, but the European project was not designed for war. It was designed for peace," said Kimmage.
paras.zh: “欧洲可以意味着很多事情，但欧洲项目不是为了战争而设计的。它是为了和平而设计的，”金马奇说。

paras.en: During this period, there were even suggestions of Russia becoming a NATO member.
paras.zh: 在此期间，甚至有人建议俄罗斯加入北约。

paras.en: But that relative period of stability changed after Russia invaded Georgia in 2008, annexed Crimea in 2014 and launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
paras.zh: 但在俄罗斯于 2008 年入侵格鲁吉亚、2014 年吞并克里米亚以及 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰之后，这段相对稳定的时期发生了变化。

paras.en: "Russia wants to redraw all of this by force. And I think that that's fundamentally unacceptable to Europe with all the diversity and variations that you get within the European landscape on what's acceptable and not acceptable. I think the large-scale redrawing of borders by force is just not the European project," said Kimmage.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯希望通过武力重新划定所有这一切。我认为这对于欧洲来说从根本上是不可接受的，因为欧洲格局中关于什么是可以接受的、什么是不可以接受的存在着多样性和差异。我认为通过武力大规模重新划定边界不是欧洲的项目，”金马奇说。

paras.en: "So to the extent that the redrawing of borders by force is the lifeblood of Russian foreign policy, and I think that's a pretty easy case to make, Russia and Europe are at an impasse," he said.
paras.zh: “因此，如果以武力重新划定边界是俄罗斯外交政策的命脉，而且我认为这是一个很容易提出的理由，那么俄罗斯和欧洲就陷入了僵局，”他说。

paras.en: What was to happen to Ukraine's security?
paras.zh: 乌克兰的安全会发生什么？

paras.en: The Trump administration very quickly turned to making sure that "existing European security institutions" would be intact, with Jared Kushner having said late Thursday that the next round of negotiations would include "our European partners."
paras.zh: 特朗普政府很快转向确保“现有的欧洲安全机构”完好无损，贾里德·库什纳周四晚间表示，下一轮谈判将包括“我们的欧洲伙伴”。

paras.en: Kushner, along with Steve Witkoff, flew to Moscow to talk to Putin after talks in Abu Dhabi. Then they flew to Dublin, Ireland, to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 库什纳和史蒂夫·威特科夫在阿布扎比会谈后飞往莫斯科与普京会谈。随后，他们飞往爱尔兰都柏林，会见乌克兰总统泽连斯基。

paras.en: Kushner had earlier Thursday signaled some "really incredible" postwar plans for Ukraine, saying that it could not be concluded without Europeans at the table.
paras.zh: 库什纳周四早些时候曾表示，乌克兰有一些“真正令人难以置信”的战后计划，称如果没有欧洲人参与，该计划就无法达成。

paras.en: "We should not allow a diktat from Russia that would result in some kind of neutralization or significant reduction in the military forces of Ukraine going forward, because that would make Ukraine very, very vulnerable to future aggression and pressure coming from Russia," said Hiski Haukkala, the director of the Finnish Institute of International Affairs.
paras.zh: 芬兰国际事务研究所所长希斯基·豪卡拉表示：“我们不应该允许俄罗斯发出指令，导致乌克兰未来军事力量出现某种形式的中立或大幅削减，因为这将使乌克兰非常非常容易受到俄罗斯未来的侵略和压力。”

paras.en: That would mean that Ukraine would also be completely dependent on the security guarantees that the US or Europeans are able and willing to provide.
paras.zh: 这意味着乌克兰也将完全依赖美国或欧洲人能够并且愿意提供的安全保证。

paras.en: "We are supporting Ukraine because we are supporting international law and the basic norms of decency and international security when it comes to European security architecture. And this is the vantage point from which we are operating," he said.
paras.zh: “我们支持乌克兰，因为在欧洲安全架构方面，我们支持国际法以及体面和国际安全的基本准则。这就是我们运作的有利位置，”他说。

paras.en: The European Union has repeatedly pointed to some of the basic treaties that Russia broke, including:
paras.zh: 欧盟多次指出俄罗斯违反的一些基本条约，包括：

paras.en: - The Helsinki Act of 1975, which established the ten core principles of European security, including the non-use of force or threat against territorial integrity.
paras.zh: - 1975 年《赫尔辛基法案》，确立了欧洲安全的十项核心原则，包括不使用武力或威胁领土完整。

paras.en: - The Charter of Paris for a New Europe that built on Helsinki commitments
paras.zh: - 以赫尔辛基承诺为基础的《巴黎新欧洲宪章》

paras.en: - The Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE), which was one of the few multilateral security forums where the West and Russia engaged.
paras.zh: - 欧洲安全与合作组织（欧安组织），这是西方和俄罗斯参与的少数多边安全论坛之一。

paras.en: - The Budapest Memorandum of 1994 in which Russia, the US and the UK provided security assurances to Ukraine and others in exchange for them giving up their nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: - 1994 年《布达佩斯备忘录》，俄罗斯、美国和英国向乌克兰和其他国家提供安全保证，以换取他们放弃核武器。

paras.en: "Russia walked away from these principles and smashed them to pieces in the process. And they are not interested in reinstating the previous security architecture order. They want something different in its stead. And as long as this is not on the table, the Russian form of negotiation is to wage war. War is a form of bargaining," Haukkala said.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯放弃了这些原则，并在此过程中将它们粉碎。他们对恢复以前的安全架构秩序不感兴趣。他们想要一些不同的东西来取而代之。只要这不摆在桌面上，俄罗斯的谈判形式就是发动战争。战争是讨价还价的一种形式，”豪卡拉说。

paras.en: "And they are signaling strategic intent to change the makeup of European security, to subdue Ukraine and to change the very essence of European security," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“他们发出了改变欧洲安全构成、压制乌克兰并改变欧洲安全本质的战略意图。”

paras.en: Daniel Fried, a former assistant secretary of state for European Affairs in the George W. Bush administration, said Russia is very good at sticking to its demands.
paras.zh: 乔治·W·布什政府负责欧洲事务的前助理国务卿丹尼尔·弗里德表示，俄罗斯非常善于坚持自己的要求。

paras.en: He said Russians know how to negotiate and "right now, they are not negotiating," referring to talks in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 他说俄罗斯人知道如何谈判，“现在他们没有谈判”，指的是在阿布扎比举行的谈判。

paras.en: Some experts said there was no possibility of having a new security architecture with the Russians at this point because there was no trust or common vision to align with Russia at the moment.
paras.zh: 一些专家表示，目前不可能与俄罗斯建立新的安全架构，因为目前没有与俄罗斯结盟的信任或共同愿景。

paras.en: Others like Balazs Jarabik, an expert on post-Soviet politics, said that Russia was part of the European security architecture whether Europeans liked it or not.
paras.zh: 其他人，例如后苏联政治专家巴拉兹·贾拉比克（Balazs Jarabik）表示，无论欧洲人喜欢与否，俄罗斯都是欧洲安全架构的一部分。

paras.en: "And the question is whether it's included as our enemy. Obviously, Russia is not going to be a partner, right? We have to find a modus operandi to reduce the risk of a horizontal escalation and potentially a bigger European war, even a bigger one than what we have now."
paras.zh: “问题是它是否被列为我们的敌人。显然，俄罗斯不会成为我们的合作伙伴，对吧？我们必须找到一种做法，以减少横向升级和可能发生更大规模的欧洲战争，甚至比我们现在的战争更大的风险。”

paras.en: A host of European leaders on Friday rejected the Russian demands to discuss Europe's security framework as well, with a spokesperson for the German government saying that Berlin was looking to host a meeting of the "Coalition of the Willing" to secure funding for Ukraine's defense and reach a unified position regarding future peace talks.
paras.zh: 周五，多位欧洲领导人拒绝了俄罗斯讨论欧洲安全框架的要求，德国政府发言人表示，柏林正在寻求主办“意愿联盟”会议，以确保为乌克兰国防提供资金，并就未来的和平谈判达成统一立场。

articles.title: Eisenkot slams Netanyahu’s ‘racist’ campaign against Palestinian Israelis

paras.en: Israeli prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot has accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of fuelling a “racist and violent” campaign against Palestinian citizens of Israel during the elections.
paras.zh: 以色列总理候选人加迪·艾森科特指责看守总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在选举期间煽动针对以色列巴勒斯坦公民的“种族主义和暴力”运动。

paras.en: Eisenkot, who has been tasked with forming Israel’s new government, posted a lengthy social media update on recent developments in Israel on Friday.
paras.zh: 负责组建以色列新政府的艾森科特周五在社交媒体上发布了一篇关于以色列近期事态发展的长篇最新动态。

paras.en: “Arab citizens of Israel make up 21 percent of the total population. Since the start of the election campaign, they have faced a racist and violent campaign of delegitimisation fuelled by the outgoing prime minister and his circle for political reasons,” Eisenkot wrote on X.
paras.zh: “以色列的阿拉伯公民占总人口的 21%。自竞选活动开始以来，他们面临着一场种族主义和暴力的非法化运动，这些运动是由即将卸任的总理及其圈子出于政治原因推动的，”艾森科特在 X 上写道。

paras.en: “The prime minister of Israel is the prime minister of all citizens, including those who did not vote for him,” he said. “Arab citizens of Israel are part of the Israeli story. The attempt to marginalise them and smear them as a group is an anti-state act.”
paras.zh: “以色列总理是所有公民的总理，包括那些没有投票给他的人，”他说。 “以色列的阿拉伯公民是以色列故事的一部分。试图将他们边缘化并抹黑他们作为一个群体是一种反国家行为。”

paras.en: In Israel’s October 27 elections, Eisenkot’s four-party alliance won 48 seats, while Netanyahu’s right-wing and religious bloc secured 53, leaving both short of the 61 needed for a parliamentary majority. Arab-led parties, representing Palestinian citizens of Israel, won a record 19 seats.
paras.zh: 在以色列 10 月 27 日的选举中，艾森科特的四党联盟赢得了 48 个席位，而内塔尼亚胡的右翼和宗教集团获得了 53 个席位，两者均未达到议会多数席位所需的 61 个席位。代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的阿拉伯领导的政党赢得了创纪录的 19 个席位。

paras.en: Netanyahu repeatedly made unproven allegations of electoral fraud by Arab-majority parties – claims Israel’s own electoral authorities have rejected.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡多次对阿拉伯占多数的政党提出未经证实的选举舞弊指控，但以色列自己的选举当局拒绝了这一指控。

paras.en: The caretaker leader has also repeatedly criticised Arab-led parties for refusing to describe Hamas as a “terror group” following the attack on Israel on October 7, 2023, despite all of the parties’ leaders condemning the Hamas-led assault.
paras.zh: 这位看守领导人还多次批评阿拉伯领导的政党在 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击以色列后拒绝将哈马斯描述为“恐怖组织”，尽管所有政党领导人都谴责哈马斯领导的袭击。

paras.en: “One can disagree with the representatives of the Arab parties, and one can even feel deep revulsion toward some of them, but one cannot, should not, and I will not allow an entire sector to be slandered,” Eisenkot said.
paras.zh: 艾森科特说：“人们可以不同意阿拉伯政党的代表，甚至可以对其中一些代表深感厌恶，但人们不能、不应该，而且我不会允许整个部门受到诽谤。”

paras.en: Arab-led parties have endorsed Eisenkot to replace Netanyahu. However, Eisenkot has ruled out forming a government with those parties, which would give him a 67-seat bloc. Winning the backing of the two ultra-Orthodox parties, United Torah Judaism and Shas, would give him exactly 61 seats.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯领导的政党支持艾森科特取代内塔尼亚胡。然而，艾森科特排除了与这些政党组建政府的可能性，这将使他拥有 67 个席位。如果赢得联合托拉犹太教和沙斯这两个极端正统政党的支持，他将获得 61 个席位。

paras.en: On efforts to form an emergency government, Eisenkot reiterated that he wants to fulfil the mandate as soon as possible, adding “it would be a grave mistake not to do so”.
paras.zh: 在谈到组建紧急政府的努力时，艾森科特重申，他希望尽快履行职责，并补充说“不这样做将是一个严重的错误”。

paras.en: Netanyahu weighs renewed strikes on Iran
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡考虑重新打击伊朗

paras.en: Eisenkot, who ran as Netanyahu’s main rival, has six weeks to form a new government.
paras.zh: 艾森科特是内塔尼亚胡的主要竞争对手，他有六周的时间组建新政府。

paras.en: While Netanyahu may be politically weakened, the prime minister is reported to be weighing military action against Iran, despite a lack of enthusiasm from the United States, his own military establishment, and Eisenkot, who has demanded that Netanyahu avoid any new escalation unless it is critical.
paras.zh: 虽然内塔尼亚胡可能在政治上被削弱，但据报道，总理正在考虑对伊朗采取军事行动，尽管美国、他自己的军事机构和艾森科特缺乏热情，艾森科特要求内塔尼亚胡避免任何新的升级，除非事态严重。

paras.en: In Friday’s update, Eisenkot said he had met with Netanyahu and his military secretary on Thursday to discuss the security situation but provided no details.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在周五的更新中表示，他已于周四会见了内塔尼亚胡及其军事秘书，讨论了安全局势，但没有提供任何细节。

paras.en: Earlier in the week, Eisenkot said that he was open to including Netanyahu in his coalition. Eisenkot suggested Netanyahu’s far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich was also welcome to join.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，艾森科特表示，他愿意将内塔尼亚胡纳入其联盟。艾森科特建议内塔尼亚胡的极右翼财政部长贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇也欢迎加入。

paras.en: Eisenkot led Israel’s military from 2015 to 2019 and sat as an observer in Netanyahu’s war cabinet for the first eight months of Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, which began in October 2023.
paras.zh: 艾森科特于 2015 年至 2019 年领导以色列军队，并在 2023 年 10 月开始的以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争的前八个月内担任内塔尼亚胡战时内阁观察员。

articles.title: At least 10 killed in Guinea clashes over gold mining ban

paras.en: At least 10 people have been killed and 13 others injured in clashes in northeastern Guinea between protesters and security forces enforcing restrictions on gold mining, the government said.
paras.zh: 政府表示，几内亚东北部抗议者与强制限制金矿开采的安全部队之间发生冲突，造成至少 10 人死亡、13 人受伤。

paras.en: The country’s Ministry of Territorial Administration said late on Thursday that clashes occurred on Wednesday, when defence and security forces were verifying the implementation of a ban on artisanal gold mining.
paras.zh: 该国领土管理部周四晚间表示，周三发生了冲突，当时国防和安全部队正在核实手工采金禁令的实施情况。

paras.en: The violence erupted in Balato, in the Siguiri region, during a patrol against illegal and unregulated gold mining. Protesters erected barricades blocking the patrol, as the situation escalated into clashes and exchanges of gunfire, the statement said. It did not specify who opened fire.
paras.zh: 锡吉里地区巴拉托在巡逻打击非法和不受监管的金矿开采期间爆发了暴力事件。声明称，随着局势升级为冲突和交火，抗议者竖起路障阻止巡逻。它没有具体说明是谁开枪的。

paras.en: Ten people, including five foreign nationals whose identities have yet to be established, were among those killed. The injured included civilians and members of the security forces.
paras.zh: 遇难者中有十人，其中包括五名身份尚未确定的外国人。受伤者包括平民和安全部队成员。

paras.en: Two pick-up trucks and a security forces truck were burned, while a firearm and a motorcycle were taken by protesters, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示，两辆皮卡车和一辆安全部队卡车被烧毁，抗议者夺走了一把枪支和一辆摩托车。

paras.en: Judicial authorities have been tasked with establishing what triggered the violence and determining responsibility.
paras.zh: 司法当局的任务是确定引发暴力的原因并确定责任。

paras.en: Guinea banned artisanal gold mining in Siguiri on November 2. Authorities said artisanal miners’ failure to comply with regulations had led to environmental degradation, including pollution of agricultural land, rivers and vegetation cover.
paras.zh: 几内亚于 11 月 2 日禁止在锡吉里进行手工金矿开采。当局表示，手工采矿者不遵守规定导致环境恶化，包括农业用地、河流和植被的污染。

paras.en: Neighbouring Mali said last week that around 100,000 people had arrived in the capital Bamako and nearly 60,000 more in the border town of Kouremale after they were forced to leave Guinea when the ban on artisanal mining was announced.
paras.zh: 邻国马里上周表示，手工采矿禁令宣布后，被迫离开几内亚的约10万人已抵达首都巴马科，另有近6万人抵达边境城镇库雷马莱。

paras.en: Burkina Faso said on Friday it had repatriated 45,406 of its citizens, who were forced to leave Guinea as a result of the ban.
paras.zh: 布基纳法索周五表示，已遣返 45,406 名因禁令而被迫离开几内亚的公民。

paras.en: Artisanal mining, driven by growing demand for metals and rising prices, is a common activity across much of West Africa.
paras.zh: 在金属需求增长和价格上涨的推动下，手工采矿是西非大部分地区的常见活动。

paras.en: Artisanal and small-scale gold mining supports the livelihoods of more than 300,000 people in Guinea, according to the UN Environment Programme.
paras.zh: 根据联合国环境规划署的数据，手工和小规模金矿开采支撑着几内亚超过 300,000 人的生计。

paras.en: But the Guinean government said the restrictions aim to curb environmental damage from mining, including the destruction of farmland by heavy machinery and the pollution of rivers by chemicals.
paras.zh: 但几内亚政府表示，这些限制旨在遏制采矿造成的环境破坏，包括重型机械对农田的破坏和化学品对河流的污染。

paras.en: Authorities arrested more than 1,200 people suspected of illegal gold mining in the Siguiri region earlier this month, according to authorities, with the first mass trials opened this week.
paras.zh: 据当局称，本月早些时候，当局逮捕了 1,200 多名涉嫌在锡吉里地区非法开采金矿的人，并于本周开始了首次大规模审判。

articles.title: How will the US deal with Nvidia scandal?

paras.en: Tech giant CEO resigned and will testify before Congress.
paras.zh: 科技巨头首席执行官辞职并将在国会作证。

paras.en: Jensen Huang, tech superstar, and now former chief executive of Nvidia, is due to appear before the United States Congress.
paras.zh: 科技巨星、现任英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋将出席美国国会听证会。

paras.en: He has admitted to having an affair with a woman accused of having links to Chinese intelligence.
paras.zh: 他承认与一名被指控与中国情报机构有联系的女性有染。

paras.en: Nvidia says no company data has been compromised and there were no breaches of national security. But the FBI and the Department of Justice have launched investigations.
paras.zh: 英伟达表示，没有公司数据被泄露，也没有违反国家安全的情况。但联邦调查局和司法部已展开调查。

paras.en: Could this damage the US chip-manufacturing industry?
paras.zh: 这是否会损害美国芯片制造业？

paras.en: And how will the US deal with potential spying at the highest levels of one of the world’s most valuable companies?
paras.zh: 美国将如何应对全球最有价值公司之一最高层的潜在间谍活动？

paras.en: Paulo Carvao – Research fellow at Harvard Kennedy School, specialising in AI and technology policy
paras.zh: Paulo Carvao – 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院研究员，专门研究人工智能和技术政策

paras.en: Aya Ibrahim – Senior fellow for economic and national security at the AI Now Institute
paras.zh: Aya Ibrahim – AI Now 研究所经济和国家安全高级研究员

paras.en: Einar Tangen – Senior fellow at the Centre for International Governance Innovation and a specialist in China-US relations
paras.zh: 艾纳尔·坦根（Einar Tangen）——国际治理创新中心高级研究员、中美关系专家

articles.title: Nvidia's interim CEO inherits risky AI bets and a legal mess
articles.author: Michel Martin

paras.en: Nvidia's interim CEO inherits risky AI bets and a legal mess
paras.zh: 英伟达临时首席执行官继承了高风险的人工智能赌注和法律混乱

paras.en: A suspected intelligence scandal, reports of multiple extramarital affairs and the abrupt departure of one of Silicon Valley's most influential CEOs. It's been a dizzying week for Nvidia and the AI industry.
paras.zh: 疑似情报丑闻、多起婚外情报道以及硅谷最有影响力的首席执行官之一的突然离职。对于英伟达和人工智能行业来说，这是令人眼花缭乱的一周。

paras.en: Jensen Huang helped bankroll the AI boom. Now, after 33 years at the helm of the leading company in AI, he's out, leaving questions about the future of an industry that has relied heavily on his company's financial backing. Longtime finance chief Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋为人工智能热潮提供了资金支持。现在，在执掌人工智能领域领先公司 33 年后，他离职了，这给这个严重依赖其公司财务支持的行业的未来留下了疑问。长期担任财务主管的科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 出任临时首席执行官。

paras.en: "Nvidia has put itself basically in a position of being a bank, backstopping everything," Gary Marcus, a cognitive scientist and longtime AI researcher, told Morning Edition.
paras.zh: 认知科学家、长期人工智能研究员加里·马库斯 (Gary Marcus) 表示：“英伟达基本上把自己定位为一家银行，为一切提供支持。”

paras.en: He was describing circular financing: Nvidia invests in AI companies that then use the money to buy Nvidia's chips. OpenAI, Anthropic and CoreWeave have relied on that funding, he said, even as many AI businesses struggle to turn a profit.
paras.zh: 他描述的是循环融资：英伟达投资人工智能公司，然后这些公司用这些钱购买英伟达的芯片。他表示，尽管许多人工智能企业难以盈利，但 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 CoreWeave 仍然依赖这笔资金。

paras.en: "Jensen was kind of a swashbuckler, willing to make bets of arbitrary size," Marcus said.
paras.zh: “詹森有点虚张声势，愿意下任意大小的赌注，”马库斯说。

paras.en: Unlike Huang, whose background is in engineering, Kress comes from finance and appears more cautious about making large financial bets, potentially changing how Nvidia backs the wider AI industry.
paras.zh: 与工程背景的黄不同，克雷斯来自金融界，对于进行大规模的金融押注似乎更加谨慎，这可能会改变英伟达支持更广泛的人工智能行业的方式。

paras.en: Kress will also have to contend with potential federal and congressional investigations into Nvidia's dealings involving China, leaving her to "clean up that mess," Marcus said.
paras.zh: 马库斯表示，克雷斯还必须应对联邦和国会可能对英伟达涉及中国的交易进行的调查，这让她“收拾残局”。

paras.en: He said lawmakers need answers about what information Huang may have shared with Alice Huang and why Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick had not intervened earlier.
paras.zh: 他表示，立法者需要了解黄可能与黄爱丽丝分享了哪些信息，以及商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克为何没有尽早干预。

paras.en: "Why didn't Lutnick shut some of this down when he was asked to?" Marcus said.
paras.zh: “为什么卢特尼克在被要求时不关闭其中的一些内容呢？”马库斯说。

paras.en: Listen to the full interview by clicking the blue button above.
paras.zh: 单击上面的蓝色按钮即可收听完整采访。

paras.en: The radio interview was edited by Simone Popperl and the web copy was edited by Suzanne Nuyen.
paras.zh: 电台采访由 Simone Popperl 编辑，网络文案由 Suzanne Nuyen 编辑。

articles.title: Nvidia CEO steps down. And, Sen. Chris Van Hollen to run for majority leader
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Nvidia CEO steps down. And, Sen. Chris Van Hollen to run for majority leader
paras.zh: 英伟达首席执行官辞职。参议员克里斯·范·霍伦 (Chris Van Hollen) 将竞选多数党领袖

paras.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is stepping down following reports of his extramarital affairs, the company's board announced. The company's chief financial officer, Colette Kress, has been appointed interim CEO. The company launched an investigation after allegations surfaced that Huang had an affair with one of its clients, who U.S. intelligence officials concluded had been recruited by China's top spy agency. In an email to Nvidia staff, Huang admitted to cheating on his wife and promised to cooperate with the investigation. Nvidia's share price fell sharply Wednesday after the news of his second affair with an Nvidia executive came to light. Huang was widely considered an important business leader in the U.S. and had close ties to President Trump.
paras.zh: 英伟达董事会宣布，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因婚外情报道而辞职。该公司首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 已被任命为临时首席执行官。在黄与其一名客户有染的指控浮出水面后，该公司展开了调查，美国情报官员断定该客户是由中国最高间谍机构招募的。在给英伟达员工的电子邮件中，黄承认对妻子不忠，并承诺配合调查。在他与英伟达高管第二次发生恋情的消息曝光后，英伟达股价周三大幅下跌。黄仁勋被广泛认为是美国重要的商界领袖，并与特朗普总统关系密切。

paras.en: - 🎧 Huang was the face of Nvidia, but Kress has also played a prominent role, NPR's John Ruwitch tells Up First. She is well-known within the company and among investors and business partners. Taking over during a crisis presents immense challenges, especially since Nvidia is a key player in the AI economy. The company produces the most widely-used chips powering the AI revolution, Ruwitch says. Kress must balance the short-term fallout from Huang's downfall while navigating Nvidia's long-term strategy. The strong demand for Nvidia's products is expected to continue as AI usage rises. Ruwitch says one remaining question is how much trust and flexibility the board will give Kress in her leadership.
paras.zh: - NPR 的 John Ruwitch 告诉 Up First，黄仁勋是 Nvidia 的代言人，但 Kress 也发挥了重要作用。她在公司内部以及投资者和业务合作伙伴中享有盛誉。在危机期间接管会带来巨大的挑战，特别是因为英伟达是人工智能经济的关键参与者。鲁维奇表示，该公司生产应用最广泛的芯片，为人工智能革命提供动力。克雷斯必须平衡黄仁勋倒台带来的短期影响，同时制定英伟达的长期战略。随着人工智能使用量的增加，对英伟达产品的强劲需求预计将持续下去。鲁维奇表示，剩下的一个问题是，董事会将给予克雷斯多少信任和灵活性。

paras.en: - 🎧 Huang's resignation may also have consequences for the U.S. government. NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben says the scandal is raising questions for the White House and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. Commerce handles imports and exports, and Kurtzleben says one big question is whether the U.S. should have more tightly restricted the chips it exports. Lawmakers from both parties want to know when Lutnick knew that Huang was in contact with a suspected Chinese asset, and what he did or didn't do in response.
paras.zh: - 🎧 黄的辞职也可能对美国政府产生影响。美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的丹妮尔·库茨莱本 (Danielle Kurtzleben) 表示，这一丑闻正在向白宫和商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克提出质疑。商务部负责进出口，库茨莱本表示，一个大问题是美国是否应该更严格地限制其出口芯片。两党议员都想知道卢特尼克何时知道黄与可疑的中国资产有联系，以及他做了什么或没有做什么回应。

paras.en: White House envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have been busy this week working on a new security framework between Russia and Europe and seeking to end the war in Ukraine. They led peace talks in Abu Dhabi, met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow and then traveled to Ireland to meet with Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 白宫特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳本周一直忙于制定俄罗斯与欧洲之间的新安全框架，并寻求结束乌克兰战争。他们在阿布扎比领导了和平谈判，在莫斯科会见了俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，然后前往爱尔兰会见了乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基。

paras.en: - 🎧 During their visit with Putin, both sides noted progress on the humanitarian track of negotiations, according to NPR's Charles Maynes. Kushner sees potential for a new security framework between Russia and Europe to help end the war, but Putin remains unyielding in public comments. Putin has accused Europe of prolonging the conflict through military support for Ukraine and ruled out European peacekeepers as part of any deal. Despite this, Witkoff said Putin had agreed to include Europeans in future talks, though the Kremlin didn't confirm it.
paras.zh: - 据美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes) 报道，在与普京访问期间，双方都注意到人道主义谈判取得了进展。库什纳认为俄罗斯和欧洲之间建立新的安全框架有可能有助于结束战争，但普京在公开评论中仍然不屈服。普京指责欧洲通过对乌克兰的军事支持来延长冲突，并排除欧洲维和部队作为任何协议的一部分。尽管如此，威特科夫表示，普京已同意让欧洲人参与未来的谈判，但克里姆林宫并未证实这一点。

paras.en: Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland has announced he will challenge New York's Chuck Schumer for the Senate majority leader position. Following recent midterm victories, Van Hollen said voters desired a "change from the status quo." Elected to the Senate in 2016 after more than a decade in the House, the 67-year-old progressive gained national attention last year for lobbying for the release of Kilmar Abrego Garcia after his wrongful deportation to a prison in El Salvador. His announcement comes as progressive activists and some Democrats push for the 75-year-old Schumer's replacement. Schumer has been in the role since 2017 but faced criticism from the Democratic base for failing to confront Trump vigorously during a funding dispute in early 2025.
paras.zh: 马里兰州参议员克里斯·范·霍伦宣布，他将挑战纽约州参议员查克·舒默，争夺参议院多数党领袖职位。在最近的中期选举胜利之后，范霍伦表示，选民希望“改变现状”。这位 67 岁的进步人士在众议院任职十多年后，于 2016 年当选为参议院议员，去年因游说基尔马·阿布雷戈·加西亚（Kilmar Abrego Garcia）被错误驱逐到萨尔瓦多监狱后获得释放而引起全国关注。在他宣布这一消息之际，进步活动人士和一些民主党人正在推动 75 岁的舒默的继任者。舒默自 2017 年以来一直担任这一职务，但因未能在 2025 年初的资金纠纷中积极对抗特朗普而受到民主党基础的批评。

paras.en: It's once again time to plan your Friendsgiving or Thanksgiving. You might be wondering: should you stick with your classic turkey recipe or spice things up? What about decorations — mini gourds or a stunning sunflower centerpiece? Let Life Kit help you decide with some fresh ideas to bring flavor, color and a touch of calm to your gathering.
paras.zh: 又到了计划你的朋友节或感恩节的时候了。您可能想知道：您应该坚持经典的火鸡食谱还是加点香料？装饰品怎么样——迷你葫芦或令人惊叹的向日葵中心装饰品？让 Life Kit 帮助您决定一些新鲜的想法，为您的聚会带来风味、色彩和一丝平静。

paras.en: - 🦃 Use "magical questions" to ignite engaging conversations with guests. Questions like "What's the weirdest thing you've found in your pocket?" can break the ice and reveal personalities in group settings.
paras.zh: - 🦃 使用“神奇问题”引发与客人的互动对话。诸如“你在口袋里发现的最奇怪的东西是什么？”之类的问题可以在群体环境中打破僵局并展现个性。

paras.en: - 🦃 If you're hosting, choose three moments to be fully present. You can't do everything on your to-do list, so focus on what matters most, like decorating the Thanksgiving table, serving turkey and watching the game.
paras.zh: - 🦃 如果您是主持人，请选择三个时刻来充分参与。您不可能完成待办事项清单上的所有事情，因此请专注于最重要的事情，例如装饰感恩节餐桌、供应火鸡和观看比赛。

paras.en: - 🦃 Place holiday decor in the entryway to make a strong first impression. A simple centerpiece, like a thrifted glass vase filled with pinecones or cranberries, can create a festive feel.
paras.zh: - 🦃 在入口处放置节日装饰，给人留下深刻的第一印象。一个简单的中心装饰品，比如装满松果或蔓越莓的旧玻璃花瓶，可以营造出节日的感觉。

paras.en: - 🦃 Engage all of your guests' five senses with cozy touches like a velvety blanket on the couch, a crackling candle and decorative gourds.
paras.zh: - 🦃 通过舒适的触感（如沙发上的天鹅绒毯子、噼啪作响的蜡烛和装饰葫芦）调动所有客人的五种感官。

paras.en: Check out what NPR is watching, reading and listening to this weekend:
paras.zh: 看看 NPR 本周末正在观看、阅读和收听的节目：

paras.en: 🍿 Movies: Gentle Monster follows a loving couple who move to a farmhouse and whose peace shatters when the husband is accused of a crime. Léa Seydoux, who plays the wife named Lucy, discusses her first "complex" lead role in English with Morning Edition.
paras.zh: 🍿 电影：《温柔的怪物》讲述了一对恩爱夫妻搬进农舍的故事，当丈夫被指控犯罪时，他们的平静被打破。扮演妻子露西的蕾雅·赛杜 (Léa Seydoux) 在《早间版》中讨论了她的第一个英语“复杂”主角。

paras.en: 📺 TV: The new show Cupertino follows two Silicon Valley lawyers whose new firm represents the underdog, takes on big tech and grapples with the complexities of AI.
paras.zh: 📺 电视：新剧《库比蒂诺》讲述了两位硅谷律师的新公司代表弱势群体的故事，他们挑战大型科技并应对人工智能的复杂性。

paras.en: 📚 Books: Journalist Mona Chalabi spent five years following 10 Americans of different economic standings to uncover what it takes to feel financially secure. Her book, Ten Lives: How What We Have Shapes Who We Are, delves into the elusive nature of financial security.
paras.zh: 📚 书籍：记者莫娜·查拉比 (Mona Chalabi) 花了五年时间跟踪 10 位不同经济状况的美国人，以揭示如何才能获得财务安全感。她的书《十种生命：我们所拥有的如何塑造我们是谁》深入探讨了金融安全的难以捉摸的本质。

paras.en: 🎵 Music: Rappers Lil Baby, Jack Harlow and SOB x RBE offer three ways to relight a flickering star and chart a path toward creative restoration through their respective albums, released today.
paras.zh: 🎵 音乐：说唱歌手 Lil Baby、Jack Harlow 和 SOB x RBE 提供了三种方式来重新点燃一颗闪烁的明星，并通过他们今天发行的各自专辑规划一条创造性恢复之路。

paras.en: 🎭 Theater: School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play wraps up its Broadway run this week. To celebrate, it will have paid livestreams on The League of Live Stream Theater's website. Set in a 1986 Ghanaian boarding school, the play humorously tackles themes of girlhood and beauty standards.
paras.zh: 🎭 剧院：女学生；或者，《非洲贱女孩戏剧》本周结束了百老汇演出。为了庆祝，它将在直播剧院联盟的网站上进行付费直播。该剧以 1986 年的加纳寄宿学校为背景，幽默地探讨了少女时代和美丽标准的主题。

paras.en: ❓Quiz: Did you actually pay attention this week, or did you just scroll past the headlines? Prove it.
paras.zh: ❓测验：这周你真的认真听了吗，还是只是浏览了头条新闻？证明一下。

paras.en: - Existing home sales fell to 3.75 million in October, marking an 8.8% drop from last year — the lowest sales in 16 years, according to the National Association of Realtors.
paras.zh: - 根据全国房地产经纪人协会的数据，10 月份成屋销售量降至 375 万套，比去年下降 8.8%，为 16 年来的最低销售量。

paras.en: - For more than 60 years, researchers at the University of Virginia have identified children with past-life memories. A new study suggests that those who died violently or unexpectedly are reincarnated more quickly than others. (via WBUR)
paras.zh: - 60 多年来，弗吉尼亚大学的研究人员一直在寻找具有前世记忆的儿童。一项新的研究表明，那些死于暴力或意外死亡的人比其他人转世得更快。 （通过 WBUR）

paras.en: - The American Cancer Society has recommended routine prostate cancer screenings for the first time. The group says that blood tests, especially for high-risk groups like Black men and those with a family history, could save lives.
paras.zh: - 美国癌症协会首次建议进行常规前列腺癌筛查。该组织表示，血液检测，特别是针对黑人男性和有家族病史的高危人群，可以挽救生命。

articles.title: What's Trump's strategy now with Iran? To keep things as they are
articles.author: Aya Batrawy

paras.en: What's Trump's strategy now with Iran? To keep things as they are
paras.zh: 特朗普现在对伊朗的战略是什么？保持事物原样

paras.en: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — President Donald Trump is confronting new realities nine months into the war with Iran that leave him with dwindling options to ending the conflict.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国迪拜——与伊朗开战九个月后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普面临着新的现实，这让他结束冲突的选择越来越少。

paras.en: On Thursday, he waved away the need for a deal with Iran, saying the U.S. has billions of Iran's dollars frozen in overseas accounts.
paras.zh: 周四，他否认了与伊朗达成协议的必要性，称美国在海外账户中冻结了数十亿美元的伊朗资金。

paras.en: "We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed. We've got their money," he wrote in a Truth Social post.
paras.zh: “我们不需要与伊朗达成协议。那些日子早已过去了。我们得到了他们的钱，”他在《真相社会》的一篇帖子中写道。

paras.en: Negotiations with Iran are stuck with mediator Qatar working to bridge the divide. Trump met Qatar's prime minister at the White House this week, and said afterward that Gulf Arab allies prefer "the status quo" of continued economic pressure on Iran. He wrote that while the U.S. remains "locked and loaded", an attack at this point "seems to be quite unlikely."
paras.zh: 与伊朗的谈判陷入困境，调解人卡塔尔正在努力弥合分歧。特朗普本周在白宫会见了卡塔尔总理，随后表示，海湾阿拉伯盟友更愿意维持对伊朗持续经济施压的“现状”。他写道，虽然美国仍然“已上膛”，但此时发动袭击“似乎不太可能”。

paras.en: That's a pivot from his threats to carry out quick, intense strikes on Iran in the days before he had to contend with two election setbacks.
paras.zh: 这是他在不得不应对两次选举挫折之前威胁要对伊朗进行快速、猛烈打击的一个转折点。

paras.en: Trump's wartime ally, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, whom he'd thrown his support behind, is on the cusp of being ousted from power after elections there.
paras.zh: 特朗普的战时盟友、以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）曾受到特朗普的支持，但在选举后，他正处于被赶下台的边缘。

paras.en: Meanwhile, at home, Trump's party lost its majority in Congress in midterm elections. Vice President JD Vance blamed Republican losses on the unpopular war with Iran and the nature of U.S. relations with Israel.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在国内，特朗普所在的政党在中期选举中失去了国会多数席位。副总统万斯将共和党的失败归咎于不受欢迎的与伊朗的战争以及美国与以色列关系的性质。

paras.en: With less room to room maneuver and Iran still defiant, Trump's strategy appears to be to keep things as they are, for now. That means the possibility of escalation still looms.
paras.zh: 由于房间之间的回旋余地较小，而且伊朗仍然目中无人，特朗普的策略似乎是暂时保持现状。这意味着升级的可能性仍然存在。

paras.en: Senior UAE diplomat, Anwar Gargash, told an audience in Abu Dhabi this week the region must "prepare for a prolonged period of uncertainty, in which neither a decisive resolution nor a stable regional order can be taken for granted."
paras.zh: 阿联酋高级外交官安瓦尔·加尔加什本周在阿布扎比对听众表示，该地区必须“为长期的不确定性做好准备，在这种情况下，无论是果断的解决方案还是稳定的地区秩序都不能被视为理所当然。”

paras.en: Here's what keeping the status quo looks like.
paras.zh: 这就是保持现状的样子。

paras.en: Iran's chokehold on the Strait of Hormuz persists
paras.zh: 伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡的封锁依然存在

paras.en: Official Iranian social media accounts frequently post videos of attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz for violating Iran's new rules requiring permission to navigate the waterway, which was open and free to ships before the war.
paras.zh: 伊朗官方社交媒体账户经常发布霍尔木兹海峡船只遭到袭击的视频，这些船只违反了伊朗要求获得航行许可的新规则，该水道在战前对船只开放且免费。

paras.en: The U.S., meanwhile, is assisting oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz using a route that's close to Oman's coastline. While this has helped Arab states export their oil, it does not solve the bigger problem of how to bring back the pre-war production levels of other vital products like liquified natural gas, fertilizer and aluminum. Nor does a status quo allow countries like Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain to import goods to their ports.
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国正在协助油轮使用靠近阿曼海岸线的路线通过霍尔木兹海峡。虽然这帮助了阿拉伯国家出口石油，但它并没有解决更大的问题，即如何使液化天然气、化肥和铝等其他重要产品的生产恢复到战前水平。现状也不允许科威特、卡塔尔和巴林等国家将货物进口到其港口。

paras.en: The International Monetary Fund says Gulf Arab states are in economic recession as a result of the war, despite higher oil prices. It says Kuwait, Qatar and Iraq's economies are contracting approximately 16% this year. Bahrain's is down 11%.
paras.zh: 国际货币基金组织表示，尽管油价上涨，海湾阿拉伯国家仍因战争而陷入经济衰退。报告称，科威特、卡塔尔和伊拉克的经济今年萎缩约16%。巴林下跌 11%。

paras.en: More limited strikes that could rapidly escalate
paras.zh: 更有限的罢工可能会迅速升级

paras.en: The U.S. is sending a third aircraft carrier with thousands of troops to the region, leaving open the possibility of another planned military escalation.
paras.zh: 美国正在向该地区派遣第三艘航母和数千名士兵，这可能导致另一次计划中的军事升级。

paras.en: This week, Iran unveiled what it says is a new underground missile production site.
paras.zh: 本周，伊朗公布了一个新的地下导弹生产基地。

paras.en: The U.S. and Iran are also still occasionally carrying out tit-for-tat for strikes.
paras.zh: 美国和伊朗也时不时地进行针锋相对的打击。

paras.en: On Friday, Iranian media said the U.S. struck one of its islands in the Strait of Hormuz. It's an area where Iran has radars and drone launch sites. Iran's Revolutionary Guard said it hit back, targeting an early warning U.S. radar in Bahrain.
paras.zh: 周五，伊朗媒体称，美国袭击了伊朗位于霍尔木兹海峡的一座岛屿。这是伊朗拥有雷达和无人机发射场的地区。伊朗革命卫队表示进行了反击，目标是位于巴林的美国预警雷达。

paras.en: Iran remains economically battered, starved of oil revenue
paras.zh: 伊朗经济仍遭受重创，石油收入匮乏

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters this week there's no need for military action against Iran at this stage because economic sanctions are doing the job.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥本周对记者表示，现阶段没有必要对伊朗采取军事行动，因为经济制裁正在发挥作用。

paras.en: "The pain that they're feeling is, eventually you have to eat. Eventually you have to be able to pay your own fighters and your own security forces," Rubio said.
paras.zh: “他们感受到的痛苦是，最终你必须吃饭。最终你必须能够支付自己的战士和安全部队的费用，”卢比奥说。

paras.en: There's also a U.S. naval blockade at sea barring Iranian ships from transporting oil to countries like China. This blockade, according to the U.S. military, has cut Iran off from at least $25 billion in revenue so far.
paras.zh: 美国还实施海上封锁，禁止伊朗船只向中国等国家运输石油。据美国军方称，迄今为止，这一封锁已使伊朗失去至少 250 亿美元的收入。

paras.en: One of the biggest economic blows, though, has come from the United Arab Emirates. The UAE announced over the summer it was severing all economic and trade ties with Iran. The UAE had been among Iran's biggest trade partners and local bank accounts were allegedly used by Iran's supreme leader and Revolutionary Guard to move money around.
paras.zh: 不过，最大的经济打击之一来自阿拉伯联合酋长国。阿联酋今年夏天宣布切断与伊朗的所有经济和贸易关系。阿联酋一直是伊朗最大的贸易伙伴之一，据称伊朗最高领导人和革命卫队利用当地银行账户转移资金。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the U.S. military's Central Command announced a new operation, dubbed "Iron Gate", with other U.S. government agencies, aimed at preventing Iran from using land routes to transport advanced weapons across its borders and the Caspian Sea.
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国军方中央司令部宣布与其他美国政府机构联合开展一项名为“铁门”的新行动，旨在阻止伊朗利用陆路运输先进武器穿越其边境和里海。

paras.en: War in Yemen intensifies, draws in more countries
paras.zh: 也门战争愈演愈烈，更多国家卷入其中

paras.en: Another consequence of the conflict with Iran is the resumption of all-out war between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis in Yemen.
paras.zh: 与伊朗冲突的另一个后果是沙特阿拉伯和也门胡塞武装之间恢复全面战争。

paras.en: The Houthis, who are not a direct proxy of Iran but are supported by it, say Saudi airstrikes across Yemen have killed scores of people in past months, including nearly 60 this past weekend, many of them women and children in a village near the capital Sana'a.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装虽然不是伊朗的直接代理人，但得到伊朗的支持，他们表示，过去几个月，沙特对也门的空袭已造成数十人死亡，其中上周末有近 60 人死亡，其中许多是首都萨那附近村庄的妇女和儿童。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia, meanwhile, faces daily missile and drone attacks by Houthis, including some this week that hit its key East-West pipeline carrying crude oil to bypass the Strait of Hormuz. Another Houthi attack hit Saudi oil company Aramco's skyscraper headquarters in Riyadh's financial district.
paras.zh: 与此同时，沙特阿拉伯每天都面临胡塞武装的导弹和无人机袭击，其中包括本周袭击其绕过霍尔木兹海峡输送原油的重要东西向管道的袭击。另一次胡塞武装袭击袭击了沙特石油公司阿美公司位于利雅得金融区的摩天大楼总部。

paras.en: Deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi airports have led to flights and high-profile events being cancelled. https://www.npr.org/2026/11/02/nx-s1-6007693/wars-in-iran-and-yemen-dent-saudi-modernization-mega-projects
paras.zh: 胡塞武装对沙特机场发动致命袭击，导致航班和备受瞩目的活动被取消。 https://www.npr.org/2026/11/02/nx-s1-6007693/wars-in-iran-and-yemen-dent-saudi-modernization-mega-projects

paras.en: As the Yemen war drags on, Pakistan, Turkey and Egypt are among the countries entering the fray with defensive support to Saudi Arabia. The U.S. is assisting with intelligence on the Houthis.
paras.zh: 随着也门战争的拖延，巴基斯坦、土耳其和埃及等国家也加入了这场战争，为沙特阿拉伯提供防御支持。美国正在协助提供有关胡塞武装的情报。

paras.en: The United Nations says some 330,000 Yemenis have been displaced by the renewed fighting between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed Yemeni government, exacerbating an already dire humanitarian crisis.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府之间的新战斗导致约 33 万也门人流离失所，加剧了本已严峻的人道主义危机。

paras.en: Efforts by mediators continue, neither side budges
paras.zh: 调解人继续努力，双方都没有让步

paras.en: Iran says it's prepared for a short-term pause on attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz, but insists that seven demands be met before entering into direct talks over its nuclear program.
paras.zh: 伊朗表示，已准备好短期暂停对霍尔木兹海峡船只的袭击，但坚称在就其核计划进行直接谈判之前必须满足七项要求。

paras.en: "The message has been only one thing. These seven items are on the table. Take it or leave it," Hamidreza Gholamzade, Tehran municipality spokesperson, told NPR.
paras.zh: 德黑兰市政府发言人哈米德雷扎·戈拉姆扎德 (Hamidreza Gholamzade) 告诉美国国家公共广播电台：“传达的信息只有一件事。这七项内容已摆在桌面上。接受或放弃。”

paras.en: These demands include lifting sanctions, ending the naval blockade, unfreezing Iran's dollars in overseas accounts and enforcing a ceasefire across all fronts, which includes halting Israeli attacks in Lebanon and Gaza.
paras.zh: 这些要求包括解除制裁、结束海上封锁、解冻伊朗海外账户中的美元以及在各条战线强制停火，其中包括停止以色列对黎巴嫩和加沙的袭击。

paras.en: Rubio has described the conditions as "absurd".
paras.zh: 卢比奥称这些条件“荒谬”。

paras.en: There's also discussion on diluting and moving Iran's enriched uranium abroad. However, the head of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, Mohsen Rezaei, told Iran's state broadcaster Wednesday: "We will not remove even a shred of enriched nuclear material from Iran."
paras.zh: 还有关于稀释伊朗浓缩铀并将其转移到国外的讨论。然而，伊朗最高国家安全委员会主席穆赫森·雷扎伊周三对伊朗国家广播公司表示：“我们不会从伊朗移走哪怕是一丝浓缩核材料。”

paras.en: It's another indication of the gridlock.
paras.zh: 这是僵局的另一个迹象。

paras.en: NPR's Hadeel al-Shalchi in Antalya, Turkey, and Ahmed Abu Hamada in Cairo contributed reporting.
paras.zh: NPR 土耳其安塔利亚的 Hadeel al-Shalchi 和开罗的 Ahmed Abu Hamada 也参与了报道。

It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳整体信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，信用额度通常越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高利率。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。
