articles.title: Nominations open for WIN Most Influential Women awards
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The Women’s Industry Network (WIN) has opened nominations for its 2027 Most Influential Women (MIW) awards through Jan. 5.
paras.zh: 女性工业网络 (WIN) 已于 1 月 5 日开放 2027 年最具影响力女性 (MIW) 奖提名。

paras.en: WIN MIW recipients are recognized for career achievements and industry influence, according to a WIN press release.
paras.zh: 根据 WIN 新闻稿，WIN MIW 获奖者因职业成就和行业影响力而受到认可。

paras.en: Nominations are open to women working in any segment of the collision repair industry across the U.S. and Canada.
paras.zh: 提名对美国和加拿大碰撞修复行业任何领域工作的女性开放。

paras.en: The class of 2027 MIW award recipients will be recognized at the annual WIN Conference May 3-4, 2027 in Portland, Oregon.
paras.zh: 2027 年 MIW 获奖者类别将于 2027 年 5 月 3 日至 4 日在俄勒冈州波特兰举行的年度 WIN 会议上进行表彰。

paras.en: “Our industry thrives because of the women who go above and beyond, not only in their daily operations but in the way they nurture those around them and champion progress,” said Jenny Anderson, WIN MIW Awards Committee chair, in the release. “Nominations for our 2027 Most Influential Women award provide a vital opportunity to celebrate excellence across every facet of collision repair — from the shop floor to the executive office. By honoring these women, we are not only recognizing their impact but ensuring a vibrant, inclusive future for all who choose to pursue a career in this field.”
paras.zh: WIN MIW 奖委员会主席珍妮·安德森 (Jenny Anderson) 在新闻稿中表示：“我们行业的蓬勃发展得益于女性的不断超越，不仅在日常运营中，而且在她们培养周围人并倡导进步的方式上。” “2027 年最具影响力女性奖的提名提供了一个重要的机会，以庆祝从车间到行政办公室的碰撞修复各个方面的卓越表现。通过向这些女性致敬，我们不仅认识到她们的影响力，而且确保为所有选择在该领域从事职业的人创造一个充满活力、包容的未来。”

paras.en: WIN says it follows established criteria when choosing recipients, including industry influence, professional accomplishments, mentorship, and community service. An independent selection committee reviews the nominations and interviews the nominees. The committee is made up of industry professionals, past MIW recipients, and WIN members who don’t currently serve in leadership.
paras.zh: WIN 表示，在选择获奖者时遵循既定标准，包括行业影响力、专业成就、指导和社区服务。独立评选委员会审查提名并对被提名者进行面试。该委员会由行业专业人士、过去的 MIW 获得者以及目前未担任领导职务的 WIN 成员组成。

paras.en: Since its inception in 1999, the MIW program has recognized over 135 women. WIN acquired stewardship of the MIW program in 2013 and continues to evolve it to align with WIN’s mission of “driving the future of collision repair by attracting, developing and advancing women,” according to the release.
paras.zh: 自 1999 年启动以来，MIW 计划已表彰了超过 135 名女性。 WIN 于 2013 年获得了 MIW 项目的管理权，并继续发展该项目，以符合 WIN 的使命：“通过吸引、培养和提升女性来推动碰撞修复的未来”。

paras.en: The 2026 MIW honorees were Angie Babin, Caliber Collision vice president, OEM partnerships and strategy; Brandi Brydges, ACX (formerly AutoCanada Collision Centres) director of operations; Jeanne Esquivel, Entegral’s North American business development and customer delivery technology leader; and Kena Dacus, Dacus Auto Body & Collision Repair owner.
paras.zh: 2026 年 MIW 获奖者是 Calibre Collision 负责 OEM 合作伙伴关系和战略的副总裁 Angie Babin； Brandi Brydges，ACX（原 AutoCanada 碰撞中心）运营总监； Jeanne Esquivel，Entegral 北美业务开发和客户交付技术负责人；以及 Dacus Auto Body & Collision Repair 所有者 Kena Dacus。

articles.title: Two automakers change security systems two hours after alerted of vulnerability
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Two automakers changed their security systems within hours after a team of hackers notified them of a vulnerability that allowed remote access to unlock and start the automakers’ vehicles.
paras.zh: 在一组黑客通知两家汽车制造商存在允许远程访问解锁和启动汽车制造商车辆的漏洞后，两家汽车制造商在几小时内就更改了安全系统。

paras.en: Shubham Shaw and Sam Curry, white hat hackers, found vulnerabilities on ForgeRock servers that allowed them access to customer logins for two automakers, according to a Nov. 7 post from the hackers. White hat hackers look for vulnerabilities in systems before the weakness can be used for malicious purposes.
paras.zh: 据黑客 11 月 7 日发布的帖子称，白帽黑客 Shubham Shaw 和 Sam Curry 在 ForgeRock 服务器上发现了漏洞，这些漏洞使他们能够访问两家汽车制造商的客户登录信息。白帽黑客会在系统漏洞被用于恶意目的之前寻找系统漏洞。

paras.en: The post doesn’t identify the automakers.
paras.zh: 该帖子没有透露汽车制造商的身份。

paras.en: The affected system served customers in multiple regions, but the hackers say they only tested U.S. accounts and vehicles.
paras.zh: 受影响的系统为多个地区的客户提供服务，但黑客表示他们只测试了美国的账户和车辆。

paras.en: “In the past few years, we’d found ways to remotely control vehicles from Honda, Acura, Nissan, Infiniti, Hyundai, Genesis, Ford, Porsche, Kia, and Subaru, but we’d never found a vulnerability that enabled remote access to either an Automaker #1 or Automaker #2 vehicles,” the post states.
paras.zh: “在过去的几年里，我们找到了远程控制本田、讴歌、日产、英菲尼迪、现代、创世纪、福特、保时捷、起亚和斯巴鲁车辆的方法，但我们从未发现能够远程访问汽车制造商 #1 或汽车制造商 #2 车辆的漏洞，”该帖子指出。

paras.en: Once in the app, the hackers say they could see every vehicle VIN that the owner had in their garage, along with its location, mileage, fuel, battery range, tire pressure, door and window state, vehicle health, alerts, and subscription status.
paras.zh: 黑客表示，一旦进入该应用程序，他们就可以看到车主车库中的每辆车的 VIN，以及其位置、里程、燃油、电池范围、轮胎压力、门窗状态、车辆健康状况、警报和订阅状态。

paras.en: According to the hackers, they first downloaded the Android version of the apps for both automakers and traced their authentication flows back to ForgeRock. The post describes ForgeRock as an identity platform used by both automakers to manage customer accounts and logins.
paras.zh: 据黑客称，他们首先下载了两家汽车制造商的 Android 版本应用程序，并将其身份验证流程追溯到 ForgeRock。这篇文章将 ForgeRock 描述为两家汽车制造商用来管理客户帐户和登录的身份平台。

paras.en: In the post, the hackers identified a series of steps they took to disable and enter the security system. This included replacing credentials and changing a user’s email and password to log in to ForgeRock.
paras.zh: 在帖子中，黑客指出了他们为禁用和进入安全系统而采取的一系列步骤。这包括替换凭据以及更改用户的电子邮件和密码以登录 ForgeRock。

paras.en: “Changing the email address and password did not invalidate the account owner’s existing app session,” the post states. “During our authorized test, the owner’s app remained logged in while our new session worked alongside it.”
paras.zh: 该帖子指出：“更改电子邮件地址和密码不会使帐户所有者现有的应用程序会话失效。” “在我们的授权测试期间，所有者的应用程序保持登录状态，而我们的新会话与之一起工作。”

paras.en: According to the hackers, they dug deeper into the identity stack than they originally expected.
paras.zh: 据黑客称，他们对身份堆栈的挖掘比他们最初预期的更深。

paras.en: “Production identity access extended across the affected directories for both automakers in multiple regions, and we validated the complete account-to-vehicle chain with live US accounts and vehicles,” the post adds.
paras.zh: 帖子补充道：“生产身份访问权限已扩展到多个地区的两家汽车制造商的受影响目录，我们通过真实的美国账户和车辆验证了完整的账户到车辆链。”

paras.en: The hackers accessed the vehicles in early 2026, the post states. The automakers were also notified of the vulnerability via a report provided to their product security teams in early 2026.
paras.zh: 帖子称，黑客于 2026 年初访问了这些车辆。汽车制造商还通过 2026 年初向其产品安全团队提供的报告得知了该漏洞。

paras.en: “Both automakers remediated the vulnerability approximately two hours after receiving the report,” the post states. “The proof bundle was removed, and the affected credentials were rotated.”
paras.zh: 帖子称：“两家汽车制造商在收到报告后大约两小时修复了该漏洞。” “证明包已被删除，受影响的凭证已被轮换。”

paras.en: During a July Collision Industry Conference (CIC) meeting, Andrea Amico, Privacy4Cars founder and CEO, said the average car in the past 10 years has about 250 sensors.
paras.zh: 在 7 月的碰撞行业大会 (CIC) 会议上，Privacy4Cars 创始人兼首席执行官 Andrea Amico 表示，过去 10 年平均每辆汽车拥有约 250 个传感器。

paras.en: “Cars have become the third personal computing device that consumers use every day,” he added.
paras.zh: “汽车已成为消费者每天使用的第三种个人计算设备，”他补充道。

paras.en: However, vehicles typically lack encryption or hidden controls compared to phones or computers, he said.
paras.zh: 然而，与手机或电脑相比，车辆通常缺乏加密或隐藏控制，他说。

paras.en: Vehicles can collect personal data through cameras, microphones, GPS, and synced phones, he said. Data collected by vehicles includes call logs, garage codes, biometrics, contacts, and passwords.
paras.zh: 他说，车辆可以通过摄像头、麦克风、GPS 和同步电话收集个人数据。车辆收集的数据包括通话记录、车库代码、生物识别信息、联系人信息和密码。

paras.en: During a separate CIC presentation, Tracy Dombrowski of Collision Advice provided an example of a woman who sold her vehicle to a dealer without disconnecting it from her app.
paras.zh: 在另一次 CIC 演示中，Collision Advice 的 Tracy Dombrowski 提供了一个例子，一名女士将车辆卖给了经销商，但没有将车辆与应用程序断开连接。

paras.en: “She was able to follow that vehicle from the sale of the vehicle to Florida to Texas,” Dombrowski said. “She is still able to remote start that vehicle; she is still able to access that vehicle at any given time.”
paras.zh: “她能够跟踪这辆车从佛罗里达州到德克萨斯州的销售过程，”多姆布罗夫斯基说。 “她仍然能够远程启动该车辆；她仍然能够在任何给定时间访问该车辆。”

paras.en: The job of data removal typically falls on the consumer, she said. But shops can help consumers as a courtesy.
paras.zh: 她说，数据删除的工作通常由消费者承担。但商店可以出于礼貌向消费者提供帮助。

paras.en: Dombrowski provided OEM webpages that offer resources for removing PPI.
paras.zh: Dombrowski 提供了 OEM 网页，其中提供了用于删除 PPI 的资源。

articles.title: Nasdaq chief economist: Inflation will likely fade and interest rates will lower
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Phil Mackintosh, Nasdaq chief economist and senior vice president, painted a picture of a resilient economy during the annual MSO Symposium held Nov. 2 and shared his predictions for the year ahead, including lower interest rates.
paras.zh: 纳斯达克首席经济学家兼高级副总裁菲尔·麦金托什 (Phil Mackintosh) 在 11 月 2 日举行的年度 MSO 研讨会上描绘了一幅充满活力的经济图景，并分享了他对未来一年的预测，包括降低利率。

paras.en: Mackintosh said the markets have “powered through” three big challenges over the last year: tariffs, the war in Iran, and interest rate changes. There are no recessions in the world, and “growth might be slow, but it’s positive enough to weather the shocks like we’ve been seeing,” he said.
paras.zh: 麦金托什表示，去年市场“克服”了三大挑战：关税、伊朗战争和利率变化。他说，世界上不存在经济衰退，“增长可能会很缓慢，但它足以抵御我们所看到的冲击”。

paras.en: “We’re definitely seeing the economy sort of turn around; things get more positive or less negative depending on which side of the economy you’re on,” Mackintosh said. “And because of that, in the labor market, we are starting to see a little bit of strength. [At] the start of the year, this was meant to be a really good tailwind for the stock market and a really good tailwind for company profits. It turns out the tailwind is still happening. Hiring is starting to pick back up.”
paras.zh: 麦金托什说：“我们肯定会看到经济出现某种程度的好转；情况会变得更加积极还是更加消极，这取决于你站在经济的哪一边。” “正因为如此，在劳动力市场上，我们开始看到一点力量。在今年年初，这对股市来说是一个非常好的顺风，对公司利润来说是一个非常好的顺风。事实证明，这种顺风仍在发生。招聘开始回升。”

paras.en: According to Mackintosh, tariffs didn’t create a big dent in the global economy, and have somewhat stabilized.
paras.zh: 麦金托什表示，关税并未对全球经济造成重大影响，而且已经有所稳定。

paras.en: “Initially there was that huge spike in the average tariff rate. It’s actually been coming down,” he said.
paras.zh: “最初，平均关税大幅上涨。实际上一直在下降，”他说。

paras.en: Interest rates have also generally been coming down.
paras.zh: 利率也普遍下降。

paras.en: “They didn’t affect the economy as much as you think, even though for a lot of companies they definitely created a lot of uncertainty,” he said. “In terms of your industry, whether tariffs have impacted inflation much… the answer is not much at all.”
paras.zh: 他说：“它们对经济的影响并没有你想象的那么大，尽管对于很多公司来说，它们确实造成了很多不确定性。” “就你所在的行业而言，关税对通胀的影响是否很大……答案根本不是很大。”

paras.en: “The general trend in this industry in inflation is you’re on a deflationary trend, and now you’ve become deflationary, so the impact of tariffs from this industry onto the CPI [Consumer Price Index] actually is pretty small,” he said.
paras.zh: “这个行业通胀的总体趋势是处于通缩趋势，现在已经进入通缩状态，所以这个行业的关税对CPI（消费者价格指数）的影响实际上很小，”他说。

paras.en: Effects on the oil market from the Iran War were digested much better than might’ve been expected, according to Mackintosh. He said that despite 20 million barrels a day missing from global supply, and the biggest shock to oil supply caused by wars dating back to the 1950s, the price of oil didn’t go up that much.
paras.zh: 麦金托什表示，伊朗战争对石油市场的影响得到了比预期更好的消化。他表示，尽管全球供应每天减少 2000 万桶，而且自 20 世纪 50 年代以来的战争对石油供应造成了最大的冲击，但石油价格并没有上涨那么多。

paras.en: And that doesn’t seem to be getting better when looking at shipping data, he noted.
paras.zh: 他指出，从运输数据来看，情况似乎并没有好转。

paras.en: “The war is still active from an economic and supply perspective,” Mackintosh said.
paras.zh: “从经济和供应的角度来看，战争仍然活跃，”麦金托什说。

paras.en: As for interest rates, he said they have gone from definitely falling to definitely rising, if you trust the market, and the reason for that is inflation. Mackintosh said interest rates are now hiking quickly because the Federal Reserve waited so long for transitory oil-driven inflation to go away.
paras.zh: 至于利率，他表示，如果你相信市场的话，利率已经从肯定下降变成肯定上升，原因就是通货膨胀。麦金托什表示，利率现在正在迅速上涨，因为美联储等待石油驱动的暂时性通胀消失太久了。

paras.en: “The Fed is not sitting there going, ‘Well, oil prices could easily come down to $70 or $60 if we resolve the war and the supply chain fixes,'” he said. “Instead, the Fed is trying to slow the economy down just in case.”
paras.zh: “美联储不会坐在那里说，‘好吧，如果我们解决战争并修复供应链，油价可能会轻松降至 70 美元或 60 美元，’”他表示。 “相反，美联储正试图放慢经济增长以防万一。”

paras.en: And long-term borrowing is starting to cost consumers and companies money, he said. Several developed countries, in addition to the U.S., have seen long-term interest rates increase.
paras.zh: 他说，长期借贷开始让消费者和公司付出代价。除美国外，一些发达国家的长期利率也有所上升。

paras.en: “If interest rates and debt both go up, they both add to the amount of costs that we’re all going to have to pay out of our tax receipts or tax bills, so you can see net interest costs becomes bigger and bigger as a problem,” Mackintosh said.
paras.zh: 麦金托什说：“如果利率和债务都上升，它们都会增加我们所有人必须从税收收入或税单中支付的成本，因此你可以看到净利息成本变得越来越大。”

paras.en: He noted that households are trying to stretch how long they’ll own a car, increasing the number of months on a new car loan.
paras.zh: 他指出，家庭正试图延长拥有汽车的期限，增加新车贷款的月数。

paras.en: “It’s going up and up and up as people try to buy a car that’s going to last longer than the usual cycle,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“随着人们试图购买比平常周期更长的汽车，价格就会不断上涨。”

paras.en: Mackintosh called himself a contrarian for his prediction that interest rates will be lower in 12 months. He said worsening Middle East conflict causing real supply shock would be the only reason his prediction would be wrong.
paras.zh: 麦金托什称自己是逆向投资者，因为他预测利率将在 12 个月内下降。他表示，中东冲突恶化导致真正的供应冲击将是他的预测错误的唯一原因。

paras.en: “I actually think we’re more likely to see inflation fade,” he said. “If the conflict in Iran doesn’t get worse, then the oil price won’t keep going up, which means it stops being inflationary. Imagine if it goes away and the oil price comes down, then you get deflation from oil, and all of a sudden we could be talking about 2% inflation pretty quickly.”
paras.zh: “我实际上认为我们更有可能看到通胀消退，”他说。 “如果伊朗的冲突不再恶化，那么油价就不会继续上涨，这意味着通胀不再存在。想象一下，如果它消失并且油价下跌，那么石油就会出现通货紧缩，突然间我们可能很快就会谈论2%的通胀。”

paras.en: Another deflationary factor is the aging population against a shrinking workforce.
paras.zh: 另一个通货紧缩因素是人口老龄化和劳动力萎缩。

paras.en: “There’s more people retired than there are with babies needing new houses and new cars and more clothes, so the demand kind of comes out of the economy,” Mackintosh said. “Interest rates don’t need to be very high in an economy where the population is shrinking.”
paras.zh: 麦金托什说：“退休的人比需要新房子、新车和更多衣服的婴儿还要多，因此需求来自于经济。” “在人口萎缩的经济体中，利率不需要很高。”

paras.en: Much more risk would be in play if the heat came out of the economy naturally and inflation decreased on its own, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，如果经济的热度自然消失并且通胀自行下降，那么风险将会大得多。

paras.en: Mackintosh said layoffs near historic lows are one facet that has helped the economy. Meanwhile, hiring has softened.
paras.zh: 麦金托什表示，接近历史低点的裁员是帮助经济的一方面。与此同时，招聘活动有所放缓。

paras.en: “We have what we’re calling a ‘no hire, no fire’ market, so everyone feels pretty secure, but the job creation slowed down quite a lot,” he said. “People that are unemployed and staying unemployed is starting to fall, so that’s good news as well. People are actually getting into work slowly rather than seeing people lose jobs.”
paras.zh: “我们有所谓的‘不雇佣、不解雇’市场，所以每个人都感觉很安全，但就业机会的创造速度却大大放缓，”他说。 “失业和持续失业的人数开始下降，所以这也是个好消息。人们实际上正在慢慢开始工作，而不是看到人们失业。”

paras.en: Tariffs, he added, are basically done, and the price increases they caused are last year’s story. Mackintosh predicts tariff increases won’t show in the CPI in a couple more months.
paras.zh: 他补充说，关税已经基本完成，关税导致的价格上涨已经是去年的事了。麦金托什预测，关税上涨在几个月后不会体现在消费者物价指数中。

paras.en: Mackintosh also covered the AI boom and its effect on the national and global economies. He predicts that AI could become deflationary if it makes us more productive.
paras.zh: 麦金托什还介绍了人工智能的繁荣及其对国家和全球经济的影响。他预测，如果人工智能能够提高我们的生产力，那么它可能会导致通货紧缩。

paras.en: According to his data, Mackintosh said AI capital expenditures are a large proportion of what’s currently driving the U.S. gross domestic product (GDP).
paras.zh: 根据他的数据，麦金托什表示，人工智能资本支出在目前推动美国国内生产总值（GDP）的动力中占据很大一部分。

paras.en: “The stock market basically reacted to AI this year rather than to the economy,” he said. “AI as a sector is contributing more and more to that growth in GDP, and so it’s become a really important economic factor to the market and the economy as a whole.
paras.zh: “今年股市基本上是对人工智能做出反应，而不是对经济做出反应，”他说。 “人工智能作为一个部门对 GDP 增长的贡献越来越大，因此它已成为市场和整个经济的一个非常重要的经济因素。

paras.en: Chip demand will be much higher than ever because of the high demand for data centers, along with a phenomenal demand for electricity, Mackintosh added.
paras.zh: 麦金托什补充说，由于对数据中心的高需求以及对电力的巨大需求，芯片需求将比以往任何时候都高得多。

paras.en: For example, he said that the Meta data center being built in Louisiana needs about 30% of the electricity the state currently produces.
paras.zh: 例如，他表示，路易斯安那州正在建设的Meta数据中心需要该州目前生产的约30%的电力。

paras.en: “This is why it’s driving the economy too, though,” he said, adding that with AI there are “a lot of known unknowns.”
paras.zh: 他说：“这就是为什么它也能推动经济发展。”他补充说，人工智能存在“许多已知的未知因素”。

paras.en: “We are still building AI; we’re still making it work in products,” he said. “We’re still trying to work out what it really can deliver. On the positive side, you’ve got the growth in token volumes or the growth in actual AI queries. It just keeps going up. …the revenues have started to plateau.
paras.zh: “我们仍在构建人工智能；我们仍在使其在产品中发挥作用，”他说。 “我们仍在努力弄清楚它真正能提供什么。从积极的一面来看，代币数量的增长或实际人工智能查询的增长。它只是不断上升……收入已经开始趋于稳定。

paras.en: “I think from an economic perspective, there’s plenty of reasons to say that it’s worth all of us doing this. And the reason I say that is if you look at the internet boom, there was a heap of CapEx, almost the same kind of scale of CapEx to the GDP in the ’90s when we were building out the internet. All the connectivity they created, the fact that we can have CarPlay in our cars and GPS, all that cool stuff is because of the internet.”
paras.zh: “我认为从经济角度来看，有很多理由说我们所有人都值得这样做。我这么说的原因是，如果你看看互联网的繁荣，就会发现大量的资本支出，几乎与 90 年代我们建设互联网时的资本支出与 GDP 的规模相同。他们创造的所有连接，我们可以在汽车中安装 CarPlay 和 GPS，所有这些很酷的东西都是因为互联网。”

paras.en: He predicts the companies that will benefit from AI might be building products we haven’t imagined.
paras.zh: 他预测，将从人工智能中受益的公司可能会开发出我们未曾想象过的产品。

paras.en: Featured image: Phil Mackintosh, Nasdaq chief economist and senior vice president, speaks during the 2026 MSO Symposium on Nov. 2. (Lurah Lowery/Repairer Driven News)
paras.zh: 特色图片：纳斯达克首席经济学家兼高级副总裁 Phil Mackintosh 在 11 月 2 日举行的 2026 年 MSO 研讨会上发表讲话。（Lurah Lowery/Repairer Driven News）

articles.title: Milwaukee Tool Named Be Pro Be Proud Tool Partner
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Be Pro Be Proud has named Milwaukee Tool its exclusive National Tool Partner, bringing professional-grade tools and technology into interactive career exploration experiences designed to introduce students across the country to opportunities in the skilled trades.
paras.zh: Be Pro Be Proud 已将 Milwaukee Tool 指定为其独家国家工具合作伙伴，将专业级工具和技术带入交互式职业探索体验中，旨在向全国各地的学生介绍技能行业的机会。

paras.en: Proud’s Mobile Workshops, virtual reality (VR) simulators and student recognition events. Students will gain exposure to the tools and technology used in skilled trades careers, including carpentry, electrical work, heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), plumbing, water technology and diesel technology.
paras.zh: Proud 的移动研讨会、虚拟现实 (VR) 模拟器和学生表彰活动。学生将接触到技能职业中使用的工具和技术，包括木工、电气工作、供暖、通风和空调 (HVAC)、管道、水技术和柴油技术。

paras.en: “A career feels real when a student can picture themselves doing the work,” said Andrew Parker, executive director of Be Pro Be Proud. “With Milwaukee Tool, we’re integrating industry-leading equipment into our Mobile Workshops, making career exploration more tangible and engaging while helping students envision a future in a high-demand technical profession.”
paras.zh: Be Pro Be Proud 的执行董事安德鲁·帕克 (Andrew Parker) 表示：“当学生能够想象自己正在从事这项工作时，就会感觉自己的职业生涯是真实的。” “通过 Milwaukee Tool，我们将行业领先的设备集成到我们的移动研讨会中，使职业探索更加切实、更具吸引力，同时帮助学生畅想高需求技术职业的未来。”

paras.en: The investment will help enhance Be Pro Be Proud’s VR simulators, aligning the virtual tools students use with actual Milwaukee Tool products across six career modules. Milwaukee Tool equipment will also be integrated into Mobile Workshop experiences, including the National Mobile Workshop scheduled to launch in 2027.
paras.zh: 这项投资将有助于增强 Be Pro Be Proud 的 VR 模拟器，使学生使用的虚拟工具与六个职业模块中的实际 Milwaukee Tool 产品保持一致。 Milwaukee Tool 设备还将集成到移动研讨会体验中，包括计划于 2027 年推出的国家移动研讨会。

paras.en: The partnership will also extend to student recognition events, including Signing Days and Draft Days, where selected students will receive Milwaukee Tool products as they take the next steps toward careers in the skilled trades.
paras.zh: 该合作伙伴关系还将扩展到学生表彰活动，包括签约日和选秀日，选定的学生将在他们迈向技术行业职业生涯的下一步时获得 Milwaukee Tool 产品。

paras.en: “The future of our industry depends on inspiring more young people to see what’s possible in the skilled trades,” said Scott Teson, senior vice president of Jobsite Solutions for Milwaukee Tool. “Milwaukee has built our business around understanding the people who work in these professions and developing solutions that help them succeed. Through Be Pro Be Proud, we’re helping students experience that innovation firsthand and discover rewarding career paths they may never have considered.”
paras.zh: 密尔沃基工具工作现场解决方案高级副总裁斯科特·特森 (Scott Teson) 表示：“我们行业的未来取决于激励更多年轻人看到技术行业的可能性。” “密尔沃基的业务围绕了解这些行业的从业人员并开发帮助他们取得成功的解决方案而建立。通过 Be Pro Be Proud，我们正在帮助学生亲身体验这种创新，并发现他们可能从未考虑过的有价值的职业道路。”

paras.en: The partnership builds on Milwaukee Tool’s broader commitment to strengthening America’s skilled trades workforce. The company expects to invest $200 million in U.S. skilled trades workforce development by 2030, supporting initiatives that introduce young people to the trades and help equip the next generation of skilled professionals.
paras.zh: 此次合作建立在 Milwaukee Tool 对加强美国熟练技工劳动力的更广泛承诺的基础上。该公司预计到 2030 年将投资 2 亿美元用于美国技术行业劳动力发展，支持向年轻人介绍该行业并帮助培养下一代技术专业人士的举措。

paras.en: Since launching in 2016, Be Pro Be Proud has reached more than 600,000 students nationally through its Mobile Workshops, which introduce students to technical careers across construction, manufacturing, transportation, and utilities.
paras.zh: 自 2016 年推出以来，Be Pro Be Proud 已通过其移动研讨会吸引了全国超过 600,000 名学生，向学生介绍建筑、制造、运输和公用事业领域的技术职业。

paras.en: For more information on Be Pro Be Proud, visit beprobeproud.org.
paras.zh: 有关 Be Pro Be Proud 的更多信息，请访问 beprobeproud.org。

articles.title: Are You Following Proper Tire Mounting Procedures?
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Proper tire mounting procedures can help prevent vibration, air loss, bead damage and damaged TPMS sensors. Technicians must understand their equipment, use approved lubrication and know where to apply pressure during mounting and demounting.
paras.zh: 正确的轮胎安装程序有助于防止振动、空气流失、胎圈损坏和 TPMS 传感器损坏。技术人员必须了解他们的设备，使用经批准的润滑，并知道在安装和拆卸过程中在哪里施加压力。

paras.en: Rim clamp and pedestal tire changers require different mounting and demounting techniques. Technicians should follow the procedures specified for their equipment.
paras.zh: 轮辋夹具和底座轮胎拆装机需要不同的安装和拆卸技术。技术人员应遵循为其设备指定的程序。

paras.en: When breaking the bead away from the wheel, technicians should begin 90 or 180 degrees away from the valve stem or TPMS sensor. Applying pressure directly at the valve stem or sensor can cause damage and lead to an avoidable comeback.
paras.zh: 将胎圈从轮辋上撬开时，技术人员应从距气门嘴或TPMS传感器90度或180度的位置开始。直接对气门嘴或传感器施加压力可能会造成损坏，并导致本可避免的返修。

paras.en: Proper lubrication is also important. Technicians should apply an approved mounting lubricant to the tire bead to help it move smoothly along the wheel barrel. Insufficient lubrication is a common cause of bead damage during mounting and demounting.
paras.zh: 适当的润滑也很重要。技术人员应在轮胎胎圈上涂抹经批准的安装润滑剂，以帮助其沿着轮筒平稳移动。润滑不足是安装和拆卸过程中珠圈损坏的常见原因。

paras.en: The tire bead contains a metal band inside the tire’s inner lip. It creates the seal between the tire and wheel, allowing the assembly to hold air. Stretching, tearing or damaging this area can prevent the tire from sealing properly.
paras.zh: 轮胎胎圈在轮胎内唇内包含金属带。它在轮胎和车轮之间形成密封，使组件能够保持空气。拉伸、撕裂或损坏该区域会导致轮胎无法正常密封。

paras.en: Tire Mounting Procedures for Bead Seating and Inspection
paras.zh: 胎圈座和检查的轮胎安装程序

paras.en: After the bead seats, technicians should fully deflate the tire before reinflating it to operating pressure. This allows the bead to settle evenly on the wheel and helps ensure proper tire centering.
paras.zh: 胎圈固定后，技术人员应先将轮胎完全放气，然后再将其重新充气至工作压力。这使得胎圈能够均匀地落在车轮上，并有助于确保轮胎正确居中。

paras.en: Before mounting, technicians should clean the wheel surfaces and inspect the tire bead for existing damage. Driving while underinflated, rubbing curbs and hitting off-road obstacles can damage the bead before the vehicle reaches the shop.
paras.zh: 安装前，技术人员应清洁车轮表面并检查轮胎胎圈是否存在损坏。在车辆到达商店之前，在充气不足的情况下驾驶、摩擦路缘石和撞上越野障碍物可能会损坏胎圈。

paras.en: Proper tire mounting requires technicians to follow equipment-specific procedures, protect TPMS sensors, apply sufficient approved lubricant and control inflation pressure. These steps help prevent tire damage and mounting-related problems.
paras.zh: 正确的轮胎安装需要技术人员遵循设备特定程序、保护 TPMS 传感器、使用足够的经认可的润滑剂并控制充气压力。这些步骤有助于防止轮胎损坏和安装相关问题。

articles.title: NHTSA Moves to Modernize Tire Testing Standards
articles.author: David Sickels

paras.en: The federal government is preparing to reconsider how tires are tested for safety, including laboratory procedures developed when passenger vehicles commonly rode on tall, bias-ply tires. Some of those testing methods remain part of federal regulations governing today’s low-profile radials, while emerging technologies such as airless tires present entirely different regulatory questions.
paras.zh: 联邦政府正准备重新考虑如何测试轮胎的安全性，包括在乘用车通常使用高斜交轮胎时制定的实验室程序。其中一些测试方法仍然是管理当今低断面子午线的联邦法规的一部分，而无气轮胎等新兴技术则提出了完全不同的监管问题。

paras.en: On October 26, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) announced plans to modernize federal tire safety standards, potentially launching the most significant overhaul of the regulations in more than two decades.
paras.zh: 10 月 26 日，美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 宣布了联邦轮胎安全标准现代化计划，可能会启动二十多年来最重大的法规改革。

paras.en: The agency is targeting tire strength, bead unseating resistance and endurance testing, along with tire sidewall markings, airless technology and load classifications for light-truck tires.
paras.zh: 该机构的目标是轮胎强度、胎圈脱座阻力和耐久性测试，以及轮胎侧壁标记、无气技术和轻型卡车轮胎的负载分类。

paras.en: However, the agency isn’t proposing replacement requirements just yet. Instead, NHTSA plans to establish an advisory committee of up to 18 industry stakeholders and technical experts to develop recommendations for future rulemaking.
paras.zh: 然而，该机构尚未提出更换要求。相反，NHTSA 计划成立一个由最多 18 名行业利益相关者和技术专家组成的咨询委员会，为未来的规则制定提出建议。

paras.en: “As American tire technology and vehicle design continue to evolve, our regulatory framework must keep pace,” said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison.
paras.zh: “随着美国轮胎技术和车辆设计的不断发展，我们的监管框架必须跟上步伐，”国家公路交通安全管理局局长乔纳森·莫里森说。

paras.en: The agency says modernized standards could improve safety while reducing regulatory costs. Whether those changes ultimately expand tire availability, alter testing requirements or affect the information technicians rely on will depend on the regulations that emerge from the process.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，现代化标准可以提高安全性，同时降低监管成本。这些变化是否最终会扩大轮胎的可用性、改变测试要求或影响技术人员所依赖的信息，将取决于该过程中出现的法规。

paras.en: Why Federal Tire Safety Standards Are Under Review
paras.zh: 为什么联邦轮胎安全标准正在接受审查

paras.en: The push to modernize federal tire safety standards has been building for years.
paras.zh: 联邦轮胎安全标准现代化的努力已经持续多年。

paras.en: The original federal tire safety regulations date to 1967, when bias-ply construction dominated the passenger tire market. Federal requirements subsequently evolved, most notably after Congress passed the Transportation Recall Enhancement, Accountability, and Documentation (TREAD) Act in 2000.
paras.zh: 最初的联邦轮胎安全法规可以追溯到 1967 年，当时斜交帘布层结构在乘用车轮胎市场占据主导地位。联邦要求随后发生变化，尤其是在国会于 2000 年通过《运输召回增强、责任和记录 (TREAD) 法案》之后。

paras.en: In 2003, NHTSA established Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) No. 139, introducing more stringent high-speed and endurance testing, as well as low-inflation performance requirements for radial tires used on light vehicles.
paras.zh: 2003年，NHTSA制定了联邦机动车辆安全标准（FMVSS）第139号，引入了更严格的高速和耐久性测试，以及对轻型车辆使用的子午线轮胎的低充气性能要求。

paras.en: As we reported at the time, the standard significantly expanded federal testing requirements, including coverage of P-metric and LT-metric radial tires. Its implementation concluded in 2007.
paras.zh: 正如我们当时报道的那样，该标准显着扩大了联邦测试要求，包括 P 公制和 LT 公制子午线轮胎的覆盖范围。其实施于 2007 年结束。

paras.en: Still, some existing tests retained methods developed decades earlier. NHTSA revisited those procedures in a December 2019 regulatory review, asking whether they remained appropriate for modern tires.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，一些现有的测试仍然保留了几十年前开发的方法。 NHTSA 在 2019 年 12 月的监管审查中重新审视了这些程序，询问它们是否仍然适合现代轮胎。

paras.en: One example is the tire strength test, also known as the plunger energy test.
paras.zh: 一个例子是轮胎强度测试，也称为柱塞能量测试。

paras.en: The procedure presses a steel plunger into a mounted tire’s tread to evaluate its ability to withstand a specified energy level. But modern radial construction and lower-profile designs can complicate that measurement. NHTSA previously observed that the plunger sometimes reaches the wheel before the tire achieves the required test energy, particularly on low-profile tires.
paras.zh: 该程序将钢柱塞压入已安装轮胎的胎面中，以评估其承受指定能量水平的能力。但现代的径向结构和低调设计会使测量变得复杂。 NHTSA 此前观察到，柱塞有时会在轮胎达到所需的测试能量之前到达车轮，特别是在低断面轮胎上。

paras.en: That raises questions about how effectively the procedure measures the intended performance characteristic across today’s tire designs.
paras.zh: 这就提出了这样的问题：该程序如何有效地衡量当今轮胎设计的预期性能特征。

paras.en: NHTSA also wants to reconsider bead unseating resistance testing, which measures the force required to dislodge a tire bead from the rim, and portions of the endurance test involving tread or sidewall chunking.
paras.zh: NHTSA 还希望重新考虑胎圈脱位阻力测试，该测试测量将轮胎胎圈从轮辋上移开所需的力，以及涉及胎面或侧壁碎块的耐久性测试部分。

paras.en: The agency has previously examined alternatives to existing strength and bead unseating tests but deferred changes pending additional research.
paras.zh: 该机构此前曾研究过现有强度和胎圈脱座测试的替代方案，但推迟了更改以等待进一步的研究。

paras.en: The October 27, 2026, Federal Register notice brings those longstanding issues back into formal consideration.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 27 日的《联邦公报》通知将这些长期存在的问题重新纳入正式考虑。

paras.en: Tire Manufacturers Welcome the Proposed Changes
paras.zh: 轮胎制造商欢迎拟议的变更

paras.en: The U.S. Tire Manufacturers Association (USTMA) strongly endorsed NHTSA’s announcement.
paras.zh: 美国轮胎制造商协会 (USTMA) 强烈支持 NHTSA 的声明。

paras.en: “Outdated tire testing standards designed for the tires of the 1960s tell us nothing about whether today’s tires are safe,” said USTMA President and CEO Anne Forristall Luke in an October 26 statement.
paras.zh: USTMA 总裁兼首席执行官 Anne Forristall Luke 在 10 月 26 日的一份声明中表示：“针对 20 世纪 60 年代轮胎设计的过时轮胎测试标准无法告诉我们当今轮胎是否安全。”

paras.en: The association argues that some existing requirements prevent American drivers from accessing newer tire technologies already available in other markets.
paras.zh: 该协会认为，一些现有的要求阻止美国司机获得其他市场已有的更新的轮胎技术。

paras.en: USTMA has previously urged regulators to reconsider testing methods that manufacturers contend provide limited safety benefits relative to their compliance burdens.
paras.zh: USTMA 此前曾敦促监管机构重新考虑制造商认为相对于其合规负担而言提供有限安全效益的测试方法。

paras.en: The distinction between maintaining meaningful performance requirements and eliminating outdated testing procedures will be central to the committee’s work. NHTSA must determine whether alternative methods can demonstrate appropriate safety performance while accommodating advances in tire construction.
paras.zh: 维持有意义的性能要求和消除过时的测试程序之间的区别将是委员会工作的核心。 NHTSA 必须确定替代方法是否能够证明适当的安全性能，同时适应轮胎构造的进步。

paras.en: The committee’s proposed agenda extends beyond traditional testing procedures.
paras.zh: 该委员会提议的议程超出了传统的测试程序。

paras.en: One significant area involves non-pneumatic, or airless, tires. Unlike conventional designs, these tires do not depend on internal air pressure to support vehicle loads, creating challenges for regulations built around inflation pressure and pneumatic tire construction.
paras.zh: 一个重要领域涉及非充气或无气轮胎。与传统设计不同，这些轮胎不依赖内部气压来支持车辆负载，这给围绕充气压力和充气轮胎结构制定的法规带来了挑战。

paras.en: The issue is particularly relevant as manufacturers continue developing airless tires for potential use on passenger vehicles.
paras.zh: 随着制造商继续开发可用于乘用车的无气轮胎，这个问题尤为重要。

paras.en: In a 2024 Tire Review interview, Michelin scientific and innovation communication director Cyrille Roget discussed the company’s Uptis airless tire prototype and its testing program.
paras.zh: 在 2024 年轮胎评论采访中，米其林科学与创新传播总监 Cyrille Roget 讨论了该公司的 Uptis 无气轮胎原型及其测试计划。

paras.en: Michelin had accumulated more than 2 million miles of testing at the time and was conducting pilot programs involving commercial delivery vehicles in Singapore and France.
paras.zh: 米其林当时已累积超过 200 万英里的测试，并正在新加坡和法国开展涉及商业运输车辆的试点项目。

paras.en: Roget emphasized that Uptis remained a prototype at that point, with regulatory authorization necessary before wider on-road use.
paras.zh: Roget 强调，Uptis 当时仍处于原型阶段，在更广泛的道路使用之前需要获得监管授权。

paras.en: NHTSA’s current initiative could help establish how technologies such as Uptis would be evaluated under future federal tire safety requirements. The agency has not yet outlined specific new testing procedures for non-pneumatic tires.
paras.zh: NHTSA 目前的举措可以帮助确定如何根据未来的联邦轮胎安全要求评估 Uptis 等技术。该机构尚未概述非充气轮胎的具体新测试程序。

paras.en: Another important issue involves Load Range F light-truck tires.
paras.zh: 另一个重要问题涉及负载范围 F 轻型卡车轮胎。

paras.en: According to the Federal Register notice, the committee will consider a petition from the Tire and Rim Association to include Load Range F light-truck tires within FMVSS No. 139.
paras.zh: 根据《联邦公报》通知，委员会将考虑轮胎和轮辋协会的请愿书，将负载范围 F 轻型卡车轮胎纳入 FMVSS 第 139 号法规中。

paras.en: The proposed review could clarify how these higher-load-capacity tires fit within federal performance requirements as light-truck applications continue to evolve.
paras.zh: 随着轻型卡车应用的不断发展，拟议的审查可以阐明这些更高负载能力的轮胎如何满足联邦性能要求。

paras.en: The agency has also identified inconsistencies involving inflation-pressure classifications.
paras.zh: 该机构还发现了通胀压力分类方面的不一致之处。

paras.en: In an August 2024 interpretation, NHTSA addressed questions from Goodyear about labeling Extra Load passenger tires with a maximum inflation pressure of 350 kPa, approximately 51 psi, and determining which strength-testing provisions applied.
paras.zh: 在 2024 年 8 月的解释中，NHTSA 解决了固特异提出的有关给超载乘用车轮胎贴上最大充气压力 350 kPa（约 51 psi）的标签，并确定适用哪些强度测试规定的问题。

paras.en: NHTSA concluded that federal standards did not prohibit the proposed labeling and explained how the relevant test pressures would be determined.
paras.zh: NHTSA 得出的结论是，联邦标准并未禁止拟议的标签，并解释了如何确定相关测试压力。

paras.en: The exchange illustrates the technical questions manufacturers encounter when applying established regulations to newer tire specifications.
paras.zh: 此次交流说明了制造商在将既定法规应用于新轮胎规格时遇到的技术问题。

paras.en: What Tire Sidewall Changes Could Mean for Dealers
paras.zh: 轮胎侧壁的变化对经销商意味着什么

paras.en: Modernizing tire markings could have particularly direct implications for tire service operations.
paras.zh: 轮胎标记的现代化可能对轮胎服务运营产生特别直接的影响。

paras.en: Sidewall information identifies construction characteristics, load capacity, inflation limits and other specifications technicians use when selecting, mounting, inflating and repairing tires.
paras.zh: 胎侧信息可识别结构特征、负载能力、充气限制以及技术人员在选择、安装、充气和修理轮胎时使用的其他规格。

paras.en: The Tire Industry Association (TIA) has previously cautioned NHTSA against eliminating certain required markings.
paras.zh: 轮胎工业协会 (TIA) 此前曾警告 NHTSA 不要取消某些必需的标记。

paras.en: As we reported in February 2020, TIA argued that removing ply-construction information from passenger and light-truck tire sidewalls could create safety concerns for technicians and motorists.
paras.zh: 正如我们在 2020 年 2 月报道的那样，TIA 认为，从乘用车和轻型卡车轮胎侧壁上删除帘布层结构信息可能会给技术人员和驾驶员带来安全隐患。

paras.en: The association specifically emphasized the importance of identifying steel versus fabric sidewall plies when determining appropriate inflation procedures. It also supported retaining tubeless and tube-type markings to help prevent improper repairs.
paras.zh: 该协会特别强调了在确定适当的充气程序时区分钢质胎侧层和织物胎侧层的重要性。它还支持保留真空胎和内胎型标记，以帮助防止不当维修。

paras.en: TIA took a different position on the word radial, arguing that the existing tire size designation already communicates radial construction through the letter R.
paras.zh: TIA 对“子午线”一词采取了不同的立场，认为现有的轮胎尺寸名称已经通过字母 R 传达了子午线结构。

paras.en: Those comments concerned NHTSA’s earlier regulatory review and should not be interpreted as a new TIA response to the 2026 announcement.
paras.zh: 这些评论涉及 NHTSA 之前的监管审查，不应被解释为 TIA 对 2026 年公告的新回应。

paras.en: NHTSA’s latest notice identifies tire markings as a topic for the advisory committee, although the agency plans a separate rulemaking to address specific requirements involving ply information, radial and tubeless markings, and certain inflation-pressure classifications.
paras.zh: NHTSA 的最新通知将轮胎标记确定为咨询委员会的一个主题，尽管该机构计划制定单独的规则来解决涉及帘布层信息、子午线和无内胎标记以及某些充气压力分类的具体要求。

paras.en: For tire dealers, those distinctions are important. Changes that simplify manufacturer compliance must also account for the construction and identification information used during everyday tire service.
paras.zh: 对于轮胎经销商来说，这些区别很重要。简化制造商合规性的变化还必须考虑日常轮胎维修过程中使用的构造和识别信息。

paras.en: What Happens Next for Federal Tire Safety Standards
paras.zh: 联邦轮胎安全标准接下来会发生什么

paras.en: NHTSA plans to use a negotiated rulemaking process, bringing representatives of affected industries and technical organizations together to seek consensus before developing a formal regulatory proposal.
paras.zh: NHTSA 计划采用协商的规则制定流程，将受影响行业和技术组织的代表聚集在一起，在制定正式的监管提案之前寻求共识。

paras.en: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy will appoint up to 18 committee members. The proposed composition includes four representatives from tire manufacturers or retailers, two from vehicle manufacturers, and additional members from manufacturing associations, safety organizations, research institutions and engineering or standards organizations.
paras.zh: 美国交通部长 Sean Duffy 将任命最多 18 名委员会成员。拟议的组成包括四名来自轮胎制造商或零售商的代表，两名来自汽车制造商，以及来自制造协会、安全组织、研究机构和工程或标准组织的其他成员。

paras.en: NHTSA expects the committee to meet approximately four times annually and develop recommendations within its charter period, which can extend up to two years unless renewed.
paras.zh: NHTSA 预计该委员会每年召开约四次会议，并在其章程期限内提出建议，除非续订，章程期限可延长至两年。

paras.en: Once the committee completes its work and the recommendations receive the necessary approvals, NHTSA intends to publish a notice of proposed rulemaking for public comment.
paras.zh: 一旦委员会完成工作并且建议获得必要的批准，国家公路交通安全管理局打算发布拟议规则制定通知以征求公众意见。

paras.en: No new tire testing or labeling requirements have taken effect as a result of the October announcement. Existing federal standards remain in force.
paras.zh: 10 月份的公告并未导致新的轮胎测试或标签要求生效。现有的联邦标准仍然有效。

paras.en: NHTSA is accepting comments on the committee’s scope and proposed membership under Docket No. NHTSA-2026-1717 at Regulations.gov. The deadline for comments is November 27, 2026. Membership nominations must also be received by 5 p.m. Eastern on that date and may be submitted to [email protected].
paras.zh: NHTSA 正在接受有关委员会范围和拟议成员的意见，其案卷编号为 NHTSA-2026-1717，网址为Regulations.gov。意见征询截止日期为 2026 年 11 月 27 日。会员提名也必须在下午 5 点之前收到。东部日期该日期并可提交至 [email protected]。

articles.title: XL Parts, The Parts House Expands VIP Event Series
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: XL Parts and The Parts House recently concluded its 2026 VIP Event Series with expanded programming across Houston, Dallas and Orlando.
paras.zh: XL Parts 和 The Parts House 最近结束了 2026 年 VIP 活动系列，并在休斯顿、达拉斯和奥兰多扩大了活动范围。

paras.en: “This year’s VIP Event Series represents a significant step forward in how we engage with our team, our vendor partners, and our customers,” said President and CEO Vikrant Aggarwal. “We have had the opportunity to create meaningful opportunities to align on strategic growth, strengthen industry relationships, and express our deep appreciation for the partners who drive our business forward.”
paras.zh: 总裁兼首席执行官维克兰特·阿加瓦尔 (Vikrant Aggarwal) 表示：“今年的 VIP 活动系列代表着我们在与团队、供应商合作伙伴和客户互动方面向前迈出了重要一步。” “我们有机会创造有意义的机会，以协调战略增长，加强行业关系，并向推动我们业务发展的合作伙伴表示深深的谢意。”

paras.en: This year’s events introduced an upgraded two-day experience in both Houston and Orlando. The new structure provided dedicated time for internal strategy sessions, vendor showcases, formal awards ceremonies for employee-of-the-year honorees and supplier partners and customer-focused trade shows and appreciation dinners.
paras.zh: 今年的活动在休斯顿和奥兰多推出了升级的两天体验。新的结构为内部战略会议、供应商展示、年度最佳员工获奖者和供应商合作伙伴的正式颁奖典礼以及以客户为中心的贸易展览和答谢晚宴提供了专门的时间。

paras.en: The series debuted Sept. 17-18 at The Woodlands Resort in Houston, TX, where XL Parts team members, vendor partners, and customers gathered for comprehensive product training, business development and vendor recognition.
paras.zh: 该系列于 9 月 17 日至 18 日在德克萨斯州休斯顿的 Woodlands Resort 首次亮相，XL Parts 团队成员、供应商合作伙伴和客户齐聚一堂，进行全面的产品培训、业务开发和供应商认可。

paras.en: It continued at The Shop Club in Dallas, TX, on September 24, where XL Parts says local shop owners and industry partners connected with suppliers over interactive exhibition booths, live entertainment, and multiple prizes.
paras.zh: 9 月 24 日，活动在德克萨斯州达拉斯市的 The Shop Club 继续进行，XL Parts 表示，当地店主和行业合作伙伴通过互动展位、现场娱乐表演和多种奖品与供应商建立了联系。

paras.en: The VIP event line-up concluded Oct. 1–2 at the Gaylord Palms Resort in Orlando, FL, where The Parts House (TPH) honored VIP customers and supplier partners through targeted product training, networking, and evening celebrations.
paras.zh: VIP 活动系列于 10 月 1 日至 2 日在佛罗里达州奥兰多盖洛德棕榈度假村结束，The Parts House (TPH) 通过有针对性的产品培训、社交和晚间庆祝活动向 VIP 客户和供应商合作伙伴致敬。

articles.title: Replacing an Oil Filter Housing With an Integrated Oil Cooler
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: A leak at the oil filter housing isn’t limited to a gasket for its explanation. On many late-model import engines, the housing is part of a larger module that manages oil filtration and temperature, and may also contain sensors, thermostats and coolant passages.
paras.zh: 机油滤清器外壳的泄漏不仅仅限于垫圈。在许多新型进口发动机上，外壳是管理油过滤和温度的较大模块的一部分，并且还可能包含传感器、恒温器和冷却剂通道。

paras.en: Look at many late-model European engines and you’ll find an assembly bolted to the side of the block or mounted in the engine’s V. It may hold the oil filter and oil cooler, along with thermostats, valves or sensors. That arrangement helps fit more functions into a crowded engine compartment, but it can turn a straightforward oil leak into a more involved repair.
paras.zh: 看看许多最新型号的欧洲发动机，您会发现一个组件用螺栓固定在缸体侧面或安装在发动机的 V 形中。它可能固定机油滤清器和机油冷却器，以及恒温器、阀门或传感器。这种布置有助于在拥挤的发动机舱中安装更多功能，但也可能会将简单的漏油变成更复杂的维修。

paras.en: The design reflects two pressures on engine development: packaging and temperature control. Modern engines often use oil to operate variable valve timing systems and, in some engines, cylinder deactivation hardware. The oil must reach these components at the required pressure and volume, while staying within the engine’s operating temperature range.
paras.zh: 该设计反映了发动机开发的两个压力：封装和温度控制。现代发动机经常使用油来操作可变气门正时系统，并且在某些发动机中还使用停缸硬件。油必须以所需的压力和体积到达这些部件，同时保持在发动机的工作温度范围内。

paras.en: Oil cooling has changed to meet those needs. Some older imports used an air-to-oil cooler mounted near the radiator, with oil routed through an adapter between the filter and its mounting base. Many later designs moved to a liquid-to-liquid cooler, often sandwiched between the engine and oil filter. Coolant warms the oil more quickly after a cold start and carries away heat once the oil is hot. Integrating the filter, cooler and related controls into a single module saves space and can simplify assembly.
paras.zh: 为了满足这些需求，油冷却已经发生了变化。一些较旧的进口产品使用安装在散热器附近的空气-油冷却器，油通过过滤器与其安装底座之间的适配器输送。许多后来的设计转向液-液冷却器，通常夹在发动机和机油滤清器之间。冷启动后，冷却剂会更快地加热油，并在油热后带走热量。将过滤器、冷却器和相关控制装置集成到单个模块中可以节省空间并简化组装。

paras.en: A liquid-to-liquid cooler transfers heat between engine oil and coolant through plates or passages inside a compact heat exchanger. The fluids remain separate; heat moves through the metal between them. Because coolant can carry heat away efficiently in a relatively small space, the cooler can be packaged close to the engine without the airflow requirements of a front-mounted cooler.
paras.zh: 液-液冷却器通过紧凑型热交换器内的板或通道在发动机油和冷却剂之间传递热量。流体保持分离状态；热量通过它们之间的金属传播。由于冷却液可以在相对较小的空间内有效地带走热量，因此冷却器可以安装在靠近发动机的位置，而无需前置冷却器的气流要求。

paras.en: Many designs use stacked plates to create a large heat-transfer area. That compact construction has a service tradeoff: narrow internal passages can retain debris. If a major engine failure sends metal fragments through the lubrication system, an oil change may not remove everything lodged in the cooler. Manufacturer guidance for some engine repairs calls for replacing the cooler and related components when bearing debris contaminates the oil circuit, because cleaning cannot reliably remove all of it.
paras.zh: 许多设计使用堆叠板来创建较大的传热面积。这种紧凑的结构有一个服务权衡：狭窄的内部通道可以保留碎片。如果发动机发生重大故障，金属碎片会通过润滑系统，更换机油可能无法清除冷却器中残留的所有物质。制造商对某些发动机维修的指导要求在轴承碎屑污染油路时更换冷却器和相关部件，因为清洁无法可靠地将其全部清除。

paras.en: Oil around the housing does not automatically mean that the housing itself has failed. The leak may come from the housing-to-engine seal, the cooler seals, the filter cap or another component above the assembly. Oil can travel down the engine and collect at the lowest point, making the source hard to identify.
paras.zh: 外壳周围有油并不自动意味着外壳本身出现故障。泄漏可能来自外壳至发动机密封件、冷却器密封件、过滤器盖或组件上方的其他部件。油可以沿着发动机流下并聚集在最低点，使得来源难以识别。

paras.en: Clean the area and inspect it closely. If necessary, use an approved leak-detection dye and re-check the engine after running it. Look for coolant residue as well as oil. A leak between the oil and coolant passages can cause contamination in either direction, depending on operating pressures and the failure. If the coolant is oily or the oil appears milky, diagnose the source before deciding what to replace.
paras.zh: 清洁该区域并仔细检查。如有必要，请使用经批准的泄漏检测染料，并在运行后重新检查发动机。寻找冷却剂残留物和油。油道和冷却剂通道之间的泄漏可能会导致任一方向的污染，具体取决于工作压力和故障。如果冷却液呈油状或油呈乳状，请先诊断其来源，然后再决定更换什么。

paras.en: Check the vehicle-specific service information before starting. The procedure may require draining coolant, removing intake or accessory components, or following a particular sequence to release the housing. Some assemblies include separate cooler seals; others are serviced as a unit. Check whether the manufacturer specifies replacement bolts, sealants, tightening sequences or a special coolant bleeding procedure.
paras.zh: 开始前检查车辆特定的服务信息。该过程可能需要排出冷却剂、拆除进气口或附件部件，或者按照特定顺序释放外壳。一些组件包括单独的冷却器密封件；其他的则作为一个单元提供服务。检查制造商是否指定了更换螺栓、密封剂、拧紧顺序或特殊的冷却剂排放程序。

paras.en: Start with a cool engine. Drain the coolant if the service procedure calls for it, then disconnect electrical connectors and coolant hoses without stressing aged plastic fittings. Clean debris from around the assembly before opening the oil and coolant passages. Dirt that falls into an exposed passage can circulate through the engine.
paras.zh: 从一个很酷的引擎开始。如果维修程序需要，请排出冷却液，然后断开电气连接器和冷却液软管，不要对老化的塑料配件施加压力。打开机油和冷却液通道之前，请清除组件周围的碎屑。落入暴露通道的污垢可以在发动机中循环。

paras.en: Clean the engine’s sealing surface carefully. Avoid abrasive discs and aggressive scraping that can gouge or distort the surface. Keep debris out of the oil and coolant passages. If baked-on gasket material is difficult to remove, use a compatible gasket remover and a suitable non-damaging tool. Follow product directions and keep solvent out of the engine.
paras.zh: 仔细清洁发动机的密封面。避免使用研磨盘和强力刮擦，以免造成表面凿伤或变形。让碎屑远离机油和冷却液通道。如果烘烤后的垫圈材料难以去除，请使用兼容的垫圈去除剂和合适的无损工具。遵循产品说明并防止溶剂进入发动机。

paras.en: Install new seals in the correct locations and orientation. Lubricate them only if the service information calls for it. Tighten fasteners in the specified sequence and to the specified torque, using a torque wrench. Remember that uneven or excessive clamping force can distort a housing, damage a cooler or cause a new leak. Avoid adding sealant unless the procedure specifies it; excess sealant can squeeze into passages.
paras.zh: 将新密封件安装在正确的位置和方向。仅当维修信息需要时才润滑它们。使用扭矩扳手按指定顺序和指定扭矩拧紧紧固件。请记住，不均匀或过大的夹紧力可能会导致外壳变形、损坏冷却器或导致新的泄漏。除非程序指定，否则避免添加密封剂；多余的密封剂可能会挤入通道。

paras.en: Address Contamination and Verify the Repair
paras.zh: 解决污染并验证修复情况

paras.en: If oil has entered the cooling system, replacing the failed cooler or housing may not be enough. Oil can remain in the radiator, heater core, hoses and expansion tank. Follow the vehicle manufacturer’s cleaning procedure and use only products approved for that cooling system. A 2025 service bulletin, for example, warns against using unvalidated detergents because they may damage seals or metal components. Replace contaminated parts when the prescribed procedure calls for it.
paras.zh: 如果油已进入冷却系统，仅更换发生故障的冷却器或外壳可能还不够。油可能残留在散热器、加热器芯、软管和膨胀水箱中。遵循车辆制造商的清洁程序，并仅使用经批准用于该冷却系统的产品。例如，2025 年服务公告警告不要使用未经验证的清洁剂，因为它们可能会损坏密封件或金属部件。当规定程序需要时，更换受污染的部件。

paras.en: If coolant has entered the oil, change the oil and filter after the leak is repaired, and follow the manufacturer’s guidance on whether further oil changes or inspections are needed. If the engine has suffered a mechanical failure that released metal debris, do not assume flushing will make the cooler reusable. The passages can retain contamination that may return to the engine after startup.
paras.zh: 如果冷却液已进入油中，请在修复泄漏后更换油和过滤器，并按照制造商的指导确定是否需要进一步更换油或检查。如果发动机发生机械故障并释放出金属碎片，不要认为冲洗会使冷却器可以重复使用。这些通道可能会滞留污染物，这些污染物可能在启动后返回发动机。

paras.en: Refill the fluids to the correct levels, and bleed the cooling system according to the application; some vehicles require a particular sequence or electronic procedure. Start the engine and check for leaks as it warms up. Confirm that the oil and coolant levels remain stable, then re-check the housing and surrounding area after a road test and cooldown.
paras.zh: 将液体重新加注到正确的液位，并根据应用对冷却系统进行排气；有些车辆需要特定的顺序或电子程序。启动发动机并在预热时检查是否有泄漏。确认机油和冷却液液位保持稳定，然后在路试和冷却后重新检查外壳和周围区域。

paras.zh: 据该公司称，这些无绳模磨机可提供持续的动力，同时不需要软管和压缩机，使专业人员能够在狭小的空间中更高效地工作。应用包括除锈、去毛刺、研磨、切割和精加工。

paras.zh: 据该公司介绍，M12 Fuel 1/4" 直模磨床专为精密应用中的更多控制而设计，具有改进的符合人体工程学的手柄；而 M12 Fuel Gen 2 1/4" 加长直模磨床可提供更大的移动性和扩展的操作范围，其 4" 轴设计用于更深入地进入受限或难以进入的区域。
