articles.title: Static vs. Dynamic ADAS Calibrations
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Choosing between static and dynamic ADAS calibration depends on the procedure specified by the vehicle manufacturer. Regardless of the method, the vehicle and its surroundings must meet the manufacturer’s requirements.
paras.zh: 静态和动态 ADAS 校准之间的选择取决于车辆制造商指定的程序。无论采用哪种方法，车辆及其周围环境都必须满足制造商的要求。

paras.en: ADAS systems affected by a repair may need to be calibrated, relearned or re-zeroed. Terminology may vary, but the purpose is to establish an accurate reference point for the system.
paras.zh: 受维修影响的 ADAS 系统可能需要校准、重新学习或重新调零。术语可能有所不同，但目的是为系统建立准确的参考点。

paras.en: A static calibration is performed while the vehicle remains stationary. Technicians position targets at exact distances and heights, and the targets must also be square to the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 静态校准是在车辆保持静止时执行的。技术人员将目标定位在精确的距离和高度，并且目标还必须与车辆中心线成直角。

paras.en: The vehicle must meet specified requirements for weight, ride height, tire pressure, fluid levels, lighting and background conditions.
paras.zh: 车辆必须满足重量、行驶高度、轮胎压力、液位、照明和背景条件的规定要求。

paras.en: Dynamic calibration takes place while driving. The technician places the system into calibration mode and drives the vehicle under specified conditions.
paras.zh: 动态校准在驾驶时进行。技术人员将系统置于校准模式并在指定条件下驾驶车辆。

paras.en: During the drive, the sensors verify that they can identify the roadway, recognize objects and align correctly with the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 在驾驶过程中，传感器验证它们是否可以识别道路、识别物体并与车辆中心线正确对齐。

paras.en: Extra weight, improper tire pressure, incorrect ride height or environmental interference can cause calibration to fail. These conditions can also establish an inaccurate reference.
paras.zh: 额外的重量、不正确的轮胎压力、不正确的行驶高度或环境干扰都可能导致校准失败。这些条件也可能建立不准确的参考。

paras.en: Whether the procedure is static or dynamic, technicians must follow the manufacturer’s instructions exactly. ADAS calibration depends on precision, and even small inconsistencies can affect system performance.
paras.zh: 无论程序是静态还是动态，技术人员都必须严格遵循制造商的说明。 ADAS 校准取决于精度，即使很小的不一致也会影响系统性能。

articles.title: Women in Auto Care Announces 2026 Award Winners
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Women in Auto Care, a community of the Auto Care Association, announced its 2026 award recipients during the Women in Auto Care Awards Ceremony, held at this year’s Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo (AAPEX) in Las Vegas. The Women in Auto Care Awards annually recognize the exceptional women and companies helping drive the automotive aftermarket forward, celebrating leadership, achievement, mentorship, advocacy and service across the industry. The awards honor recipients in the following categories: Lifetime Achievement, Outstanding Leadership, Shop Owner of the Year, Women of Excellence, Company Ally of the Year and Champion of the Year.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会旗下的女性汽车护理社区在今年拉斯维加斯汽车售后市场产品博览会 (AAPEX) 举行的女性汽车护理颁奖典礼上宣布了 2026 年获奖者名单。汽车护理女性奖每年都会表彰帮助推动汽车售后市场发展的杰出女性和公司，表彰整个行业的领导力、成就、指导、宣传和服务。该奖项授予以下类别的获奖者：终身成就奖、杰出领导奖、年度店主奖、杰出女性奖、年度公司盟友奖和年度冠军奖。

paras.en: “Every year, I have the privilege of seeing firsthand the extraordinary talent, generosity and commitment within the Women in Auto Care community,” said Missy Goodpaster, community engagement manager, Auto Care Association. “Our 2026 award recipients are leaders who not only make an impact through their own work, but also create opportunities for others, strengthen our industry and help build the next generation of automotive aftermarket leaders. I am incredibly proud to celebrate this remarkable group and the many ways they are making our industry better.”
paras.zh: “每年，我都有幸亲眼目睹女性汽车护理社区中的非凡才华、慷慨和奉献精神，”汽车护理协会社区参与经理米西·古德帕斯特 (Missy Goodpaster) 说道。 “我们的 2026 年获奖者都是领导者，他们不仅通过自己的工作产生影响，而且还为他人创造机会，增强我们的行业并帮助培养下一代汽车售后市场领导者。我非常自豪能够庆祝这个卓越的团队以及他们在许多方面使我们的行业变得更好。”

paras.en: The winners of the 2026 Women in Auto Care Awards are:
paras.zh: 2026 年女性汽车护理奖获奖者是：

paras.en: - Lifetime Achievement: Liz Whalen, founder and president, Whalen Search Group
paras.zh: - 终身成就奖：Liz Whalen，Whalen Search Group 创始人兼总裁

paras.en: - Outstanding Leadership: Jessica Toliuszis, vice president, general manager, Highline Warren
paras.zh: - 杰出领导力：Jessica Toliuszis，Highline Warren 副总裁兼总经理

paras.en: - Shop Owner of the Year: Tenise Chapman, owner, Black Hills Tire
paras.zh: - 年度店主：Tenise Chapman，Black Hills Tire 店主

paras.en: - Women of Excellence: Samantha Higdon, marketing manager, Schearer’s Sales and Service
paras.zh: - 杰出女性：Samantha Higdon，Shearer 销售和服务部营销经理

paras.en: - Women of Excellence: Allison Moody, senior marketing manager,Global, Snap-on
paras.zh: - 杰出女性：Allison Moody，实耐宝全球高级营销经理

paras.en: - Women of Excellence: Kendra Mitchell, senior key account manager, TERREPOWER
paras.zh: - 杰出女性：Kendra Mitchell，TERREPOWER 高级大客户经理

paras.en: - Women of Excellence: Caitlin McGill, national sales manager, WD-40 Company
paras.zh: - 杰出女性：Caitlin McGill，WD-40 公司全国销售经理

paras.en: - Champion of the Year: Dawn Fitzgerald, senior manager, Marketing Communications, Stryten Energy
paras.zh: - 年度冠军：Dawn Fitzgerald，Stryten Energy 营销传播高级经理

paras.en: Liz Whalen, founder and president of Whalen Search Group, has spent more than two decades in the automotive industry, building a career centered on connecting people with opportunities and helping organizations strengthen their teams. After beginning her automotive career in human resources and advancing to director of recruiting for an automotive aftermarket manufacturer, she transitioned into independent recruiting and founded Whalen Search Group in 2015. Today, the executive search firm supports more than 40 customers across the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: Liz Whalen 是 Whalen Search Group 的创始人兼总裁，她在汽车行业工作了二十多年，其职业生涯的重点是为人们提供机会并帮助组织加强团队。她在人力资源领域开始了自己的汽车职业生涯，并晋升为一家汽车售后市场制造商的招聘总监，随后转型为独立招聘领域，并于 2015 年创立了 Whalen Search Group。如今，这家猎头公司为汽车售后市场的 40 多家客户提供服务。

paras.en: Whalen has been actively involved with Women in Auto Care since attending her first conference in 2019. She has served on the Executive Champions Committee, participated in Women in Auto Care programming and mentorship and serves as a YANG mentor. Through her business, she also advocates for expanding career opportunities and advises companies and professionals on recruiting, leadership and career development.
paras.zh: 自 2019 年参加第一次会议以来，Whalen 一直积极参与女性汽车护理行业的活动。她曾在执行冠军委员会任职，参与女性汽车护理行业的规划和指导，并担任 YANG 导师。通过她的业务，她还倡导扩大职业机会，并为公司和专业人士提供招聘、领导力和职业发展方面的建议。

paras.en: “I am truly honored and humbled to receive this award from Women in Auto Care and grateful to be part of an industry and community I love so much,” said Whalen. “I’m thankful to God each day for my husband’s support, our four children, the amazing Whalen Search Group team, and the many mentors, customers and friends who have inspired and supported me throughout my journey.
paras.zh: Whalen 表示：“能够获得女性汽车护理行业人士颁发的奖项，我感到非常荣幸和谦卑，并且很感激能够成为我如此热爱的行业和社区的一部分。” “我每天都感谢上帝对我丈夫的支持、我们的四个孩子、出色的 Whalen Search Group 团队以及在我的整个旅程中激励和支持我的许多导师、客户和朋友。

paras.en: “Thank you, Women in Auto Care, for this meaningful recognition and your commitment to empowering and celebrating women in our industry. It’s a privilege to be part of this incredible organization, give back, and make a difference one person and one placement at a time!”
paras.zh: “汽车护理界的女性，感谢你们给予我们这一有意义的认可，感谢你们对赋予我们行业女性权力和赞扬的承诺。我很荣幸能够成为这个令人难以置信的组织的一员，回馈社会，一次一个人、一个职位地做出改变！”

paras.en: Outstanding Leadership: Jessica Toliuszis
paras.zh: 杰出领导力：Jessica Toliuszis

paras.en: Jessica Toliuszis, vice president and general manager, Highline Warren, has built her career around developing people, creating opportunities and inspiring others to lead. At Highline Warren, she leads relationships with major automotive retailers while also serving as general manager for the development of the company’s operations in Mexico.
paras.zh: Highline Warren 副总裁兼总经理 Jessica Toliuszis 的职业生涯围绕培养人才、创造机会和激励他人发挥领导作用而建立。在 Highline Warren，她负责与主要汽车零售商建立关系，同时还担任公司墨西哥业务发展的总经理。

paras.en: Her impact on Women in Auto Care is extensive. As a volunteer, committee leader, vice chair and chair, Toliuszis worked to expand volunteer and leadership opportunities through initiatives including Champions, Executive Champions, Connection Circles, speaker mentorship and the Empower Half Hour. She has continued that work within Highline Warren as an executive sponsor of the Women’s Highway employee resource group and through mentorship and career advocacy for emerging leaders.
paras.zh: 她对汽车护理领域的女性产生了广泛的影响。作为一名志愿者、委员会领导、副主席和主席，Toliuszis 致力于通过冠军、执行冠军、联系圈、演讲者指导和赋权半小时等举措扩大志愿者和领导机会。她继续在 Highline Warren 内开展这项工作，担任女性高速公路员工资源小组的执行发起人，并为新兴领导者提供指导和职业宣传。

paras.en: “This recognition is especially meaningful, because it comes from a community that has shaped both my career and my life. Women in Auto Care has given me mentors, leadership opportunities, lifelong friendships and the privilege of serving an industry I love,” said Toliuszis. “
paras.zh: “这种认可特别有意义，因为它来自一个塑造了我的职业生涯和生活的社区。女性汽车护理行业给了我导师、领导机会、终生的友谊以及为我热爱的行业服务的特权，”Toliuszis 说。 “

paras.en: While I am deeply honored by this award, I believe the greatest impact of Women in Auto Care is its ability to help people see potential in themselves and in others. I am grateful to be part of that mission and committed to continuing to build leaders, create opportunities, and help others thrive in our industry.”
paras.zh: 虽然我对获得这一奖项深感荣幸，但我相信女性汽车护理行业的最大影响是它能够帮助人们看到自己和他人的潜力。我很高兴能够成为这一使命的一部分，并致力于继续培养领导者、创造机会并帮助其他人在我们的行业中蓬勃发展。”

paras.en: Tenise Chapman, owner, Black Hills Tire, founded a full-service automotive repair and tire shop with her husband, Weston, eight years ago. The business has grown from a two-bay, three-employee operation into an eight-bay shop with 16 employees and $5 million in annual sales. Community involvement is central to the business, with Black Hills Tire donating more than $100,000 annually in recent years. Chapman is also the founder of Camp DRIVE, a two-day, hands-on automotive program that introduces youth ages 12–15 to automotive careers through activities including welding, brakes, alignments, vehicle maintenance, engines, electrical diagnostics and tires. She is also involved with Western Dakota Technical College and the Build Dakota Scholarship Program, supporting pathways into skilled-trades careers and automotive technology education.
paras.zh: 八年前，Black Hills Tire 老板 Tenise Chapman 与丈夫 Weston 共同创办了一家提供全方位服务的汽车维修和轮胎店。该公司已从拥有 2 个开间、3 名员工的店铺发展成为拥有 16 名员工、拥有 16 名员工、年销售额达 500 万美元的 8 个开间的商店。社区参与是公司业务的核心，近年来 Black Hills Tire 每年捐赠超过 10 万美元。 Chapman 还是 Camp DRIVE 的创始人，这是一个为期两天的汽车实践项目，通过焊接、制动、定位、车辆维护、发动机、电气诊断和轮胎等活动向 12 至 15 岁的青少年介绍汽车职业。她还参与了西达科他州技术学院和建设达科他州奖学金计划，支持进入技术行业职业和汽车技术教育的途径。

paras.en: “This is truly an honor, as I feel it is a full circle moment,” said Chapman. “My grandparents owned their own automotive repair shop for many years and received many accolades, but my grandmother was never able to receive any recognition because that’s just how it was. I’m proud to represent her and many other women in accepting this award. I’m also excited to continue inspiring our younger generation to dream big, just like my grandmother encouraged me to.”
paras.zh: “这确实是一种荣幸，因为我觉得这是一个完整的时刻，”查普曼说。 “我的祖父母拥有自己的汽车维修店多年，并获得了许多荣誉，但我的祖母从未获得过任何认可，因为事情就是这样。我很自豪能够代表她和许多其他女性接受这个奖项。我也很高兴能够继续激励我们的年轻一代实现远大梦想，就像我祖母鼓励我那样。”

paras.en: AutoZone has supported Women in Auto Care for more than a decade through sponsorship, employee participation, committee involvement, conferences and industry programming. AutoZone sends team members to the Women in Auto Care Leadership Conference and has supported educational sessions and special events, participated in scholarship selection and contributed to Women in Auto Care Tool Kit initiatives benefiting emerging automotive professionals.
paras.zh: 十多年来，AutoZone 通过赞助、员工参与、委员会参与、会议和行业规划来支持女性汽车护理行业。 AutoZone 派遣团队成员参加女性汽车护理领袖会议，并支持教育会议和特别活动，参与奖学金评选，并为女性汽车护理工具包计划做出贡献，使新兴汽车专业人士受益。

paras.en: The company also invests in leadership development and professional development opportunities. Since 2019, women’s representation at AutoZone has increased to 44% of Board of Directors seats, 24% of vice president roles and 29% of management roles.
paras.zh: 公司还投资于领导力发展和专业发展机会。自 2019 年以来，AutoZone 董事会席位中的女性比例已增至 44%、副总裁职位中的 24% 和管理职位中的 29%。

paras.en: “Receiving the Ally of the Year award is a tremendous honor for AutoZone and a meaningful recognition of the values that define our culture: caring about people and embracing diversity. Since our founding, we have remained committed to creating an environment where AutoZoners and customers are empowered to grow, succeed, and reach their full potential.
paras.zh: “获得年度盟友奖是 AutoZone 的巨大荣誉，也是对定义我们文化的价值观的有意义的认可：关心他人和拥抱多样性。自成立以来，我们始终致力于创造一个环境，使 AutoZone 员工和客户能够成长、成功并充分发挥潜力。

paras.en: “This recognition reflects our ongoing dedication to fostering an inclusive workplace and advancing opportunities for women across our industry. We are proud to be recognized for these efforts and remain committed to building a culture where everyone can thrive.”
paras.zh: “这一认可反映了我们持续致力于培育包容性工作场所并为整个行业的女性增加机会。我们很自豪这些努力得到认可，并将继续致力于建立一种人人都能蓬勃发展的文化。”

paras.en: Samantha Higdon began her automotive career in 2017 at Schearer’s Sales & Service, progressing from Client Service Representative to Service Advisor and ultimately into marketing, training and leadership responsibilities. She also founded ShiftPoint Training Academy, where she coaches automotive professionals in communication, leadership and professional development. In 2024, she was named AAPEX Service Advisor of the Year.
paras.zh: Samantha Higdon 于 2017 年在 Schearer 的销售和服务部门开始了她的汽车职业生涯，从客户服务代表晋升为服务顾问，并最终担任营销、培训和领导职务。她还创立了 ShiftPoint 培训学院，为汽车专业人士提供沟通、领导力和专业发展方面的培训。 2024 年，她被评为 AAPEX 年度服务顾问。

paras.en: Since becoming involved with Women in Auto Care in 2024, she has participated in the Leadership Conference and AAPEX programming, served as a scholarship application reviewer and presented for the Generation Gap Connection Circle. She focuses much of her work on developing people, helping emerging leaders build confidence and connecting women with professional development opportunities.
paras.zh: 自 2024 年加入女性汽车护理组织以来，她参加了领导力会议和 AAPEX 计划，担任奖学金申请审核员，并为代沟连接圈做演讲。她的大部分工作重点是人才培养、帮助新兴领导者建立信心以及为女性提供职业发展机会。

paras.en: “Receiving a 2026 Woman of Excellence Award is an incredible honor and a reminder of how much it matters to invest in people,” said Higdon. “I’m beyond grateful for the women and mentors who have encouraged me, challenged me and helped me find my voice in this industry. This recognition motivates me to continue creating that same opportunity for others, helping them feel supported, recognize their potential and grow into confident leaders.”
paras.zh: “获得 2026 年杰出女性奖是一项令人难以置信的荣誉，它提醒我们投资于人才是多么重要，”Higdon 说。 “我非常感谢那些鼓励我、挑战我并帮助我在这个行业找到自己声音的女性和导师。这种认可激励我继续为其他人创造同样的机会，帮助他们感到支持，认识到自己的潜力并成长为自信的领导者。”

paras.en: Allison Moody, senior global marketing manager, Snap-on Equipment, leading strategic marketing initiatives across the automotive undercar, collision repair and heavy-duty sectors. Her work spans global markets and includes brand strategy, digital marketing, trade shows, content development and customer engagement. Beyond her professional responsibilities, Moody is involved with Women in Auto Care, MEMA Modern Industry eXpertise Council, the Auto Care Association, MEMA Marketing Executives Council and YANG. She serves as a Women in Auto Care Champion and partnered with Human Resources at Snap-on Equipment to help establish a Women in Leadership initiative focused on mentorship, collaboration, visibility and professional growth.
paras.zh: Allison Moody，实耐宝设备全球高级营销经理，领导汽车底盘、碰撞修复和重型行业的战略营销计划。她的工作横跨全球市场，包括品牌战略、数字营销、贸易展览、内容开发和客户参与。除了她的专业职责外，穆迪还参与了女性汽车护理、MEMA 现代工业专业委员会、汽车护理协会、MEMA 营销执行委员会和 YANG 的活动。她是女性汽车护理冠军，并与 Snap-on Equipment 的人力资源部合作，帮助建立女性领导力计划，重点关注指导、协作、知名度和职业发展。

paras.en: “Receiving the Women of Excellence Award is incredibly meaningful because so many people in this industry have encouraged me, opened doors and challenged me to grow,” said Moody. “I hope to continue paying that forward by connecting people, creating opportunities and helping other women recognize their potential and know there is a place for them in this industry.”
paras.zh: 穆迪表示：“获得杰出女性奖意义非凡，因为这个行业中有很多人鼓励我、打开大门并挑战我成长。” “我希望继续通过联系人们、创造机会并帮助其他女性认识到她们的潜力并知道她们在这个行业有一席之地来继续推动这一事业。”

paras.en: Kendra Mitchell, senior key account manager, TERREPOWER, serves as the primary liaison between TERREPOWER and O’Reilly Auto Parts for undercar product categories. She began her career with an employee-owned remanufacturer and joined TERREPOWER in 2023. She also serves on the YANG Events sub-committee and volunteers with Women in Auto Care’s Auction and Events Committees.
paras.zh: TERREPOWER 高级大客户经理 Kendra Mitchell 担任 TERREPOWER 和 O’Reilly Auto Parts 车底产品类别之间的主要联络人。她的职业生涯始于一家员工持股的再制造商，并于 2023 年加入 TERREPOWER。她还在 YANG Events 小组委员会任职，并在 Women in Auto Care 的拍卖和活动委员会担任志愿者。

paras.en: Her industry engagement has included earning the Automotive Aftermarket Professional designation, speaking at Women in Auto Care and Auto Care Connect events and participating in mentorship and Connection Circle programming. Within TERREPOWER, she has advocated for enhanced parental leave policies and helped develop a company wellness initiative.
paras.zh: 她的行业参与包括获得汽车售后市场专业人士称号、在女性汽车护理和汽车护理连接活动中发表演讲以及参与指导和连接圈计划。在 TERREPOWER 内部，她倡导加强育儿假政策，并帮助制定公司健康计划。

paras.en: “Winning this award honestly feels unreal,” said Mitchell. “I am incredibly honored and blessed to have been selected, and to me, this recognition means that the work I’m doing is making a meaningful impact in our industry. Knowing that truly makes my heart happy and motivates me to keep growing and making a difference.”
paras.zh: “赢得这个奖项确实让人感觉不真实，”米切尔说。 “我非常荣幸和幸运地被选中，对我来说，这种认可意味着我所做的工作正在对我们的行业产生有意义的影响。知道这一点确实让我内心感到高兴，并激励我不断成长并做出改变。”

paras.en: Caitlin McGill, national sales manager, WD-40 Company, has built her automotive aftermarket career around strategic customer relationships, sales growth and industry engagement. Her responsibilities include leading key customer relationships and collaborating across sales, marketing, supply chain and category management to support growth and customer strategy.
paras.zh: Caitlin McGill 是 WD-40 公司的全国销售经理，她的汽车售后市场职业生涯围绕战略客户关系、销售增长和行业参与而展开。她的职责包括领导关键客户关系，并在销售、营销、供应链和品类管理方面进行协作，以支持增长和客户战略。

paras.en: McGill is an active Women in Auto Care Champion, volunteers to support the Women in Auto Care Leadership Conference and participates in Connection Circles. She has also supported industry advocacy by encouraging participation in Right to Repair outreach and has taken leadership responsibility for PIES initiatives within her area of responsibility.
paras.zh: 麦吉尔是一位积极的女性汽车护理倡导者，志愿者支持女性汽车护理领导力会议并参与连接圈。她还通过鼓励参与修复权外展活动来支持行业倡导，并在其职责范围内领导 PIES 举措。

paras.en: “Winning this award reminds me that growth happens when you keep showing up, pushing yourself outside your comfort zone, and believing you have something valuable to contribute,” said McGill. “I hope it inspires other women to say yes to opportunities that challenge them, believe in what they bring to the table, and never be afraid to take up space.”
paras.zh: 麦吉尔说：“赢得这个奖项提醒我，当你不断表现、推动自己走出舒适区并相信自己可以做出有价值的贡献时，成长就会发生。” “我希望它能激励其他女性接受挑战她们的机会，相信她们能带来什么，并且永远不要害怕占据空间。”

paras.en: Dawn Fitzgerald, senior manager, marketing communications, Stryten Energy, has worked in the automotive aftermarket since 1998, beginning as a marketing coordinator and taking on increasingly broad responsibilities spanning marketing services, product information, motorsports sponsorships, events and marketing communications. She moved into her current senior manager role in 2025 and leads a marketing communications team supporting Stryten Energy’s Transportation and Industrial business groups.
paras.zh: Dawn Fitzgerald 是 Stryten Energy 营销传播高级经理，自 1998 年以来一直在汽车售后市场工作，最初担任营销协调员，并承担越来越广泛的职责，涵盖营销服务、产品信息、赛车赞助、活动和营销传播。她于 2025 年升任目前的高级经理职位，领导一支营销传播团队，为 Stryten Energy 的运输和工业业务部门提供支持。

paras.en: Her connection to Women in Auto Care dates back to its days as The Women’s Board. After returning to the Women in Auto Care Breakfast at AAPEX in 2021, Fitzgerald became increasingly active in the community. She has attended the Leadership Conference, volunteered with the Awards and Auction Committees, reviewed scholarship applications, supported scholarship tool kit packing and participated in Empower Half Hours and multiple Connection Circles. Fitzgerald has also served on the Automotive Communications Council Board, including a term as chair, and participates in the MEMA Marketing Executives Council.
paras.zh: 她与汽车护理女性协会的联系可以追溯到女性委员会的时代。 2021 年重返 AAPEX 的女性汽车护理早餐会后，菲茨杰拉德在社区中变得越来越活跃。她参加了领导力会议，在奖项和拍卖委员会担任志愿者，审查奖学金申请，支持奖学金工具包打包，并参加 Empower Half Hours 和多个 Connection Circles。 Fitzgerald 还曾在汽车通信委员会董事会任职，包括担任主席，并参加了 MEMA 营销执行委员会。

paras.en: “Being named Champion of the Year is the highest and most meaningful honor I’ve received in my career,” said Fitzgerald. “I’m deeply grateful for the opportunity to give back to this organization by working alongside this extraordinary group of women who make our industry stronger and better for everyone. To be recognized by my peers as one of them is humbling, to say the least.”
paras.zh: “被评为年度冠军是我职业生涯中获得的最高、最有意义的荣誉，”菲茨杰拉德说道。 “我非常感谢有机会与这群杰出的女性一起工作，回馈这个组织，她们使我们的行业变得更加强大，为每个人带来更好的利益。至少可以说，被我的同行认可为其中之一，我感到很谦卑。”

paras.en: Learn more about the Women in Auto Care community, including upcoming events, scholarships and award opportunities at autocare.org/women-in-auto-care.
paras.zh: 了解有关女性汽车护理社区的更多信息，包括即将举办的活动、奖学金和奖励机会，请访问 autocare.org/women-in-auto-care。

articles.title: Symach Names VP of Business Development for North America
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Symach announced that Jon Dulude has joined the company as vice president of business development for North America.
paras.zh: Symach 宣布乔恩·杜鲁德 (Jon Dulude) 已加入公司，担任北美业务开发副总裁。

paras.en: Dulude brings more than 40 years of experience in the collision repair industry to Symach, spanning shop operations, national account leadership and strategic business development. His understanding of the challenges facing collision repair businesses will be a valuable resource for our customers.
paras.zh: Dulude 为 Symach 带来了 40 多年在碰撞修复行业的经验，涵盖商店运营、全国客户领导和战略业务开发。他对碰撞修复业务面临的挑战的了解将成为我们客户的宝贵资源。

paras.en: In his new role, Dulude will work closely with Symach’s North American customers and partners to identify opportunities to improve shop layout, streamline production and increase profitability through Symach’s equipment, technology and process expertise.
paras.zh: 在新职位上，Dulude 将与 Symach 的北美客户和合作伙伴密切合作，通过 Symach 的设备、技术和工艺专业知识寻找改善车间布局、简化生产并提高盈利能力的机会。

paras.en: Dulude shares Symach’s commitment to building lasting relationships and helping customers get the most from their investment.
paras.zh: Dulude 与 Symach 一样致力于建立持久的关系并帮助客户从投资中获得最大收益。

articles.title: Clarios Expands hAGM Battery Technology
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Clarios is expanding its hAGM technology platform across future original-equipment programs and the aftermarket. The expansion addresses growing demands on low-voltage energy systems in modern vehicles.
paras.zh: Clarios 正在将其 hAGM 技术平台扩展到未来的原始设备计划和售后市场。此次扩建满足了现代车辆对低压能源系统日益增长的需求。

paras.en: Vehicles across powertrain types are becoming increasingly connected, software-enabled and electrically intensive. More electronic control units, safety features, connectivity systems and energy-management functions increase the importance of the 12-volt battery. These systems also increase the battery’s role in vehicle reliability, performance and reducing battery-related warranty risks.
paras.zh: 各种动力总成类型的车辆变得越来越互联、软件化和电力密集型。更多的电子控制单元、安全功能、连接系统和能源管理功能增加了 12 伏电池的重要性。这些系统还增强了电池在车辆可靠性、性能方面的作用，并降低了与电池相关的保修风险。

paras.en: Modern vehicles also rely on the 12-volt battery to support electronic systems and important functions while parked.
paras.zh: 现代车辆还依靠 12 伏电池在停车时支持电子系统和重要功能。

paras.en: Clarios Develops hAGM for Increasing Electrical Demands
paras.zh: Clarios 开发 hAGM 以满足不断增长的电力需求

paras.en: Clarios developed hAGM as the next evolution of absorbent glass mat (AGM) battery technology to address these changing requirements.
paras.zh: Clarios 开发了 hAGM 作为吸收性玻璃毡 (AGM) 电池技术的下一代发展，以满足这些不断变化的需求。

paras.en: Building on established AGM technology, hAGM supports improved dynamic charge acceptance and reliable operation under demanding conditions. These conditions include higher electrical loads, repeated cycling, extended parking periods and growing dependence on electronic systems.
paras.zh: hAGM 以成熟的 AGM 技术为基础，支持改进的动态充电接受能力和在苛刻条件下的可靠运行。这些条件包括更高的电力负载、重复循环、延长停车时间以及对电子系统的日益依赖。

paras.en: These capabilities support faster energy recovery during short charging periods, improved cycling performance and vehicle efficiency under real-world operating conditions.
paras.zh: 这些功能支持在短时间内充电期间更快地恢复能量，提高实际操作条件下的循环性能和车辆效率。

paras.en: Automakers Select hAGM for Future Vehicle Programs
paras.zh: 汽车制造商为未来汽车项目选择 hAGM

paras.en: Multiple leading global automakers have selected Clarios’ hAGM technology for high-volume future vehicle programs. Production for previously announced programs will begin in the fourth quarter of 2026.
paras.zh: 多家全球领先的汽车制造商已选择 Clarios 的 hAGM 技术用于大批量的未来汽车项目。先前宣布的节目将于 2026 年第四季度开始制作。

paras.en: An additional global automaker has also selected Clarios to supply hAGM technology for future vehicle programs. This agreement further expands the technology’s OEM pipeline.
paras.zh: 另一家全球汽车制造商也选择 Clarios 为未来的汽车项目提供 hAGM 技术。该协议进一步扩大了该技术的 OEM 渠道。

paras.en: “The role of the 12-volt battery is changing as vehicle architectures become increasingly sophisticated,” said Federico Morales-Zimmermann, vice president and general manager of global OEM customers and technology at Clarios. “The selection of hAGM for future vehicle programs demonstrates that automakers are preparing for higher electrical demands with technology designed to support improved dynamic charge acceptance, enhanced cycling performance and reliable operation under real-world conditions.”
paras.zh: Clarios 全球 OEM 客户和技术副总裁兼总经理 Federico Morales-Zimmermann 表示：“随着车辆架构变得越来越复杂，12 伏电池的作用正在发生变化。” “为未来的车辆项目选择 hAGM 表明，汽车制造商正在为更高的电力需求做好准备，其技术旨在支持改进的动态充电接受能力、增强的循环性能以及在现实条件下的可靠运行。”

paras.en: OPTIMA REDTOP Brings hAGM+ to the Aftermarket
paras.zh: OPTIMA REDTOP 将 hAGM+ 引入售后市场

paras.en: The recently introduced OPTIMA REDTOP with hAGM+ technology builds on the Clarios hAGM technology foundation. Clarios developed the product for premium aftermarket applications. The battery supports demanding operating conditions, including higher electrical loads, frequent cycling, extensive accessory usage and modern electrical-system requirements.
paras.zh: 最近推出的采用 hAGM+ 技术的 OPTIMA REDTOP 建立在 Clarios hAGM 技术基础上。 Clarios 为优质售后市场应用开发了该产品。该电池支持苛刻的工作条件，包括更高的电力负载、频繁的循环、广泛的配件使用和现代电气系统要求。

paras.en: “The technology trends shaping future vehicles will also shape the replacement market,” said Marc Andraca, president of U.S. and Canada Region at Clarios. “OPTIMA REDTOP with hAGM+ technology helps aftermarket partners and vehicle owners prepare for the more demanding battery requirements that increasingly sophisticated vehicles will bring.”
paras.zh: Clarios 美国和加拿大地区总裁 Marc Andraca 表示：“塑造未来汽车的技术趋势也将塑造替换市场。” “采用 hAGM+ 技术的 OPTIMA REDTOP 可帮助售后合作伙伴和车主为日益复杂的车辆带来的更严格的电池要求做好准备。”

paras.en: The expanding OEM program pipeline and new OPTIMA REDTOP demonstrate how Clarios is applying its low-voltage technology across both markets.
paras.zh: 不断扩大的 OEM 项目管道和新的 OPTIMA REDTOP 展示了 Clarios 如何在这两个市场应用其低压技术。

paras.en: Battery Technology Featured at AAPEX and SEMA
paras.zh: AAPEX 和 SEMA 上的电池技术

paras.en: Clarios and OPTIMA highlighted the hAGM technology platform during AAPEX and SEMA in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Clarios 和 OPTIMA 在拉斯维加斯 AAPEX 和 SEMA 期间重点介绍了 hAGM 技术平台。

paras.en: The companies provided customers and industry stakeholders information about changing low-voltage energy requirements. They also highlighted the connection between future vehicle technology and replacement-market demand.
paras.zh: 这些公司向客户和行业利益相关者提供有关不断变化的低压能源需求的信息。他们还强调了未来汽车技术与替换市场需求之间的联系。

articles.title: Federated Auto Parts Launches Holiday Diecast Giveaway
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: To celebrate the holiday season, Federated Auto Parts is conducting its annual diecast giveaway. Five winners of a limited-edition Federated collectible will be announced each Friday on the Federated Facebook pages beginning Nov. 13, with the final winners announced on Dec. 11.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝节日，联邦汽车配件公司正在举办年度压铸赠品活动。从 11 月 13 日开始，Federated 限量版收藏品的五名获奖者将于每周五在 Federated Facebook 页面上公布，最终获奖者将于 12 月 11 日公布。

paras.en: “The holiday season is the perfect time to give back to our Facebook followers, and our annual diecast giveaway is one way we can show our appreciation,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “These limited-edition Federated collectibles are sure to be a hit with the winners, whether they add them to their collections, give them as stocking stuffers or keep them as a special holiday treat.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“节日季是回馈 Facebook 粉丝的最佳时机，每年的压铸赠品是我们表达谢意的一种方式。” “这些限量版联邦收藏品肯定会受到获奖者的欢迎，无论他们将它们添加到他们的收藏中，将它们作为圣诞礼物还是将它们作为特殊的节日礼物。”

paras.en: To enter for a chance to win, visit Federated Auto Parts and Federated Car Care on Facebook by Dec. 3 and click on the mobile link in the first post to complete the entry form. Participants can earn extra entries by sharing the contest with Facebook friends.
paras.zh: 要获得获奖机会，请于 12 月 3 日之前访问 Facebook 上的 Federated Auto Parts 和 Federated Car Care，然后单击第一篇文章中的移动链接来填写报名表。参赛者可以通过与 Facebook 好友分享比赛来赚取额外的参赛资格。

articles.title: The 45-Day Rule: How Parts Stores Stop Financing Their Customers
articles.author: Bob Morgan

paras.en: Every parts store has an account like this. The shop buys a lot. The owner is a good guy. He pays — eventually. Meanwhile he’s 50 to 90 days out and asking for another special order “by Thursday.”
paras.zh: 每个配件店都有一个这样的帐户。店里买的很多。店主是个好人。他最终付出了代价。与此同时，他有 50 到 90 天的时间，并要求“在周四之前”再下一份特别订单。

paras.en: Here’s the hard truth I learned after about 15 years running stores on Long Island: volume you don’t collect isn’t volume. It’s a loan you never approved. Most stores aren’t short on sales. They’re short on cash because they’re quietly running a bank for their customers, with the special-order desk as the loan window.
paras.zh: 这是我在长岛经营商店大约 15 年之后学到的残酷事实：你不收集的数量就不是数量。这是一笔您从未批准过的贷款。大多数商店都不缺销售。他们缺乏现金，因为他们悄悄地为客户经营一家银行，以特殊订单柜台作为贷款窗口。

paras.en: The fix isn’t a collections agency or a nasty letter. It’s one rule, written down and used every single time.
paras.zh: 解决办法不是催收机构或令人讨厌的信件。这是一条规则，写下来并每次都使用。

paras.en: If an account is 45 or more days past due and they want a special order, the special waits until the money is in the building.
paras.zh: 如果账户逾期 45 天或以上，并且他们想要特殊订单，则特殊订单会等到钱到达大楼后才进行。

paras.en: That’s it. Shelf stock can still go out for cash. The relationship stays intact. But you stop ordering non-returnable, hard-to-restock parts for an account that hasn’t paid for the last batch.
paras.zh: 就是这样。货架库存仍然可以换取现金。关系保持完好。但您会停止为上一批尚未付款的帐户订购不可退货、难以补货的零件。

paras.en: Why special orders? A stocked part sold on account is a receivable. A special order for a slow-paying account is a receivable plus freight, a restocking fee and a part you may end up owning if the job falls through. That’s where slow accounts do the most damage, so that’s where the line goes.
paras.zh: 为什么要特殊订单？赊销的库存零件是应收账款。慢付款帐户的特殊订单是应收账款加上运费、补货费以及如果工作失败您最终可能拥有的部分。这就是缓慢的帐户造成最大损害的地方，所以这就是线路的所在。

paras.en: Before the rule works, everyone at the counter has to agree on what “45 days” means. I count days past the due date, not days since the invoice. A Net 30 invoice dated June 12 is due July 12. On September 2, it’s 52 days past due — over the line.
paras.zh: 在规则生效之前，柜台上的每个人都必须就“45 天”的含义达成一致。我计算的是到期日之后的天数，而不是发票后的天数。日期为 6 月 12 日的 Net 30 发票应于 7 月 12 日到期。到 9 月 2 日，已逾期 52 天。

paras.en: If you’d rather age from the invoice date, fine. Pick one method, write it on the rule and never switch mid-argument. If your company already has a hold policy, use its number. The discipline matters more than the exact day.
paras.zh: 如果您希望从发票日期算起，没问题。选择一种方法，将其写在规则上，并且永远不要在争论中途改变。如果您的公司已有保留政策，请使用其号码。纪律比具体的日子更重要。

paras.en: The 45-day rule works because nobody gets surprised by it. The steps before it do the heavy lifting:
paras.zh: 45 天的规则之所以有效，是因为没有人对此感到惊讶。完成繁重工作之前的步骤：

paras.en: - Day 30 — a reminder, not a threat. “Invoice 1844 is at 30. Card or check on the next stop?”
paras.zh: - 第 30 天——提醒，而不是威胁。 “发票1844是30号。下一站刷卡还是支票？”

paras.en: - Day 35–40 — a human call. Not another statement they’re already ignoring. A person, by name, on the phone.
paras.zh: - 第 35-40 天 — 人工召唤。这不是他们已经忽视的另一个声明。一个人，叫出名字，正在打电话。

paras.en: - Day 45 — credit hold for new specials. Shelf can still be cash. Specials wait.
paras.zh: - 第 45 天 — 新特价商品的积分保留。货架上还是可以现金的。特价等。

paras.en: - Day 60 — hard hold. No “just this once” unless a manager puts the amount and the date in writing.
paras.zh: - 第 60 天 — 坚守。除非经理以书面形式注明金额和日期，否则不能“仅此一次”。

paras.en: Most accounts never reach day 45 once the day-30 and day-35 touches actually happen. The rule is the backstop, not the first move.
paras.zh: 一旦第 30 天和第 35 天的接触实际发生，大多数帐户永远不会到达第 45 天。规则是后盾，而不是第一步。

paras.en: Give your counter people the exact words. Nobody should improvise a credit conversation with a regular at the register. At day 45:
paras.zh: 向柜台人员提供准确的词语。任何人都不应该在收银台与常客即兴进行信用对话。第 45 天：

paras.en: “I can keep selling you what’s here if we’re cash. I can’t put another special in motion until 1844 is clear. I need you current so I can keep saying yes.”
paras.zh: “如果我们有现金，我可以继续向你出售这里的商品。在 1844 年明确之前，我无法推出另一个特价商品。我需要你提供最新信息，这样我才能继续答应。”

paras.en: “I like working with you. I can’t keep shipping on a 60-day balance. Let’s pick an amount for this week and a date for the rest. Until that starts, we’re cash.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢和你一起工作。我无法在 60 天的余额中继续发货。让我们选择本周的金额和其余的日期。在那之前，我们都是现金。”

paras.en: Those lines don’t threaten and don’t apologize. They state the rule and offer a path back. “I need you current so I can keep saying yes” puts you and the customer on the same side.
paras.zh: 这些台词既不构成威胁，也不构成道歉。他们陈述规则并提供返回路径。 “我需要你保持最新状态，这样我才能一直说“是””让你和客户站在同一边。

paras.en: The most common way the rule breaks: “I’m not paying until you fix that core credit.” Freeze the one disputed line and research it. The rest of the balance is still due. Don’t let a $40 question hold up a $4,000 balance.
paras.zh: 最常见的违反规则的方式是：“在你修复核心信用之前，我不会付款。”冻结一条有争议的线路并进行研究。其余余额仍需支付。不要让 40 美元的问题占用 4,000 美元的余额。

paras.en: And if yelling breaks the rule, you’ve just taught every shop in town that yelling works. The rule has to hold for your biggest account, too.
paras.zh: 如果大喊大叫违反了规则，那么你就已经告诉镇上的每一家商店大喊大叫是有效的。该规则也必须适用于您最大的帐户。

paras.en: A rule nobody checks turns into a suggestion. Once a week — I do it in a short Monday meeting — pull your aging and look at three things:
paras.zh: 无人检查的规则变成了建议。每周一次——我在周一的一次简短会议上进行——拉动你的衰老，看看三件事：

paras.en: - Total dollars 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的总金额。

paras.en: - A name and a next-call date next to every one of those accounts.
paras.zh: - 每个帐户旁边都有姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Any special order that went out to a 45+ account, and who approved it.
paras.zh: - 发送至 45+ 帐户的任何特殊订单以及批准者。

paras.en: A simple example (invented numbers): a store has $6,940 at 45+ days past due across two accounts. A fleet account on that list calls for a special. The counter person checks the list and uses the day-45 line. The special gets placed the afternoon the check clears. No fight, no exception, and the store isn’t fronting more parts to a customer who already owes $4,200.
paras.zh: 一个简单的例子（虚构的数字）：一家商店的两个账户逾期 45 天以上，有 6,940 美元。该名单上的车队帐户需要特殊服务。柜台人员检查清单并使用第 45 天的线路。特价商品在支票兑现的下午进行。没有打架，没有例外，商店也不会向已经欠下 4,200 美元的顾客提供更多零件。

paras.en: - Export or write down your current aging.
paras.zh: - 导出或写下您当前的年龄。

paras.en: - Highlight everything 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 突出显示逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的所有内容。

paras.en: - Put a name and a next-call date on every one.
paras.zh: - 在每个人身上写上姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Write the special-order rule on a sticky note at the counter where everyone can see it.
paras.zh: - 将特殊订单规则写在柜台的便利贴上，让每个人都能看到。

paras.en: You can like the shop. You can need the volume. You still collect. The 45-day rule is how a parts store stops financing its customers and gets back to selling them parts.
paras.zh: 你可以喜欢这家商店。您可能需要音量。你还是收藏吧。 45 天规则规定了零部件商店如何停止向客户提供融资并重新向他们销售零部件。

articles.title: APA’s Gatsby Gala Brings Roaring ’20s Glamour to AAPEX
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Automotive Parts Associates (APA) brought a touch of Roaring ’20s glamour to this year’s AWDA and AAPEX festivities with its annual industry cocktail party. This year’s party, The Gatsby Gala, was held November 3, 2026, at 1923 Prohibition Bar in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Automotive Parts Associates (APA) 举办的年度行业鸡尾酒会为今年的 AWDA 和 AAPEX 庆祝活动增添了一丝咆哮的 20 年代魅力。今年的派对“盖茨比晚会”于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在拉斯维加斯 1923 Prohibition 酒吧举行。

paras.en: Guests stepped back in time for an evening of drinks, networking, and old-school elegance. Adding to the occasion, APA staff dressed in 1920s-inspired attire, helping bring the spirit of the Jazz Age to life at the Prohibition-era venue.
paras.zh: 客人们回到过去，度过了一个畅饮、社交和老式优雅的夜晚。为庆祝这一盛事，APA 工作人员身着 1920 年代风格的服装，帮助在禁酒令时代的场馆将爵士乐时代的精神带入生活。

paras.en: “One of the best parts of AWDA and AAPEX is the opportunity to bring people together outside of the day-to-day business. The Gatsby Gala gave us a chance to celebrate the relationships that make this industry special while enjoying a memorable evening with our shareholders, members and supplier partners,” said Steve Tucker, president of Automotive Parts Associates.
paras.zh: Automotive Parts Associates 总裁 Steve Tucker 表示：“AWDA 和 AAPEX 最好的部分之一就是有机会将日常业务之外的人们聚集在一起。Gatsby Gala 让我们有机会庆祝使这个行业与众不同的关系，同时与我们的股东、会员和供应商合作伙伴一起度过一个难忘的夜晚。”

paras.en: The evening brought together APA shareholders, TruStar members, NEXUS representatives, and industry supplier partners for an opportunity to connect with fellow aftermarket professionals, strengthen existing relationships, and enjoy a night away from the busy trade show floor.
paras.zh: 当晚，APA 股东、TruStar 会员、NEXUS 代表和行业供应商合作伙伴齐聚一堂，有机会与售后市场专业人士建立联系、加强现有关系，并享受远离繁忙贸易展览场地的夜晚。

paras.en: The Gatsby Gala carried on APA/TruStar’s tradition of hosting an annual gathering during one of the busiest weeks in the automotive aftermarket. Beyond the party, APA also held a dinner for its Board of Directors on Saturday night and met with more than 70 supplier partners during AWDA and on the AAPEX show floor.
paras.zh: Gatsby Gala 延续了 APA/TruStar 在汽车售后市场最繁忙的几周举办年度聚会的传统。除了派对之外，APA 还在周六晚为其董事会举办了晚宴，并在 AWDA 期间和 AAPEX 展厅与 70 多家供应商合作伙伴会面。

articles.title: 125,000-year-old poisoned stone points discovered on shore of ancient lake in Saudi Arabia
articles.author: Charles Q. Choi

paras.en: Archaeologists have found what may be the world's oldest poisoned weapons at a 125,000-year-old site on an ancient lakeshore in Saudi Arabia. The stone tools, which were likely used to hunt large animals, had traces of residue from a poisonous tree historically used for its toxins.
paras.zh: 考古学家在沙特阿拉伯古老湖岸一处拥有 125,000 年历史的遗址中发现了可能是世界上最古老的有毒武器。这些石器很可能是用来猎杀大型动物的，其中含有历史上用来提取毒素的有毒树的残留物。

paras.en: "At 125,000 years old, these would be substantially older than the poisoned arrowheads recently identified in South Africa, which date to around 60,000 years ago," study co-author Chris Clarkson, an archaeologist at the Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology in Germany and Griffith University in Australia, told Live Science in an email. "But we haven't demonstrated exactly how the poison was prepared or whether it was effective. So I'd describe these as potentially the oldest evidence for poisoned hunting weapons, rather than an unequivocally established first."
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、德国马克斯·普朗克地球人类学研究所和澳大利亚格里菲斯大学的考古学家克里斯·克拉克森在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》：“这些有 125,000 年历史的毒箭头比最近在南非发现的毒箭头要古老得多，后者的历史可以追溯到大约 60,000 年前。” “但我们还没有确切地证明这种毒药是如何制备的，或者它是否有效。所以我将这些描述为可能是有毒狩猎武器的最古老的证据，而不是明确确立的第一个证据。”

paras.en: In the new study, published Thursday (Nov. 12) in the journal Science, researchers investigated a 125,000-year-old site in southern Saudi Arabia known as 'Uruq Aljelibah, which means "sand dunes of a watering hole," study co-author Frans van Buchem, a geologist at the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology in Saudi Arabia, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 周四（11 月 12 日）发表在《科学》杂志上的这项新研究中，研究人员调查了沙特阿拉伯南部一处名为“Uruq Aljelibah”的遗址，它有 125,000 年的历史，意思是“水坑的沙丘”，该研究的合著者、沙特阿拉伯阿卜杜拉国王科技大学的地质学家 Frans van Buchem 告诉《Live Science》。

paras.en: Today, the area is "hot, extremely dry, with extensive sand dunes," Clarkson said, located as it is within the Empty Quarter — one of the hottest, driest deserts on Earth. But the scientists found the site was once home to a freshwater lake measuring about 130 square miles (340 square kilometers) and up to 95 feet (29 meters) deep. Fossils there suggest it once supported a rich diversity of flora and fauna, including hippopotamuses, buffalo, ostriches, camels, gazelles, oryx, palms, reeds, trees and shrubs, which early modern humans likely exploited for food and other resources.
paras.zh: 克拉克森说，如今，该地区“炎热、极其干燥，有大片沙丘”，因为它位于空地——地球上最热、最干燥的沙漠之一。但科学家们发现该地点曾经是一个淡水湖的所在地，面积约 130 平方英里（340 平方公里），深达 95 英尺（29 米）。那里的化石表明，它曾经支持着丰富多样的动植物群，包括河马、水牛、鸵鸟、骆驼、瞪羚、大羚羊、棕榈树、芦苇、树木和灌木，早期现代人类可能利用它们来获取食物和其他资源。

paras.en: "The idea of hippopotamuses and enormous buffalo living around a lake in what is now the Empty Quarter really brings home just how dramatically these landscapes, and global climates, have changed," Clarkson said.
paras.zh: 克拉克森说：“河马和巨大的水牛生活在现在的空旷地区的一个湖周围，这一想法确实让人意识到这些景观和全球气候已经发生了多么巨大的变化。”

paras.en: The archaeologists discovered more than 5,500 stone artifacts at the site, along with extraordinarily preserved traces of plant materials, such as fibers, resins and wood. Several of these artifacts were stone points that showed impact damage consistent with hunting large animals, and a microscopic analysis revealed traces of animal tissue near the point tips. The distribution of the stone tools closely matched clusters of animal bones, suggesting that the lakeshore was a focal point for hunting and processing game, according to the study.
paras.zh: 考古学家在现场发现了 5,500 多件石器，以及保存完好的纤维、树脂和木材等植物材料痕迹。其中一些文物是石尖，显示出与狩猎大型动物一致的撞击损伤，显微镜分析显示尖尖附近有动物组织的痕迹。研究表明，石器的分布与动物骨头群密切相关，表明湖岸是狩猎和加工动物的焦点。

paras.en: "At most Paleolithic sites, we're lucky if we get the stone tools and perhaps a few animal bones," Clarkson said. "Here we can actually begin to reconstruct what those tools were doing and what other materials people were combining with them."
paras.zh: 克拉克森说：“在大多数旧石器时代遗址，如果我们能找到石器，或许还有一些动物骨头，我们就很幸运了。” “在这里，我们实际上可以开始重建这些工具的用途以及人们与它们结合的其他材料。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The researchers found that people may have hunted animals with poison-tipped tools. Several stone points had chemical residues linked with the arrow poison tree (Acokanthera schimperi), which is known historically for its toxins and is native to eastern and central Africa and southern Arabia. African hunters have coated spear tips and arrowheads with extracts from this plant to paralyze or kill game.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，人们可能用有毒的工具猎杀动物。几个石尖上有与箭毒树（Acokanthera schimperi）有关的化学残留物，这种毒树历史上因其毒素而闻名，原产于非洲东部和中部以及阿拉伯南部。非洲猎人将这种植物的提取物涂在矛尖和箭头上，以麻痹或杀死猎物。

paras.en: It remains unclear how hunters who poisoned their targets might have avoided poisoning themselves upon eating the game.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚那些对目标下毒的猎人如何避免在食用野味后中毒。

paras.en: "The effects of a poison depend on the substance, the dose and how it enters the body," Clarkson said. "A poison introduced directly into a wound doesn't necessarily behave in the same way when swallowed." Hunters throughout history "are known to sometimes remove the meat around the wound before eating the rest of the animal," he added.
paras.zh: “毒药的影响取决于物质、剂量以及它进入人体的方式，”克拉克森说。 “直接进入伤口的毒药在吞咽后不一定会产生同样的作用。”他补充说，历史上的猎人“有时会先去除伤口周围的肉，然后再吃掉动物的其余部分”。

paras.en: These findings emphasize how researchers have often underestimated the technological complexity of early human populations, because so much of what they made was organic and has simply disappeared," Clarkson said. "These weren't just people knocking stone flakes off cores," Clarkson noted. "They were combining stone with wood, plant fibers, resins and potentially toxic substances to make complex tools and weapons."
paras.zh: 这些发现强调了研究人员常常低估了早期人类的技术复杂性，因为他们制造的很多东西都是有机的，而且已经消失了。”克拉克森说。“这些人不仅仅是从核心上敲下石片，”克拉克森指出。“他们将石头与木材、植物纤维、树脂和潜在有毒物质结合起来，制造复杂的工具和武器。”

paras.en: To have so much evidence for how people were making and using tools in a site like this "is remarkable," Eleanor Scerri, an archaeologist at the Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology in Germany who did not take part in this research, told Live Science in an email. "This goes from both the micro-scale, in finding traces of how people hafted spear tips, for instance, up to the bigger scale of the whole site and the very convincing spatial relationship between hunting-related tools and the bones of animals such as hippos."
paras.zh: 德国马克斯·普朗克地球人类学研究所的考古学家埃莉诺·斯切里（Eleanor Scerri）没有参与这项研究，她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，有如此多的证据证明人们如何在这样的遗址中制造和使用工具“是了不起的”。 “这既包括微观尺度，例如寻找人们如何使用矛尖的痕迹，也包括整个遗址的更大尺度，以及狩猎相关工具和河马等动物骨骼之间非常令人信服的空间关系。”

paras.en: Sites in Arabia that possess both stone tools and animal bones are rare, Jeffrey Rose, a Paleolithic archaeologist at the University of Algarve in Portugal who did not participate in this study, told Live Science in an email. "This one has thousands of artifacts on an old lakeshore alongside hippo, buffalo and ostrich, and some of the flakes fit back together, so the tools were made on the spot," he said. "It's valuable new data."
paras.zh: 葡萄牙阿尔加维大学的旧石器时代考古学家杰弗里·罗斯（Jeffrey Rose）没有参与这项研究，他在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，在阿拉伯半岛，同时拥有石器和动物骨头的遗址很少见。他说：“这个古老的湖岸上有数以千计的文物，旁边还有河马、水牛和鸵鸟，其中一些薄片重新组装在一起，所以这些工具是当场制作的。” “这是有价值的新数据。”

paras.en: The Arabian Peninsula sits between Africa and the rest of Asia and was a major corridor for humans as they dispersed across the world. Recurring spans of increased rainfall could have made its otherwise hostile landscapes more habitable in the past. However, the hot desert that now covers much of Arabia has made it difficult for scientists to excavate many details about this vital bridge during this critical point in human history.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯半岛位于非洲和亚洲其他地区之间，是人类分散到世界各地的主要走廊。降雨量的反复增加可能会使过去原本恶劣的景观变得更适合居住。然而，现在覆盖阿拉伯大部分地区的炎热沙漠使科学家们很难在人类历史的这个关键时刻挖掘这座重要桥梁的许多细节。

paras.en: The researchers did not unearth any human remains. Still, they suspect the site most likely belonged to modern humans (our species, Homo sapiens), as opposed to a different human species.
paras.zh: 研究人员没有挖掘出任何人类遗骸。尽管如此，他们怀疑该地点很可能属于现代人类（我们的物种，智人），而不是其他人类物种。

paras.en: "We know that H. sapiens had already expanded out of Africa and were present in Southwest Asia during this period," Clarkson said. "The age of the site fits with those early movements."
paras.zh: 克拉克森说：“我们知道，在此期间，智人已经走出了非洲，并出现在西南亚。” “该地点的年龄与那些早期的运动相符。”

paras.en: These findings add to growing evidence that wetter intervals in Arabia created migration corridors between Africa and Asia and supported productive habitats capable of sustaining repeated human occupation.
paras.zh: 这些发现进一步证明，阿拉伯半岛的湿润间隔创造了非洲和亚洲之间的迁徙走廊，并支持了能够维持人类反复占领的生产性栖息地。

paras.en: "What our site shows is that people weren't necessarily just passing through these environments," Clarkson said. "They were exploiting them in quite sophisticated ways, using a range of technologies and resources."
paras.zh: “我们的网站显示，人们不一定只是经过这些环境，”克拉克森说。 “他们使用一系列技术和资源，以相当复杂的方式利用它们。”

paras.en: But Rose cautioned that all of the stone artifacts found in this study were collected from the surface. "Not one was excavated from the layers that were dated," he said. "The 125,000-year date belongs to the lake, not to the tools. For the tools, it is only a maximum age." Future research at the site should look for stone artifacts sealed in lake beds. "That's hard in Arabia, where wind has stripped most sites down to surface scatters, but it can be done," Rose said.
paras.zh: 但罗斯警告说，这项研究中发现的所有石制品都是从地表收集的。 “没有从已测年的地层中挖掘出任何东西，”他说。 “十二万五千年的日期属于湖泊，而不属于工具。对于工具来说，它只是一个最大年龄。”该遗址的未来研究应该寻找密封在湖床上的石制品。罗斯说：“这在阿拉伯半岛很难做到，那里的大部分地点都被风吹到了地表分散的地方，但这是可以做到的。”

paras.en: - Neanderthals may have trekked through the Saudi Arabian desert 55,000 years ago, farther south than experts thought possible
paras.zh: - 尼安德特人可能在 55,000 年前徒步穿越沙特阿拉伯沙漠，比专家认为的更南边

paras.en: - 1,200-year-old gold hoard discovered in Saudi Arabia may have been buried by a medieval pilgrim
paras.zh: - 在沙特阿拉伯发现的拥有 1,200 年历史的金库可能是由中世纪朝圣者埋葬的

paras.en: - Life-size rock art points the way to oldest human inhabitants of Saudi Arabia — and the desert oases they used
paras.zh: - 真人大小的岩石艺术为沙特阿拉伯最古老的人类居民以及他们使用的沙漠绿洲指明了道路

paras.en: Clarkson agrees that further work is needed. "I'd really like to keep going back to this site to find more fossils, both animals as well as hopefully human fossils," Clarkson said. "I'd also really like to push the chemical and functional analyses further, particularly the evidence for toxic plant compounds. It would be fascinating to determine exactly which substances were being used, how they might have been prepared and whether they were deliberately applied to hunting weapons."
paras.zh: 克拉克森同意需要进一步的工作。克拉克森说：“我真的很想继续回到这个地点寻找更多化石，包括动物化石，也希望能找到人类化石。” “我还真的很想进一步推动化学和功能分析，特别是有毒植物化合物的证据。准确确定正在使用哪些物质、它们可能是如何制备的以及它们是否被故意用于狩猎武器，这将是令人着迷的。”

paras.en: Future research focusing on the ancient lake margins may reveal more information. "There must be other places where people were living and carrying out activities, and some may preserve better stratified archaeological deposits," Clarkson said.
paras.zh: 未来针对古湖边缘的研究可能会揭示更多信息。克拉克森说：“肯定还有其他地方是人们生活和开展活动的地方，有些地方可能保存了更好的分层考古沉积物。”

paras.en: But the combination of discoveries at this site is amazing, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 但研究人员表示，该地点的发现组合起来令人惊叹。

paras.en: "I've spent much of my career studying stone tools, and one of the great frustrations is that we're usually only looking at the small fraction of ancient technology that survives," Clarkson said. "Here we have a chance to see much more of the complete technological system."
paras.zh: “我职业生涯的大部分时间都在研究石器，最大的挫折之一是我们通常只关注幸存下来的古代技术的一小部分，”克拉克森说。 “在这里我们有机会看到更多完整的技术系统。”

articles.title: A widely used antibiotic for acne and infections is linked to risk of pregnancy loss, new study finds
articles.author: Isha Ishtiaq

paras.en: Taking doxycycline, a commonly prescribed antibiotic, during the first trimester of pregnancy may increase the risk of pregnancy loss, a new study suggests.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究表明，在怀孕的前三个月服用强力霉素（一种常用的抗生素）可能会增加流产的风险。

paras.en: The antibiotic is broad-spectrum, meaning it targets a wide range of bacteria. It's often used to treat acne, respiratory infections and sexually transmitted infections, such as chlamydia and syphilis. Doctors generally avoid prescribing the drug during the second and third trimesters because it belongs to a class of antibiotics that can bind to calcium in developing bones. Animal studies suggest that this may disrupt fetal bone development.
paras.zh: 这种抗生素是广谱的，这意味着它针对多种细菌。它通常用于治疗痤疮、呼吸道感染和性传播感染，例如衣原体和梅毒。医生通常避免在妊娠中期和晚期开这种药，因为它属于一类抗生素，可以与骨骼发育中的钙结合。动物研究表明这可能会破坏胎儿骨骼的发育。

paras.en: However, evidence on doxycycline's safety during early pregnancy has been mixed and limited. The new study, published Tuesday (Nov. 10) in the journal Annals of Internal Medicine, provides clearer evidence of a link between doxycycline use in the first trimester and pregnancy loss.
paras.zh: 然而，关于多西环素在妊娠早期的安全性的证据是复杂且有限的。这项新研究于周二（11 月 10 日）发表在《内科医学年鉴》杂志上，为妊娠早期使用强力霉素与流产之间的联系提供了更明确的证据。

paras.en: "I would advise physicians to carefully consider the benefit-risk balance when prescribing doxycycline to women who are pregnant or planning a pregnancy," study first author Almut Winterstein, a pharmacist and drug-safety researcher at the University of Florida, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、佛罗里达大学药剂师兼药物安全研究员阿尔穆特·温特斯坦 (Almut Winterstein) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》：“我建议医生在给怀孕或计划怀孕的女性开强力霉素时仔细考虑利益与风险平衡。”

paras.en: Using information from two U.S. insurance databases, the researchers analyzed 224,870 pregnancies in people ages 12 to 55. More than 218,230 of these patients were treated for respiratory tract infections, and over 6,630 were treated for acne, between conception and the end of the first trimester. About 4,385 of the women filled a prescription for doxycycline during that time frame, while the others received an alternative antibiotic.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用两个美国保险数据库的信息，分析了 224,870 名年龄在 12 至 55 岁之间的怀孕患者。其中，在受孕至妊娠前三个月结束期间，其中超过 218,230 名患者接受了呼吸道感染治疗，超过 6,630 名患者接受了痤疮治疗。在此期间，大约 4,385 名女性服用了多西环素处方，而其他女性则接受了替代抗生素。

paras.en: Among women with respiratory infections, those prescribed doxycycline had a 40% to 54% higher risk of pregnancy loss, compared with those prescribed amoxicillin, another broad-spectrum antibiotic in a different class. The exact level of risk varied between the two databases.
paras.zh: 在患有呼吸道感染的女性中，与服用阿莫西林（另一种不同类别的广谱抗生素）的女性相比，服用多西环素的女性流产的风险要高 40% 至 54%。两个数据库的确切风险级别有所不同。

paras.en: The researchers also compared the doxycycline users against women prescribed macrolides, the class of antibiotics that includes azithromycin (or "Z-Pak"). Again, the doxycycline users saw a higher risk — 39% and 36% higher, respectively.
paras.zh: 研究人员还将多西环素使用者与服用大环内酯类药物的女性进行了比较，大环内酯类抗生素包括阿奇霉素（或“Z-Pak”）。同样，多西环素使用者的风险更高——分别高出 39% 和 36%。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Among the patients treated for acne, doxycycline users had a 49% higher risk of pregnancy loss in one database than those given the antibiotic clindamycin. In the second database, though, the difference wasn't statistically significant. Winterstein said that may be because there were fewer patients included in that analysis.
paras.zh: 一项数据库显示，在接受痤疮治疗的患者中，服用多西环素的患者流产的风险比服用抗生素克林霉素的患者高 49%。但在第二个数据库中，差异并不具有统计显着性。温特斯坦说，这可能是因为该分析中纳入的患者较少。

paras.en: Overall, doxycycline was associated with seven to 11 additional pregnancy losses per 100 pregnancies, compared with the other antibiotic options assessed, the researchers reported.
paras.zh: 研究人员报告称，总体而言，与评估的其他抗生素选择相比，每 100 次妊娠中，多西环素会导致 7 至 11 例额外流产。

paras.en: It is not yet clear how the drug might contribute to pregnancy loss. Because the study was observational, it cannot prove that the antibiotic itself caused those losses, which included miscarriages and stillbirths. (Miscarriage is pregnancy loss before 20 weeks of pregnancy, whereas stillbirth refers to pregnancy loss after the 20th week.)
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚该药物如何导致流产。由于该研究是观察性的，因此无法证明抗生素本身造成了这些损失，其中包括流产和死产。 （流产是指怀孕20周之前流产，而死产是指怀孕20周之后流产。）

paras.en: Animal studies hint that doxycycline could interfere with early placental development, potentially making it harder for the placenta to support a growing pregnancy, Luke Grzeskowiak, an associate professor and clinical pharmacist at Flinders University in Australia who was not involved in the study, said in an email.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的澳大利亚弗林德斯大学副教授兼临床药剂师 Luke Grzeskowiak 在一封电子邮件中表示，动物研究表明，多西环素可能会干扰早期胎盘发育，可能使胎盘更难支持妊娠的生长。

paras.en: The study authors also noted in their report that the drug may have direct effects on the developing embryo. But these explanations remain hypothetical; the researchers have not established that either mechanism occurs in humans.
paras.zh: 研究作者还在报告中指出，该药物可能对发育中的胚胎产生直接影响。但这些解释仍然是假设性的。研究人员尚未确定这两种机制是否发生在人类身上。

paras.en: "Pregnancy loss affects around one in four pregnancies and can happen for many reasons," Grzeskowiak noted. Although doxycycline exposure may add to that risk, taking the antibiotic does not necessarily mean pregnancy loss will occur. The available data suggests that it is just one risk factor among many.
paras.zh: 格热斯科维亚克指出：“流产影响了大约四分之一的怀孕，并且发生的原因有很多。”尽管接触多西环素可能会增加这种风险，但服用抗生素并不一定意味着会发生流产。现有数据表明，这只是众多风险因素之一。

paras.en: Because doxycycline may be prescribed before a pregnancy is recognized, doctors should consider the possibility of pregnancy when prescribing this drug to women of reproductive age, particularly those who are sexually active, Grzeskowiak suggested. That does not mean doctors should avoid prescribing the antibiotic to these women, he emphasized; rather, clinicians should consider pregnancy plans and medical history when choosing a treatment.
paras.zh: Grzeskowiak 建议，由于在确认怀孕之前可能会开出多西环素，因此医生在向育龄妇女（尤其是性活跃的妇女）开这种药时应考虑怀孕的可能性。他强调，这并不意味着医生应该避免给这些女性开抗生素。相反，临床医生在选择治疗方法时应考虑怀孕计划和病史。

paras.en: In some cases, doxycycline may still be the best option for a severe infection, Winterstein told Live Science, and that infection could itself put a pregnancy at risk. But for less-serious infections, safer alternatives may be available, she said.
paras.zh: 温特斯坦告诉《生活科学》杂志，在某些情况下，多西环素可能仍然是治疗严重感染的最佳选择，而感染本身可能会使怀孕面临风险。但她说，对于不太严重的感染，可能有更安全的替代方案。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Winterstein, A. G., Chen, H., Thai, T., Wang, Y., Smolinski, N. E., Wen, W., Ewig, C. L., Gilboa, S. M., Meaney-Delman, D., Maro, J. C., & Rasmussen, S. A. (2026). Doxycycline and risk for pregnancy loss: A multi-database, multi-indication cohort study. Annals of Internal Medicine. https://doi.org/10.7326/annals-26-01647
paras.zh: Winterstein, A. G.、Chen, H.、Thai, T.、Wang, Y.、Smolinski, N. E.、Wen, W.、Ewig, C. L.、Gilboa, S. M.、Meaney-Delman, D.、Maro, J. C. 和 Rasmussen, S. A. (2026)。多西环素和流产风险：一项多数据库、多适应症队列研究。内科医学年鉴。 https://doi.org/10.7326/annals-26-01647

paras.en: Isha Ishtiaq is a freelance health journalist based in Pakistan who covers health, medicine and biomedical research. Her work has appeared in Live Science, Science News, and Medscape, among other outlets. She holds a B.S. (Hons) in biotechnology from the University of Gujrat and an M.S. in biological sciences from the University of Sialkot, where her research focused on the use of deep learning models for disease detection.
paras.zh: Isha Ishtiaq 是巴基斯坦的自由健康记者，报道健康、医学和生物医学研究。她的作品曾发表在《Live Science》、《科学新闻》和《Medscape》等媒体上。她拥有学士学位。古吉拉特大学生物技术学士（荣誉）学位和硕士学位她拥有锡亚尔科特大学生物科学博士学位，她的研究重点是使用深度学习模型进行疾病检测。

articles.title: Chinese scientists cool atoms to near absolute zero in record-breaking experiment
articles.author: Elizabeth Howell

paras.en: Scientists have cooled atoms to the coldest temperature ever recorded, using a laser trap aboard China's Tiangong space station.
paras.zh: 科学家利用中国天宫空间站上的激光阱将原子冷却到有记录以来的最低温度。

paras.en: Tiangong included an experiment in which atoms were cooled to 10 picokelvins, which is barely above absolute zero, the coldest theoretical temperature possible in physics. Absolute zero is minus 459.67 degrees Fahrenheit (minus 273.15 degrees Celsius) and the threshold at which all particles in an object are believed to stop moving.
paras.zh: 天宫进行了一项实验，其中原子被冷却到 10 皮开尔文，这几乎不高于绝对零，这是物理学中可能的最冷理论温度。绝对零是负 459.67 华氏度（负 273.15 摄氏度），也是物体中所有粒子被认为停止移动的阈值。

paras.en: Scientists hit the mark using "optical tweezers," known more formally as an optical-dipole trap (ODT), which hold atoms in a laser beam," the scientists reported Nov. 5 in the journal Science.
paras.zh: 科学家们在 11 月 5 日的《科学》杂志上报道说，科学家们使用“光镊子”达到了目的，这种镊子更正式地称为光学偶极子陷阱 (ODT)，它可以将原子固定在激光束中。

paras.en: The team placed 20,000 rubidium atoms in the trap in order to restrict their motion. This reduced motion, along with the weightlessness induced by the low-gravity environment aboard the space station, caused the cloud of atoms to cool to much lower temperatures than are possible on Earth.
paras.zh: 研究小组在陷阱中放置了 20,000 个铷原子，以限制它们的运动。这种减少的运动，加上空间站上低重力环境引起的失重，导致原子云冷却到比地球上低得多的温度。

paras.en: The experiment's results could help improve future space-based research, the team said.
paras.zh: 研究小组表示，该实验的结果可能有助于改善未来的天基研究。

paras.en: "This record-low temperature could stimulate a new generation of ODT-based experiments in quantum simulation and precision measurements in space," the researchers wrote in the paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“这一创纪录的低温可能会刺激新一代基于 ODT 的量子模拟和太空精密测量实验。”

paras.en: Despite this achievement, it's doubtful that scientists could ever hit absolute zero. One interpretation of the third law of thermodynamics, which looks at how systems behave when they approach absolute zero, is that the particles would always have a bit of entropy (disorder) associated with them, making absolute zero unachievable.
paras.zh: 尽管取得了这一成就，但科学家能否达到绝对零仍值得怀疑。热力学第三定律研究系统在接近绝对零时的行为，其一种解释是，粒子总是具有一些与之相关的熵（无序），使得绝对零无法实现。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "One version of the third law states that it would require an infinite number of steps to reach absolute zero, which means you will never get there," Saibal Mitra, a professor of physics at Missouri State University, told Live Science in a 2024 interview.
paras.zh: 密苏里州立大学物理学教授 Saibal Mitra 在 2024 年接受《Live Science》采访时表示：“第三定律的一个版本指出，需要无数步才能达到绝对零，这意味着你永远无法到达那里。”

paras.en: The second law of thermodynamics, which states that entropy always increases, would also be violated if scientists could reach absolute zero, he added. "If you had a heat sink at absolute zero, then you could build a machine that was 100% efficient," Mitra said.
paras.zh: 他补充说，如果科学家能够达到绝对零，热力学第二定律也将违反，该定律规定熵总是增加。 “如果你的散热器绝对为零，那么你就可以建造一台 100% 高效的机器，”Mitra 说。

paras.en: That said, space makes it easier to get close to absolute zero because microgravity allows atoms to "float" and become more efficient at cooling, Science News reported. The researchers took their weightless collection of atoms and created a quantum state of matter known as a Bose-Einstein condensate, in which very cold atoms clump and create a "fifth state" of matter as they behave akin to a single atom.
paras.zh: 据《科学新闻》报道，太空更容易接近绝对零，因为微重力允许原子“漂浮”并变得更有效的冷却。研究人员利用失重的原子集合，创造了一种被称为玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态的物质量子态，其中非常冷的原子聚集在一起，创造出物质的“第五态”，因为它们的行为类似于单个原子。

paras.en: Tiangong's very cold clump follows similar experiments on the International Space Station that reached 52 picokelvins and from a weightless fall induced by a drop from a tall tower, in which atoms hit 38 picokelvins, Science News added.
paras.zh: 《科学新闻》补充说，天宫的非常冷的团块是在国际空间站上进行的类似实验之后产生的，实验温度达到了 52 皮开尔文，并且是从高塔上坠落引起的失重坠落，其中原子的温度达到了 38 皮开尔文。

paras.en: Xiong, W., Li, T., Jin, S., Huang, Q., Wang, B., Li, L., He, Y., Li, X., Chen, D., Song, T., Ji, J., Zhou, C., Lai, C., Zhang, Z., Tian, J., Guo, Y., Yao, H., Hou, X., Liu, L., . . . Chen, X. (2026). Quantum gases below 10 picokelvin in space. Science, eaea5324. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aea5324

paras.en: Elizabeth Howell was staff reporter at Space.com between 2022 and 2024 and a regular contributor to Live Science and Space.com between 2012 and 2022. Elizabeth's reporting includes multiple exclusives with the White House, speaking several times with the International Space Station, witnessing five human spaceflight launches on two continents, flying parabolic, working inside a spacesuit, and participating in a simulated Mars mission. Her latest book, "Why Am I Taller?" (ECW Press, 2022) is co-written with astronaut Dave Williams.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白·豪厄尔 (Elizabeth Howell) 于 2022 年至 2024 年间担任 Space.com 的特约记者，并于 2012 年至 2022 年间为 Live Science 和 Space.com 定期撰稿。伊丽莎白的报道包括白宫的多项独家报道、与国际空间站的多次对话、见证了在两大洲的五次载人航天发射、抛物线飞行、在宇航服内工作以及参与模拟火星任务。她的最新书《为什么我更高？》 （ECW Press，2022 年）与宇航员戴夫·威廉姆斯 (Dave Williams) 共同撰写。

articles.title: Global Fossil Fuel Emissions Are Expected to Drop This Year, Partly Because of the Conflicts in Iran and Ukraine

paras.en: In 2020, humans hunkered down amid the Covid-19 pandemic, contributing to an unprecedented 7 percent decrease in global fossil fuel emissions, according to the Global Carbon Project, an international collaboration that releases annual reports on emissions trends. For the first time since then, emissions are expected to fall again, although to a lesser degree.
paras.zh: 根据全球碳项目（发布排放趋势年度报告的国际合作项目）的数据，2020 年，人类在 Covid-19 大流行中采取了行动，导致全球化石燃料排放量史无前例地减少了 7%。自那时以来，排放量预计将首次再次下降，尽管幅度较小。

paras.en: Global Carbon Project researchers predict that in 2026, countries will have emitted 42.1 billion U.S. tons of planet-warming carbon dioxide, a 0.4 percent decrease compared with the previous year. That’s partly because of growing solar and wind power, but also a surge in oil prices and supply chain issues sparked by the United States-Israel war with Iran.
paras.zh: 全球碳项目研究人员预测，到2026年，各国将排放421亿吨导致地球变暖的二氧化碳，比上一年减少0.4%。部分原因是太阳能和风能的增长，但也有油价飙升以及美以与伊朗战争引发的供应链问题。

paras.en: The team described these findings in a preprint report, which has not been peer-reviewed, released on November 10 in the journal Earth System Data Science. Some of the scientists also published an analysis in the journal Nature Climate Change.
paras.zh: 该团队在 11 月 10 日发表在《地球系统数据科学》杂志上的预印本报告中描述了这些发现，该报告尚未经过同行评审。一些科学家还在《自然气候变化》杂志上发表了分析。

paras.en: “A decline in fossil [carbon dioxide] emissions is encouraging, but a reduction driven partly by geopolitical shocks is not a sustainable climate solution,” says report and study co-author Pierre Friedlingstein, a climate scientist at the University of Exeter in England, in a statement. “The long-term answer remains the rapid deployment of clean energy technologies. While renewables and electric vehicles are increasingly offsetting growth in energy demand, further acceleration is needed if global emissions are to peak and enter a sustained decline.”
paras.zh: “化石[二氧化碳]排放量的下降令人鼓舞，但部分由地缘政治冲击推动的减排并不是可持续的气候解决方案，”报告和研究的合著者、英国埃克塞特大学气候科学家皮埃尔·弗里德林斯坦(Pierre Friedlingstein)在一份声明中表示。 “长期的答案仍然是快速部署清洁能源技术。虽然可再生能源和电动汽车日益抵消能源需求的增长，但如果全球排放量要达到峰值并进入持续下降，就需要进一步加速。”

paras.en: According to Friedlingstein and colleagues’ calculations, emissions from oil and gas are projected to decline this year by 1.9 and 0.3 percent, respectively. However, that’s partially offset by a 0.6 percent rise in emissions from coal. (Burning coal generates more pollution than oil or gas.)
paras.zh: 根据弗里德林斯坦及其同事的计算，今年石油和天然气的排放量预计将分别下降 1.9% 和 0.3%。然而，这被煤炭排放量增加 0.6% 部分抵消。 （燃烧煤炭比石油或天然气产生更多的污染。）

paras.en: Did you know? Atmospheric methane surged
paras.zh: 你可知道？大气中甲烷浓度飙升

paras.en: In 2020, levels of methane—the second-largest contributor to climate change—surprisingly spiked. Earlier this year, researchers reported that the unexpected surge was caused by dynamics in the atmosphere and natural sources of the gas, including wetlands.
paras.zh: 2020 年，导致气候变化的第二大因素——甲烷的含量出人意料地飙升。今年早些时候，研究人员报告说，意外的激增是由大气动态和天然气天然来源（包括湿地）引起的。

paras.en: China emits around one-third of the world’s fossil emissions, making it the country that produces the most carbon dioxide. This year, its emissions declined overall, despite a small bump in coal pollution. That’s likely because China is leading the clean energy transition—it’s responsible for half of global emissions avoided due to renewable energy and electric vehicles.
paras.zh: 中国的化石排放量约占世界的三分之一，是二氧化碳排放量最多的国家。今年，尽管煤炭污染略有增加，但其排放量总体下降。这可能是因为中国正在引领清洁能源转型——全球因可再生能源和电动汽车而避免的排放量有一半是由中国造成的。

paras.en: In the United States, which follows China as a polluter, researchers predict a 1.3 percent decrease in emissions in 2026. That’s mainly thanks to a decrease in coal emissions following a spike last year due to high natural gas prices and cold weather.
paras.zh: 美国是仅次于中国的污染大国，研究人员预测 2026 年排放量将减少 1.3%。这主要是由于去年天然气价格高涨和天气寒冷导致煤炭排放量大幅下降。

paras.en: Emissions from the rest of the world are projected to decline by 0.7 percent, driven largely by lower oil use.
paras.zh: 世界其他地区的排放量预计将下降 0.7%，这主要是由于石油使用量减少所致。

paras.en: “I would call it unexpected,” says study and report co-author Glen Peters, a climate scientist at the Center for International Climate Research in Norway, to Brad Plumer at the New York Times. “It’s pretty rare to see a drop in oil demand this big.”
paras.zh: “我认为这是出乎意料的，”研究和报告的合著者、挪威国际气候研究中心的气候科学家格伦·彼得斯对《纽约时报》的布拉德·普卢默说。 “石油需求下降如此之大是非常罕见的。”

paras.en: The researchers call this an “energy shock,” a short-term response triggered by the war in Iran. The combat zone caused officials to close the Strait of Hormuz, located partially in Iranian waters and a major global chokepoint for oil transportation. That conflict, along with the Russia-Ukraine war, has caused prices for oil and gas to soar worldwide, forcing many countries to turn to domestic fossil or renewable energy sources, reports the Times.
paras.zh: 研究人员称之为“能源冲击”，这是伊朗战争引发的短期反应。该战区导致官员关闭了霍尔木兹海峡，该海峡部分位于伊朗水域，是全球石油运输的主要咽喉要道。据《泰晤士报》报道，这场冲突以及俄罗斯和乌克兰的战争导致全球石油和天然气价格飙升，迫使许多国家转向国内化石或可再生能源。

paras.en: The team emphasizes that this global decline in fossil emissions will not last without structural efforts to tackle emissions, such as deploying more electric vehicles along with solar and wind projects. In the Nature Climate Change paper, the authors estimate that these renewable energy strategies should offset 64 to 79 percent of increasing emissions from now through 2028. Still, that means the transition to clean energy isn’t yet robust enough to offset the anticipated rise in emissions from growing energy demands.
paras.zh: 该团队强调，如果不采取结构性措施来解决排放问题，例如部署更多电动汽车以及太阳能和风能项目，全球化石排放量的下降就不会持续下去。在《自然气候变化》论文中，作者估计，从现在到 2028 年，这些可再生能源战略应该可以抵消 64% 至 79% 的排放量增加。但这意味着向清洁能源的过渡还不足以抵消能源需求不断增长带来的预期排放量增加。

paras.en: “There’s plenty of good news in terms of the rapid expansion of renewables,” says report co-author Mike O’Sullivan, a climate scientist at the University of Exeter, to Simmone Shah at Time. “But on a global scale, it’s completely inadequate.”
paras.zh: 报告合著者、埃克塞特大学气候科学家迈克·奥沙利文在《时代》杂志上向西蒙·沙阿表示：“可再生能源的快速扩张带来了很多好消息。” “但在全球范围内，这是完全不够的。”

articles.title: This Mysterious Combination Lock Sank in a 1583 Shipwreck. When Engineers Cracked the Code, It Clicked Open for the First Time in More Than 400 Years

paras.en: In 1999, Peter Hughes stumbled upon the brass combination lock on Margam Beach in Wales. It featured four rotating dials, each bearing six letters. The dials turned smoothly, but only one of 1,296 possible combinations would open the device.
paras.zh: 1999 年，Peter Hughes 在威尔士马格姆海滩偶然发现了黄铜密码锁。它有四个旋转表盘，每个表盘上有六个字母。转盘转动顺畅，但 1,296 种可能的组合中只有一种可以打开设备。

paras.en: The lock was an artifact from the Ann Francis, a merchant ship that sank in 1583. Hundreds of the vessel’s treasures—including compasses, coins and cannonballs—have since surfaced on the beach. But Hughes was particularly intrigued by the lock. He fiddled with the dials for two decades, trying to solve the puzzle.
paras.zh: 这把锁是 Ann Francis 号商船的文物，这艘商船于 1583 年沉没。船上的数百件财宝，包括指南针、硬币和炮弹，后来在海滩上浮出水面。但休斯对锁特别感兴趣。他摆弄了表盘二十年，试图解决这个难题。

paras.en: Now, researchers have used CT scans to reveal the four-letter code: ANCE. When they tested it out, the lock clicked open for the first time in more than four centuries. “For me, it’s like opening the Ark of the Covenant,” Hughes tells BBC Wales’ Meleri Williams. “I’m delighted—truly thrilled.”
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员使用 CT 扫描揭示了四个字母的代码：ANCE。当他们进行测试时，四个多世纪以来锁首次打开。 “对我来说，这就像打开约柜一样，”休斯告诉 BBC 威尔士的梅莱里·威廉姆斯。 “我很高兴——真的很激动。”

paras.en: The Ann Francis was traveling from Spain to England when a storm swept in on December 28, 1583. The winds blew it off course, and it ultimately wrecked off Margam Beach in southern Wales. According to a parish register, 14 sailors died in December 1583, and these men may have been the Ann Francis’ crew. The record blamed the incident on “the detestable working of an execrable witch.”
paras.zh: 1583 年 12 月 28 日，安·弗朗西斯号正从西班牙驶往英国，这时一场暴风雨席卷而来。大风将其吹离航线，最终在威尔士南部的马格姆海滩失事。根据教区登记册，1583 年 12 月有 14 名水手死亡，这些人可能是安·弗朗西斯号的船员。该记录将这一事件归咎于“一个可恶的女巫的可憎行为”。

paras.en: As word spread, looters descended upon the beach, prompting legal disputes over the rights to the ship’s treasures. A few months after the wreck, Francis Shaxton, the owner of the Ann Francis, claimed the vessel and recovered some of the items.
paras.zh: 随着消息传开，抢劫者纷纷涌向海滩，引发了有关船上财宝权利的法律纠纷。沉船事故发生几个月后，安·弗朗西斯号的船主弗朗西斯·沙克斯顿认领了这艘船，并找回了一些物品。

paras.en: For centuries, many more artifacts remained buried beneath the sand. Hughes, a metal detectorist, made his discoveries between 1996 and 2017, aided by dredging and storms that shifted the beach’s sand. He found the combination lock near coin weights and Spanish silver coins—perhaps items that the lock once protected.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，还有更多的文物被埋在沙子下面。休斯是一名金属探测器员，他在 1996 年至 2017 年间通过疏浚和风暴移动了海滩的沙子，有了他的发现。他在硬币重量和西班牙银币附近发现了密码锁——也许是密码锁曾经保护过的物品。

paras.en: “It’s in fantastic condition. It still has its working parts. All of the letters are really clear,” Siân Iles, a senior curator at Museum Wales, says in a video. “I think it’s human nature when you have a code to crack—that’s what you want to do.”
paras.zh: “它的状况非常好。它仍然有其工作部件。所有字母都非常清晰，”威尔士博物馆高级馆长 Siân Iles 在视频中说道。 “我认为当你有密码需要破解时，这就是人性——这就是你想做的事。”

paras.en: Museum Wales recently acquired Hughes’ trove of artifacts, including the lock. Curators decided to ask researchers at Cardiff University for help identifying the combination. They explained that they had an Elizabethan lock on their hands, but nobody knew how to open it. Would they be able to use micro-CT scanners to peer inside?
paras.zh: 威尔士博物馆最近收购了休斯的一批文物，其中包括这把锁。策展人决定请求卡迪夫大学的研究人员帮助识别这种组合。他们解释说，他们手上有一把伊丽莎白时代的锁，但没有人知道如何打开它。他们能够使用微型 CT 扫描仪来观察内部情况吗？

paras.en: David Williams, a biomechanical engineer at Cardiff University, was intrigued. Normally, he studies how humans move, sometimes using micro-CT scanners to see inside 3D objects on a very small scale. He didn’t know whether the scans would reveal anything useful about the artifact. But he had a few history buffs on his team, and they agreed to try.
paras.zh: 卡迪夫大学的生物力学工程师大卫·威廉姆斯对此很感兴趣。通常，他研究人类如何移动，有时使用微型 CT 扫描仪以非常小的尺寸观察 3D 物体的内部。他不知道扫描是否会揭示有关该文物的任何有用信息。但他的团队中有一些历史爱好者，他们同意尝试一下。

paras.en: “Micro-CT scanning allowed us to look inside the lock without damaging it,” Williams says in a statement. “We normally use this technology to study bones and other biological structures, so investigating a 400-year-old padlock was certainly a first for us!”
paras.zh: “微型 CT 扫描使我们能够在不损坏锁的情况下查看锁的内部，”威廉姆斯在一份声明中说。 “我们通常使用这项技术来研究骨骼和其他生物结构，因此研究一把 400 年历史的挂锁对我们来说无疑是第一次！”

paras.en: When the lock arrived, the researchers conducted an initial scan to determine whether this approach was worth pursuing. When they saw that they could make out letters in the images, they realized the answer might be close at hand.
paras.zh: 当锁到达后，研究人员进行了初步扫描，以确定这种方法是否值得采用。当他们看到可以辨认出图像中的字母时，他们意识到答案可能就在眼前。

paras.en: The team used the scans to determine how the notches on the lock’s dials lined up with the teeth on the key inside them. Unfortunately, the second scan was a bust. The third, however, was much more revealing, suggesting that the long-lost code was ANCE.
paras.zh: 研究小组利用扫描来确定锁表盘上的凹口如何与锁内钥匙上的齿对齐。不幸的是，第二次扫描失败了。然而，第三个则更具启发性，表明失传已久的密码是 ANCE。

paras.en: “After a couple of days’ work, we were able to be fairly confident that what we had was the correct code,” Alastair Willis, a senior curator at the museum, says in the video. “And then when we took the lock back to the museum, we very carefully tried moving the rings in the right combination.” Right away, he noticed that the four dials felt looser. After conservators cleaned out some of the grit that had accumulated, the lock finally clicked open.
paras.zh: “经过几天的工作，我们相当有信心我们拥有的是正确的代码，”博物馆高级馆长阿拉斯泰尔·威利斯在视频中说道。 “然后，当我们把锁带回博物馆时，我们非常仔细地尝试以正确的组合移动环。”立刻，他发现四个转盘感觉更松了。在管理员清理掉一些积聚的沙粒后，锁终于“咔哒”一声打开了。

paras.en: The combination lock is now on display at “Tides of Treasure,” a free exhibition at the National Waterfront Museum in Swansea. The show features other artifacts from the Ann Francis, including a boatswain’s whistle and gold coins dating to Ferdinand and Isabella’s reign.
paras.zh: 该密码锁目前在斯旺西国家海滨博物馆的免费展览“Tides of Treasure”中展出。该展览还展出了安·弗朗西斯号上的其他文物，包括水手长的哨子和斐迪南和伊莎贝拉统治时期的金币。

paras.en: According to a 16th-century inventory of items recovered from the wreck, at least three chests had been aboard the ship. Their locks had been broken, and no objects were found inside. The researchers wonder whether the combination lock protected one of these chests.
paras.zh: 根据 16 世纪从沉船中打捞出的物品清单，船上至少有三个箱子。他们的锁被打破了，里面没有发现任何物品。研究人员想知道密码锁是否保护了其中一个箱子。

paras.en: - According to Museum Wales, a similar combination lock is currently housed at the British Museum.
paras.zh: - 据威尔士博物馆称，大英博物馆目前收藏着一把类似的密码锁。

paras.en: - Found in York, England, this early 17th-century lock features one fixed ring and four rotating dials. The word that opens it is MARCI.
paras.zh: - 这把 17 世纪早期的锁发现于英国约克，具有一个固定环和四个旋转表盘。打开它的词是MARCI。

paras.en: “Elizabethan combination locks are known in Britain, but this one is in exceptionally good condition and is associated with a dated wreck, making it a unique find and the code a tantalizing mystery to solve,” Willis says in the statement. “Of course, now we’ve solved it, we are left wondering if the code meant something to its owner.”
paras.zh: 威利斯在声明中表示：“伊丽莎白密码锁在英国广为人知，但这把锁的状况非常好，而且与一艘古老的沉船有关，这使它成为一个独特的发现，而其密码也成为一个诱人的谜团。” “当然，现在我们已经解决了这个问题，但我们想知道代码对其所有者是否意味着什么。”

paras.en: In addition to the four letters on the rotating dials, the lock features stationary letters on its outer edges. But how these letters align with ANCE is unclear. Whatever the code’s meaning, Hughes thinks the intricately crafted artifact once protected something dear to the owner’s heart.
paras.zh: 除了旋转表盘上的四个字母外，该锁的外边缘还具有固定字母。但这些字母如何与 ANCE 保持一致尚不清楚。无论代码的含义是什么，休斯认为这件制作精良的文物曾经保护过主人心中所珍视的东西。

paras.en: “Tides of Treasure” is on view at the National Waterfront Museum in Swansea, Wales, through June 26, 2027.
paras.zh: “宝藏之潮”将于 2027 年 6 月 26 日在威尔士斯旺西国家海滨博物馆展出。

articles.title: Florida Is Facing Its Worst Dengue Outbreak in Decades, With at Least 524 Locally Acquired Cases. Here's What to Know

paras.en: This year, the Florida Department of Health has recorded a staggering 524 locally acquired cases of dengue, a mosquito-borne viral disease, as of October 31. That’s the highest number recorded there since the disease returned to the state in 2009, according to Forbes’ John Drake. For context, only 62 locally acquired cases were documented in 2025.
paras.zh: 今年，截至 10 月 31 日，佛罗里达州卫生部已记录了惊人的 524 例本地感染登革热病例，这是一种由蚊子传播的病毒性疾病。据《福布斯》杂志的约翰·德雷克 (John Drake) 报道，这是自 2009 年该疾病重返该州以来记录的最高数字。就背景而言，2025 年仅记录了 62 例本地感染病例。

paras.en: Most infected people either do not show symptoms or experience only mild illness. But in early September, a Tampa-area woman named Gay Rabb Small died of dengue on her 80th birthday, after developing a tremor and going to the emergency room, per the New York Times’ Anemona Hartocollis.
paras.zh: 大多数感染者要么没有表现出症状，要么只出现轻微症状。但据《纽约时报》的 Anemona Hartocollis 报道，9 月初，坦帕地区一位名叫盖伊·拉布·斯莫尔 (Gay Rabb Small) 的妇女在 80 岁生日时因出现震颤并被送往急诊室后死于登革热。

paras.en: Later that month, three counties in Florida declared local emergencies over the illness, and in October, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) issued a national emergency response to dengue.
paras.zh: 当月晚些时候，佛罗里达州的三个县宣布当地因该疾病进入紧急状态，十月，疾病控制和预防中心 (CDC) 发布了针对登革热的国家紧急响应。

paras.en: “It is very unusual to have transmission in the United States,” Eva Harris, an infectious diseases expert at the University of California, Berkeley, tells the Times. “This is so very much of an eye-opener.”
paras.zh: 加州大学伯克利分校传染病专家伊娃·哈里斯 (Eva Harris) 告诉《泰晤士报》：“在美国传播病毒是非常不寻常的。” “这真是令人大开眼界。”

paras.en: Dengue is a viral disease spread by mosquitoes, mainly the species Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, which are both present in Florida, among other places. The disease is more common in tropical and subtropical regions, where these biting insects thrive, than in temperate climates.
paras.zh: 登革热是一种由蚊子传播的病毒性疾病，主要是埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊，它们都存在于佛罗里达州等地。这种疾病在这些叮咬昆虫大量繁殖的热带和亚热带地区比在温带气候地区更常见。

paras.en: Around three in four infected people are asymptomatic or have mild flu-like symptoms, such as fever, headache, nausea and rash. Muscle and joint pain is another common symptom, which is why the disease is sometimes called “breakbone fever.” Symptoms usually appear within two weeks of being bitten by an infected mosquito and clear up after a week or two.
paras.zh: 大约四分之三的感染者没有症状或有轻微的流感样症状，如发烧、头痛、恶心和皮疹。肌肉和关节疼痛是另一种常见症状，这就是为什么这种疾病有时被称为“断骨热”。症状通常在被受感染的蚊子叮咬后两周内出现，并在一两周后消失。

paras.en: However, one in four dengue cases becomes severe.
