Those symptoms include extreme abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing and blood in vomit or stool, and anyone experiencing them should seek medical care. These signs often appear after the fever goes away, and people who have previously been infected are at a greater risk of severe dengue.
paras.zh: 然而，四分之一的登革热病例变得严重。这些症状包括极度腹痛、持续呕吐、呼吸急促以及呕吐物或粪便中带血，任何出现这些症状的人都应该寻求医疗护理。这些症状通常在退烧后出现，之前感染过登革热的人患严重登革热的风险更大。

paras.en: Individuals who recover from dengue can continue feeling fatigued for several weeks.
paras.zh: 从登革热中康复的人可能会持续几周感到疲劳。

paras.en: Although dengue vaccines exist, none are currently approved for use in the United States. They’re authorized in nations where the disease is more common, such as Argentina, Brazil, Indonesia and Thailand.
paras.zh: 尽管存在登革热疫苗，但目前尚未批准在美国使用。它们在这种疾病较常见的国家获得了授权，例如阿根廷、巴西、印度尼西亚和泰国。

paras.en: Vaccines are also challenging to develop, because dengue has four distinct but closely related virus types, called 1, 2, 3 and 4. When infected with one type, the body builds up pathogen-fighting antibodies against it, and immunity lasts for life, reports the Associated Press’ Mike Stobbe. But if later infected with a different type of dengue, the antibodies might fail to attack that virus and even help the pathogen enter immune cells and make copies of itself.
paras.zh: 疫苗的开发也具有挑战性，因为登革热有四种不同但密切相关的病毒类型，分别为 1、2、3 和 4。美联社的 Mike Stobbe 报道称，当感染其中一种病毒时，人体会产生抗击病原体的抗体，并且免疫力会持续一生。但如果后来感染了另一种类型的登革热，抗体可能无法攻击该病毒，甚至帮助病原体进入免疫细胞并自我复制。

paras.en: Experts say the best way to protect yourself is to avoid mosquito bites. Cover up with loose-fitting long sleeves and pants, apply insect repellent with DEET and control for mosquitoes in and around your home, such as by removing stagnant water—where young mosquitoes live—and treating your yard with insecticide.
paras.zh: 专家表示，保护自己的最佳方法是避免蚊虫叮咬。穿宽松的长袖衣服和裤子，涂抹含有避蚊胺的驱虫剂，并控制家中和周围的蚊子，例如清除积水（幼蚊居住的地方），并用杀虫剂处理院子。

paras.en: Additionally, there are no specific treatments for dengue. For those with mild symptoms, physicians recommend drinking plenty of fluids and resting. Ill individuals can take acetaminophen to alleviate fever and pain, but they should avoid nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), such as ibuprofen and aspirin, because they can increase the risk of bleeding.
paras.zh: 此外，登革热没有具体的治疗方法。对于症状较轻的人，医生建议多喝水并休息。病人可以服用对乙酰氨基酚来缓解发烧和疼痛，但应避免使用非甾体抗炎药 (NSAID)，例如布洛芬和阿司匹林，因为它们会增加出血风险。

paras.en: People with severe dengue might need oral or intravenous fluids or even blood transfusions.
paras.zh: 患有严重登革热的人可能需要口服或静脉输液，甚至输血。

paras.en: Why is dengue so bad in Florida this year?
paras.zh: 为什么今年佛罗里达州登革热如此严重？

paras.en: Historically, most U.S. cases of dengue have come from travel to other countries or U.S. territories. Southern Florida has hosted many of them, because it’s a transit hub that welcomes lots of travelers from Puerto Rico and other locations where the disease is prevalent, says Dawn Wesson, an infectious diseases researcher at Tulane University, to the AP. In fact, the state has reported 382 travel-associated cases of dengue in 2026, as of October 31.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，美国大多数登革热病例都来自前往其他国家或美国领土的旅行。杜兰大学传染病研究员道恩·韦森 (Dawn Wesson) 向美联社表示，南佛罗里达州接待了其中的许多人，因为它是一个交通枢纽，欢迎来自波多黎各和其他疾病流行地区的大量旅客。事实上，截至 10 月 31 日，该州已报告 2026 年发生 382 例与旅行相关的登革热病例。

paras.en: Quick fact: Previous largest statewide outbreak
paras.zh: 事实速览：之前最大规模的全州疫情爆发

paras.en: Before Florida’s current dengue outbreak, the largest statewide one occurred in Hawaii. Health officials there recorded 264 locally acquired cases in a six-month stretch from 2015 to 2016.
paras.zh: 在佛罗里达州当前的登革热爆发之前，全州最大的一次登革热发生在夏威夷。那里的卫生官员在 2015 年至 2016 年的六个月内记录了 264 例本地感染病例。

paras.en: However, that means locally acquired cases have outpaced travel-linked ones this year, and many infections have shown up in the central part of the state. Researchers are still trying to figure out what’s behind the trend, per the Times.
paras.zh: 然而，这意味着今年本地感染病例超过了旅行相关病例，而且许多感染病例出现在该州中部地区。据《泰晤士报》报道，研究人员仍在试图找出这一趋势背后的原因。

paras.en: Rainstorms have recently flooded parking lots and playgrounds in Southern Florida, which could potentially help mosquitoes lay eggs, multiply and continue spreading dengue. Additionally, climate change is continuing to make the state a warmer and wetter place, creating an even more ideal environment for the disease-carrying creatures.
paras.zh: 最近，暴雨淹没了佛罗里达州南部的停车场和游乐场，这可能会帮助蚊子产卵、繁殖并继续传播登革热。此外，气候变化继续使该州变得更加温暖和湿润，为携带疾病的生物创造了更加理想的环境。

paras.en: “I think the dengue outbreaks will get worse over the coming years in the U.S.,” Ira Longini, a biostatistician at the University of Florida, tells the Times.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达大学生物统计学家伊拉·朗吉尼 (Ira Longini) 告诉《泰晤士报》：“我认为未来几年美国的登革热疫情将会变得更加严重。”

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s $470 Billion Affair
articles.author: Brian Barrett, Zoë Schiffer, Leah Feiger

paras.en: This week, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, a businesswoman US intelligence says was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security. On Uncanny Valley, Brian Barrett, Zoë Schiffer, and Leah Feiger break down what this means for Nvidia, for the AI industry, and for the chip export controls Huang has long pushed back against. Plus, now that the Democrats have swept the midterms, white nationalists, Christian nationalists, and the Proud Boys are declaring the MAGA movement dead and saying the Republican Party is theirs for the taking.
paras.zh: 本周，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与美国情报部门称被中国国家安全部招募的女商人爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）有染。在《恐怖谷》中，布莱恩·巴雷特 (Brian Barrett)、佐伊·希弗 (Zoë Schiffer) 和利亚·费格 (Leah Feiger) 分析了这对 Nvidia、人工智能行业以及黄仁勋长期以来反对的芯片出口管制意味着什么。另外，既然民主党在中期选举中大获全胜，白人民族主义者、基督教民族主义者和骄傲男孩们都宣布 MAGA 运动死亡，并表示共和党是他们的天下。

paras.en: - Jensen Huang Hired a PR Firm Known for Handling Sex Scandals Last Year
paras.zh: - 黄仁勋去年聘请了一家以处理性丑闻而闻名的公关公司

paras.en: - Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling
paras.zh: ——黄仁勋的麻烦让人工智能行业陷入困境

paras.en: - ‘We Have to Take Over’: Far-Right Extremists Want to Seize Control of the GOP
paras.zh: - “我们必须接管”：极右极端分子想要夺取共和党的控制权

paras.en: You can follow Brian Barrett on Bluesky at @brbarrett, Zoë Schiffer on Bluesky at @zoeschiffer, and Leah Feiger on Bluesky at @leahfeiger. Write to us at [email protected].
paras.zh: 您可以通过 @brbarrett 关注 Bluesky 上的 Brian Barrett，通过 @zoeschiffer 关注 Bluesky 上的 Zoë Schiffer，以及通过 @leahfeiger 关注 Bluesky 上的 Leah Feiger。请通过 [email protected] 给我们写信。

paras.en: If you're on an iPhone or iPad, open the app called Podcasts, or just tap this link. You can also download an app like Overcast or Pocket Casts and search for “uncanny valley.” We’re on Spotify too.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 iPhone 或 iPad，请打开名为“播客”的应用程序，或者只需点击此链接。您还可以下载 Overcast 或 Pocket Casts 等应用程序，然后搜索“恐怖谷”。我们也在 Spotify 上。

paras.en: Note: This is an automated transcript, which may contain errors.
paras.zh: 注意：这是一个自动记录，可能包含错误。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: Welcome to WIRED's Uncanny Valley. I'm Brian Barrett, executive editor.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：欢迎来到《连线》的恐怖谷。我是布赖恩·巴雷特，执行主编。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: I'm Zoë Schiffer, contributing editor.
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：我是 Zoë Schiffer，特约编辑。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: And I'm Leah Feiger, director of politics and science.
paras.zh: 利亚·费格：我是政治和科学主任利亚·费格。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: This week, we're getting into the scandal that has had everyone talking. On Sunday, Nvidia CEO, Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with a businesswoman who US intelligence says is also a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗（Zoë Schiffer）：本周，我们将陷入所有人都在议论的丑闻。周日，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名女商人有染，美国情报部门称这名女商人也是中国间谍。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: The affair has brought up all kinds of questions from what information might have been linked to China to why the White House was previously warned about the relationship but didn't do much about it seemingly. We're taking a step back and discussing what this whole mess means for the AI industry at large and for the future of the chip export controls that Jensen Huang has pushed back against for so long.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：这件事引发了各种各样的问题，从哪些信息可能与中国有关，到为什么白宫之前就收到了关于这种关系的警告，但似乎没有采取太多行动。我们退后一步，讨论整个混乱对整个人工智能行业以及黄仁勋长期以来一直反对的芯片出口管制的未来意味着什么。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: And after last week's democratic sweep in the midterms, you would think that the far-right would be hiding in the corner, licking their wounds. And they did for about a week, but that's all. Instead, now white nationalists, Christian nationalists, and the Proud Boys have declared that the MAGA movement is dead and the Republican Party is theirs for the taking. We're going to get into what these groups are saying and why they see the election results as an opportunity.
paras.zh: 利亚·费格：上周民主在中期选举中大获全胜之后，你可能会认为极右翼分子会躲在角落里舔舐伤口。他们这样做了大约一周，但仅此而已。相反，现在白人民族主义者、基督教民族主义者和骄傲男孩宣称“MAGA”运动已经死亡，共和党是他们的了。我们将了解这些团体的言论以及他们为何将选举结果视为一次机会。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: OK. So this past weekend, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang sent a message to his employees that no CEO ever wants to write. He admitted basically that he has been having an affair with this woman, Alice Huang. Same last name, no relation. I keep laughing at that. I'm like, the only way this scandal could be more insane is if they were second cousins or something, but in fact, no.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：好的。因此，上周末，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋向他的员工发出了一条没有首席执行官愿意写的信息。他基本上承认自己和这个女人Alice Huang有染。同姓，无血缘关系。我对此一直在笑。我想，如果他们是远房表兄弟之类的，这起丑闻可能会变得更加疯狂，但事实上，不是。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: And this is not something people care about necessarily, but it does make writing these stories a little bit trickier because you have to sort of switch back to first names for a while. Anyway, yes, but not the point.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：这不一定是人们关心的事情，但这确实让写这些故事变得有点棘手，因为你必须暂时切换回名字。无论如何，是的，但不是重点。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: I feel like it's fairly obvious that they're not related. However, yeah, I guess you do need to say it out loud. The New York Times has been reporting for weeks that US intelligence identified she was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security, basically they're like CIA, to gather information on him. Nvidia's board has now opened an investigation into this incident and Huang is absolutely staying in charge, at least for now while this all plays out. But this whole saga has been both a very embarrassing PR nightmare with potential national security consequences, and it has the company on track to lose more than $470 billion in market value over just two days.
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：我觉得很明显他们没有关系。但是，是的，我想你确实需要大声说出来。 《纽约时报》几周来一直报道称，美国情报机构确定她是被中国国家安全部招募的，基本上他们就像中央情报局一样，收集有关他的信息。英伟达董事会现已对这一事件展开调查，黄仁勋绝对会继续负责，至少目前这一切都还在继续。但这整个事件不仅是一场非常尴尬的公关噩梦，还可能带来国家安全后果，而且该公司有望在短短两天内损失超过 4700 亿美元的市值。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: It's an unbelievable amount of money for an also unbelievable story. Honeypotting in this day and age, incredible stuff. Zoë, I'm sorry to be this person, but can you take us through year by year what we knew, when we knew it? Because this whole scandal didn't just break in the last couple of days.
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：对于一个同样令人难以置信的故事来说，这是一笔令人难以置信的资金。在当今时代，蜜罐是不可思议的事情。 Zoë，我很抱歉成为这个人，但是你能带领我们年复一年地了解我们所知道的事情吗？因为这整个丑闻并不是最近几天才爆发的。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: Let me go back to 2023. This is when Megaspeed, the company that Alice Huang is in charge of, was created and it splits off from a Chinese gaming company just a few months after the US began restricting advanced chip exports to China. And the reason that this is important is a couple things. Number one, Malaysia where this company is operating out of, almost immediately when the export controls become a thing is identified as a very obvious loophole. Malaysia doesn't have a big AI industry, so if you see big data centers cropping up and they're full of Nvidia chips, you can be sure that those chips are actually on their way to China. And in fact, it looks like most people in Silicon Valley and in the Trump administration were aware of this and it just wasn't a huge deal. The other thing that's worth saying is that Alice Huang was a former TV journalist. This is not someone with a computer science background. It's not the person you would expect to be in charge of a company that becomes a very big part, a very important part of Nvidia's business. So in 2024, Jensen begins appearing in public with Alice Huang. Around this time, they're photographed together multiple times. Their body language is a little bit funny. So there are whispers starting at least inside the company. And again, Megaspeed begins multi-billion dollar purchases of advanced Nvidia chips, which looks a little suss. And I think it's very, very, very difficult, some might say impossible to imagine that Jensen isn't fully aware of where the chips are headed.
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：让我回到2023年。当时，Alice Huang负责的Megaspeed公司成立，并在美国开始限制对华先进芯片出口几个月后，从一家中国游戏公司中分拆出来。这很重要的原因有几个。第一，该公司所在的马来西亚，几乎在出口管制成为一件事的同时就被认定为一个非常明显的漏洞。马来西亚没有大型的人工智能产业，所以如果你看到大型数据中心突然出现并且里面装满了英伟达芯片，你可以确定这些芯片实际上正在运往中国。事实上，看起来硅谷和特朗普政府的大多数人都意识到了这一点，而且这没什么大不了的。另一件值得一提的是，黄爱丽曾是一名电视记者。这不是具有计算机科学背景的人。你所期望的领导者不会成为英伟达业务中非常大、非常重要的一部分。因此，2024 年，Jensen 开始与 Alice Huang 一起出现在公共场合。大约在这个时候，他们被多次拍到在一起 次。他们的肢体语言有点有趣。所以至少在公司内部开始有一些窃窃私语。 Megaspeed 再次开始斥资数十亿美元购买先进的 Nvidia 芯片，这看起来有点可疑。我认为这非常非常困难，有些人可能会说不可能想象詹森不完全了解芯片的发展方向。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: Yeah. Well, and he also has been very vocal about saying, "I think China should have chips." He doesn't feel any... Yeah.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：是的。嗯，他也一直非常直言不讳地说，“我认为中国应该有芯片。”他没有任何感觉……是的。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: Few AI executives have had as much sway over Trump's approach to AI and China as Huang, and he's made his position incredibly clear multiple times.
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：很少有人工智能高管能像黄仁勋那样对特朗普对人工智能和中国的态度产生如此大的影响力，而且他多次明确地表达了自己的立场。

paras.en: Jensen Huang, archival audio: I did my best to inform the policymakers in the United States of the importance of engaging the Chinese market and making sure that we serve that market for as long as we can. I've been very clear that even though although we compete against China, they're not our enemies. If we care deeply about the safety of the world with respect to artificial intelligence, then of course we must open dialogues. We must work with them in every possible way.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋，档案音频：我尽力告知美国决策者参与中国市场并确保我们尽可能长时间地服务于该市场的重要性。我非常清楚，尽管我们与中国竞争，但他们不是我们的敌人。如果我们非常关心世界在人工智能方面的安全，那么我们当然必须开展对话。我们必须以一切可能的方式与他们合作。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: He was vocal about this before he and Alice knew each other.
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：在他和爱丽丝认识之前，他就直言不讳地谈论过这一点。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: This is a core part of his belief system. The two theories are either you sell advanced chips to China and thus China becomes reliant on US chips and maybe they don't build their own industry or you don't and you hope that you kneecap them in the short term and your AI industry is able to stay far enough ahead that it's not a huge problem. But Jensen had a very legitimate, I think, argument here. Obviously now he's never allowed to talk about export controls ever again because he's going to look-
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：这是他信仰体系的核心部分。这两种理论是，要么你向中国出售先进芯片，从而中国变得依赖美国芯片，也许他们不建立自己的产业，要么你不建立自己的产业，你希望在短期内击败他们，而你的人工智能产业能够保持足够的领先地位，这不是一个大问题。但我认为詹森在这里有一个非常合理的论点。显然，现在他再也不允许谈论出口管制，因为他会-

paras.en: Brian Barrett: I bet he will though. I bet he will.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：我打赌他会的。我打赌他会的。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: I mean, maybe. Yeah. But it's like China does do this. They make competitive hardware all the time and then underprice it, and so it harms US industry. And I think that in addition to this being a very good business play, Nvidia could have doubled its business because China is going through the same data center build out that the US is. He also had a national security argument that wasn't totally farfetched.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：我的意思是，也许吧。是的。但中国好像确实这么做了。他们一直在制造有竞争力的硬件，然后压低价格，这损害了美国工业。我认为，除了这是一项非常好的商业活动之外，英伟达还可以将其业务增加一倍，因为中国正在建设与美国相同的数据中心。他还有一个国家安全论点，这一论点并非完全牵强。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: I think too, and I think he also, I've heard him argue, it's a related point, but I think if China builds their own competitive chips, then they'll build their own whole tech stack and you'll have this entire world of AI that is largely open source, open weight, broadly accessible that the US is totally shut out of because it's not just Nvidia chips, it's everything around them. Setting the merits of it aside, the point is it's not like Alice Huang said, "Hey Jensen, have you heard about China?" That's not what this is.
paras.zh: Brian Barrett：我也这么认为，我也认为他也是，我听他说过，这是一个相关的观点，但我认为如果中国制造自己的有竞争力的芯片，那么他们将构建自己的整个技术堆栈，你将拥有整个人工智能世界，它基本上是开源的、开放的、广泛访问的，而美国完全被排除在外，因为它不仅仅是英伟达芯片，而是它们周围的一切。抛开其优点不谈，关键是这并不像 Alice Huang 所说的那样，“嘿 Jensen，你听说过中国吗？”事实并非如此。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: Certainly not. And I think there's a lot of different facets of these arguments, but one that you hear with the open source angle a lot is China will be able to spread its Chinese AI around the world and gain influence by making a bunch of other countries dependent on their technology instead of US technology. And that in and of itself would be a big threat.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：当然不是。我认为这些争论有很多不同的方面，但你从开源角度经常听到的一个观点是，中国将能够在世界各地传播其中国人工智能，并通过让其他一些国家依赖他们的技术而不是美国技术来获得影响力。这本身就是一个巨大的威胁。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: I think you really can't overstate the importance of Jensen Huang with the China conversation in the US. He is not only the leading voice, I think he's one of the only prominent voices among Silicon Valley CEOs who has taken this stance of, "We should work closely with them." Everybody else is running the other direction as fast as they can. Between that and the Democrats coming in, I really do wonder what this is going to mean for our relationship with China. I assume nothing great. I assume when you lose a voice like that ... Trump is still swayable probably, but who's there to sway him?
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：我认为黄仁勋在美国中国对话中的重要性怎么强调都不为过。他不仅是主要声音，我认为他是硅谷首席执行官中唯一采取“我们应该与他们密切合作”立场的杰出声音之一。其他人都以最快的速度朝另一个方向跑。再加上民主党的介入，我真的很想知道这对我们与中国的关系意味着什么。我认为没什么了不起的。我想当你失去这样的声音时……特朗普可能仍然可以左右，但谁能左右他呢？

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: Yeah. And to be clear, China has already come out and said that Alice is not a Chinese spy, and how dare anyone suggest otherwise.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：是的。需要明确的是，中国已经站出来表示爱丽丝不是中国间谍，谁敢提出不同的建议。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: Can we talk about the Marco Rubio thing of it all?
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：我们能谈谈 Marco Rubio 的事情吗？

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: Yeah, so this is the question. So during Trump's latest return to the White House, he and Jensen become quite close. And this is a switch for Jensen who previously wasn't political. You had other CEOs, Mark Zuckerberg, Sam Altman, who were known liberals, Democrats, and then made a big switch with Trump's return to the White House. Jensen wasn't like that. He was apolitical and then decided to go all in on Trump and they seemingly became quite close. And behind the scenes, Jensen is advocating for his point of view. He wants special exemptions so that he can sell chips to China. He certainly doesn't want Trump cracking down on the Malaysia of it all, this obvious loophole in the export controls. And this makes people like Marco Rubio and other China hawks not so happy with Jensen, to say the very least. And so at some point the government becomes aware that there is this affair going on and Marco Rubio drafts a memo that starts circulating around the White House basically saying, "Hey, this is happening and we think that it's a problem." We don't know who, but someone takes that opportunity to leak the memo to the press and make Jensen look really bad. And the timing of this is crucial because Jensen is more vulnerable in this moment, I think, than he has been in recent past because Democrats just took the House. And so while previously Elizabeth Warren asked him to come testify before the Senate Banking Committee and he essentially said, "No, thank you." I think it's fair to imagine that he's not going to have that option again.
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：是的，这就是问题所在。因此，在特朗普最近重返白宫期间，他和詹森变得非常亲密。对于以前不涉足政治的詹森来说，这是一个转变。还有其他首席执行官，马克·扎克伯格、山姆·奥尔特曼，他们都是众所周知的自由派、民主党人，然后随着特朗普重返白宫而做出了重大转变。詹森不是那样的人。他对政治不感兴趣，然后决定全力支持特朗普，他们似乎变得非常亲密。在幕后，詹森正在倡导他的观点。他希望获得特殊豁免，以便可以向中国出售芯片。他当然不希望特朗普严厉打击马来西亚，这是出口管制中明显的漏洞。至少可以说，这使得马可·卢比奥和其他对华鹰派人士对詹森不太满意。因此，在某个时候，政府意识到这件事正在发生，马可·鲁比奥起草了一份备忘录，开始在白宫流传，基本上说，“嘿，这件事正在发生，我们认为这是一个问题。”我们不知道是谁，但有人利用这个机会向媒体泄露了这份备忘录，让 Jensen 看起来非常糟糕。以及时间安排 这一点至关重要，因为我认为，詹森此时此刻比他最近因为民主党刚刚拿下众议院而更加脆弱。因此，此前伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 要求他到参议院银行委员会作证，而他基本上说：“不，谢谢。”我认为可以合理地想象他不会再有这种选择了。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: And in fact, he's been invited to a closed door briefing by three Republican house committee chairs on November 18th, so that may be coming sooner than later.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：事实上，三名共和党内务委员会主席邀请他参加 11 月 18 日举行的闭门简报会，所以这可能是迟早的事情。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: Let's talk next CEO. Have there been any rumors or conversations about who would take over?
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：我们来谈谈下一位首席执行官。是否有任何关于谁将接任的谣言或对话？

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: No, I don't think there's an obvious name. I mean, I've been talking to a lot of people in Silicon Valley about this this week, and I have yet to find a CEO who's like, "They should get rid of Jensen." But, almost everyone has been like, "It is such a red flag that he didn't see the obvious red flags of this random TV journalist who's in charge of this seemingly shell company that is obviously selling chips to China." The whole thing is just incredibly irresponsible at the very, very least. And I think that that's going to continue to come up.
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：不，我认为没有一个明显的名字。我的意思是，本周我一直在与硅谷的很多人谈论这个问题，但我还没有找到一位首席执行官会说“他们应该摆脱詹森”。但是，几乎每个人都说，“这是一个危险信号，他没有看到这个随机电视记者的明显危险信号，他负责这家看似空壳公司，显然正在向中国出售芯片。”整件事至少是极其不负责任的。我认为这种情况将会继续出现。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: I think one thing I keep going back to, which is maybe slightly related, is that Nvidia, it is such a different company than it was five years ago, four years ago. For almost 30 of the years he's talking about, he was building a really great GPUs for gaming laptops business. And it's only in the last three years that he has ascended to the top of the mountain because those chips happen to also be very good for AI.
paras.zh: Brian Barrett：我认为我不断回顾的一件事（可能略有相关）是 Nvidia，它与五年前、四年前相比是一家非常不同的公司。在他所说的近 30 年里，他一直在为游戏笔记本电脑业务打造真正出色的 GPU。直到最近三年，他才登上了山顶，因为这些芯片恰好对人工智能也非常有用。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: Well, yes. And he did make a bet that that was going to be a really important business and that bet enormously paid off.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：嗯，是的。他确实打赌这将是一项非常重要的业务，而且这个赌注得到了巨大的回报。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: But when you talk to people in Silicon Valley who worked at Nvidia 10 years ago, they will be like, "I worked for lame Nvidia. I worked for Nvidia when the stock was like ... " They always differentiate the people who work for this phase of the company, which is explosive growth, leading ... It's worth what? $4 trillion. It's leading the AI industry. Jensen, until this moment, could do absolutely no wrong. And the company before that was, like Brian said, making gaming chips and was like, "What? Who?"
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：但是当你和 10 年前在 Nvidia 工作过的硅谷人交谈时，他们会说，“我在蹩脚的 Nvidia 工作过。我在 Nvidia 工作的时候，股票就像......”他们总是区分在公司这个阶段工作的人，这是爆炸性增长，领先......它的价值是什么？ 4万亿美元。它正在引领人工智能行业。 Jensen，直到这一刻，绝对不会做错事。正如布莱恩所说，在那之前的公司是生产游戏芯片的，当时的情况是，“什么？谁？”

paras.en: Brian Barrett: Yeah. Not taking away anything from him. He proactively made that bet and is responsible for Nvidia's success. It is just, I remember lame Nvidia, and to see all of this happening to new Nvidia boggles the mind.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：是的。没有夺走他的任何东西。他主动做出了这个赌注，并对英伟达的成功负有责任。只是，我记得英伟达很蹩脚，看到这一切发生在新的英伟达身上，真是令人难以置信。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: We have to talk about ... I know that last week, again, shout out to the politics team. Everyone came on over. We wrenched the episode away from you two and discussed all sorts of midterms results, including how the country has really apparently turned away from Silicon Valley. It's been sort of amazing over the last week to watch everyone fully feel their reactions to all of this. Shout out to Palantir CEO Alex Karp, who is now a Democrat once more. Everyone's feeling things is all I have to say. But I would have to add that one of my favorite storylines that WIRED is staying on top of is white nationalists and extremists seeing this as a massive opportunity. So on election day last week, white nationalist Nick Fuentes, can't believe we're still saying his name in this day and age, he urged his supporters on X to quote, "Get out and vote Democrat." The post racked up over 12 million views and hours later when the Democrats performed so well, Fuentes took credit for the victory writing, "We did it again," on Telegram. And he later called it the groyper effect in reference to the nickname given to his followers. He sees the Democratic Party winning as part of a larger strategy for the far right to take over. He's not the only one that felt this way. David Gilbert, senior politics at WIRED, reviewed a number of comments from white supremacists, Christian nationalists, other far-right groups in the wake of the midterm results that shows much of the same. These groups basically said that Donald Trump did not go far enough. That's why they didn't win. But now that they didn't win, this is a way for them to get back in the saddle. I know that this logic is a little bit weird here, but stay with me. There is part of it that I look at and I go, "Yeah, of course there's an opportunity for them." In the last year and a half of Donald Trump being in office, you didn't really need the Proud Boys terrorizing immigrants on the street. You had ICE. You did not need a variety of rights being taken away from trans people. That was happening in the DOJ. So many different platforms that these groups espouse were being taken over by the Trump administration themselves, which they had promised these groups in effect. So all of these folks have been sort of sitting idly by, hanging out, talking to each other online with not a whole lot to do, which in theory sounds nice except for the fact that all a white supremacist really wants is to be needed, it turns out. And now the call to action is here.
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：我们必须谈论……我知道上周再次向政治团队大声疾呼。大家都过来了。我们把这件事从你们两个身上夺走了，并讨论了各种中期选举结果，包括这个国家如何明显地远离硅谷。在过去的一周里，看到每个人都充分感受到他们对这一切的反应，真是令人惊奇。向 Palantir 首席执行官 Alex Karp 致敬，他现在再次成为民主党人。大家的感受就是我要说的。但我必须补充一点，《连线》杂志最喜欢的故事情节之一是白人民族主义者和极端主义者认为这是一个巨大的机会。因此，在上周的选举日，白人民族主义者尼克·富恩特斯（Nick Fuentes）不敢相信我们在这个时代还在喊他的名字，他在 X 上敦促他的支持者引用：“出去投票给民主党。”这篇帖子的浏览量超过了 1200 万次，几个小时后，当民主党表现如此出色时，富恩特斯在 Telegram 上写道：“我们再次做到了”，将胜利归功于自己。后来他根据给他的追随者的昵称，将其称为“格罗珀效应”。他认为民主党的胜利是更大范围内的一部分 极右势力接管的战略。他并不是唯一一个有这种感觉的人。 《连线》杂志的高级政治人物大卫·吉尔伯特（David Gilbert）回顾了白人至上主义者、基督教民族主义者和其他极右团体在中期选举结果显示的大部分相同内容后发表的评论。这些团体基本上表示唐纳德·特朗普做得还不够。这就是他们没有获胜的原因。但现在他们没有获胜，这是他们重新坐上马鞍的一种方式。我知道这个逻辑有点奇怪，但请听我说。我看到了其中的一部分，然后说道：“是的，他们当然有机会。”在唐纳德·特朗普执政的最后一年半里，你真的不需要骄傲男孩在街上恐吓移民。你有 ICE。你不需要剥夺跨性别者的各种权利。这就是司法部发生的事情。这些团体所拥护的许多不同平台正在被特朗普政府本身接管，而特朗普政府实际上已经向这些团体做出了承诺。因此，所有这些人都无所事事地坐着，闲逛，在网上互相交谈，没有太多事情可做，这在理论上听起来 事实证明，这很好，只是白人至上主义者真正想要的只是被需要。现在我们呼吁采取行动。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: My first question is you mentioned opportunity and they see this as an opportunity for whatever. These people are also ... How much of it is Nick Fuentes and his ilk seeing an opportunity for their movement versus an opportunity to draw attention to themselves, which is what so often this is about? You know what I mean? How do we separate that out?
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：我的第一个问题是你提到的机会，他们认为这是一个机会。这些人还……尼克·富恩特斯之流在多大程度上看到了他们运动的机会，而不是吸引人们注意的机会，而这往往是关于这一点的？你知道我的意思？我们如何将其分开？

paras.en: Leah Feiger: For sure. I mean, look, I don't think we're going to be able to for a while, but you're absolutely right because there, again, has been no need to call attention to their play. The Proud Boys are like, "Guys, immigrants suck." And the entire Trump administration is like, "We're with you. This is not new info." So the idea of drawing attention, perhaps getting more supporters from people who are so devastated from this democratic sweep is part and parcel of the plan here.
paras.zh: 利亚·费格：当然。我的意思是，听着，我认为我们暂时无法做到这一点，但你是绝对正确的，因为没有必要再引起人们对他们比赛的关注。骄傲男孩们就像是，“伙计们，移民很糟糕。”整个特朗普政府都在说，“我们和你站在一起。这不是新信息。”因此，吸引关注的想法，或许从那些因民主大扫除而深受打击的人们那里获得更多支持，是这里计划的重要组成部分。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: But wait, just so I understand the "plan," their theory is that they're going to help?? Democrats get elected, then Democrats will screw up their experience of being in power and thus people will be more disillusioned. And in the meantime, they'll be taking over the void that was left by the MAGA movement. And so then when they go to the right again, they'll be going to the Proud Boys. Is that...
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：但是等等，就我理解这个“计划”而言，他们的理论是他们会提供帮助？民主党当选，那么民主党就会搞砸他们的执政经历，从而让人们更加幻灭。与此同时，他们将填补 MAGA 运动留下的空白。因此，当他们再次向右走时，他们将前往“骄傲男孩”。难道是……

paras.en: Leah Feiger: That's basically it, minus the part at the beginning about them "helping Democrats take over." I'm not giving them any sort of credit for that. This is just Nick Fuentes speaking.
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：基本上就是这样，减去开头关于他们“帮助民主党接管”的部分。我不会为此给予他们任何荣誉。这是尼克·富恩特斯的发言。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: Right. I'm just trying to understand their logic.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：对。我只是想理解他们的逻辑。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: It's either tremendous cope or 5D chess, and I think I know what side I'm coming down on. Yeah, obviously.
paras.zh: Brian Barrett：要么是巨大的应对，要么是 5D 国际象棋，我想我知道我站在哪一边。是的，显然。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: Yeah. 5D chess. It's 5D chess. And that's 100 percent true, but I do want to talk about this other stat that I'm going to spend a little bit of time thinking about in the coming weeks. And I think that we're all going to have to contend with it a little bit, which is that many extremist candidates still won their seats. While some of the Republican parties, extremist candidates were rejected, the Institute for Research and Education on Human Rights was tracking 535 candidates in statewide races who are members of at least one far right Facebook group. So I'm not even just talking about tweeted something one time. No, no, no. They are members of these various groups.
paras.zh: 利亚·费格：是的。 5D国际象棋。这是5D国际象棋。这是 100% 正确的，但我确实想谈谈另一个统计数据，我将在接下来的几周内花一点时间思考这个统计数据。我认为我们都将不得不面对这个问题，即许多极端主义候选人仍然赢得了席位。虽然一些共和党极端主义候选人被拒绝，但人权研究与教育研究所正在追踪全州竞选中的 535 名候选人，这些候选人至少是一个极右 Facebook 群组的成员。所以我什至不只是谈论一次发过推文。不，不，不。他们是这些不同群体的成员。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: And still using Facebook.
paras.zh: Brian Barrett：并且仍在使用 Facebook。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: Which should be disqualifying in some way.
paras.zh: Brian Barrett：这在某种程度上应该是取消资格的。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: The biggest red flag of all.
paras.zh: Zoë Schiffer：最大的危险信号。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: Of the 476 races that were called by last Friday, we now have more that have been called. It's just been taking everyone a while to kind of pull everything together. 338 of those candidates won, which is a 71 percent win rate. To be clear, the vast majority of these races saw GOP incumbents keep their seats. These were GOP-heavy arenas, which is all just to say though that extremism didn't necessarily go anywhere, even if part of this is perhaps going to be taking a little bit of a winding direction. The reason I think this is interesting, and we have to discuss it at all, even if it is cope or 5D chess, is 2028 is around the corner. And if any of these groups are able to mobilize in any sort of way, link up with election denial folks and actually get re-inspired by MAGA in general, if, big if, 2028 could look a little bit different than Democrats want it to.
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：在上周五宣布的 476 场比赛中，我们现在已经宣布了更多比赛。每个人都花了一段时间才把所有事情整合到一起。其中 338 名候选人获胜，胜率达 71%。需要明确的是，在这些竞选中，绝大多数共和党现任议员保住了自己的席位。这些都是共和党占主导地位的舞台，这只是说极端主义不一定会蔓延到任何地方，即使其中一部分可能会采取一些曲折的方向。我认为这很有趣，我们必须讨论它的原因，即使是应对或 5D 国际象棋，是 2028 年即将到来。如果这些团体中的任何一个能够以任何方式动员起来，与否认选举的人联系起来，并真正从总体上重新受到“MAGA”的启发，如果，如果，很重要的话，2028 年可能会与民主党希望的有所不同。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: OK. I'm just going to say before we end this segment that, boy, was I wrong about what was going to happen during the election. Every time I have a hot take as a journalist, it turns out poorly for me. I'm so happy I'm not that kind of journalist, but I just ... Credit where credit is due. That was not my moment.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：好的。在我们结束本节之前，我只想说，天哪，我对选举期间将要发生的事情是错误的吗？作为一名记者，每次我有热门报道时，结果对我来说都很糟糕。我很高兴我不是那种记者，但我只是……值得赞扬的地方。那不是我的时刻。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: I don't think it was anyone's moment, and that's the wild part. We all said Dems are going to do pretty well, but I don't think that ... There's very few who had any idea about the majorities that we were looking at.
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：我认为这不是任何人的时刻，而这正是最疯狂的部分。我们都说民主党会做得很好，但我不认为……很少有人知道我们正在关注的多数人。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: All right. Coming up after the break, we have a special edition of WIRED/TIRED this week. Stay with us.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：好的。休息后，本周我们将推出《连线/疲劳》特别版。留在我们身边。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: OK. It is time for our WIRED/TIRED segment. Whatever is new and cool is WIRED. Whatever is old is TIRED, but we're doing it a little bit differently this week. Instead of sharing our personal picks for what's new and exciting this week, we're actually going to take a look at what seems to be in and what is out in this new post-election landscape. Who wants to go first?
paras.zh: 利亚·费格：好的。现在是我们的“连线/疲倦”部分的时间了。无论是新的、酷的，都是连线的。任何旧的东西都会让人厌倦，但这周我们的做法有点不同。我们不会分享我们个人对本周新的和令人兴奋的事情的选择，而是实际上会看看选举后新形势中的新情况和新情况。谁想先走？

paras.en: Brian Barrett: I'll do one. OK. Well, I'm going to say in is seasteading, but for data centers, in addition to wanting to send data centers to outer space, there's a push led by a big Peter Thiel investment in a company called Panthalassa that wants to put data centers in the ocean and power them by waves. The reason there's an acceleration for this, of course, is that Democrats are now in charge of Texas, which is a data center hotspot, and also all of Congress. They're going to be passing all kinds of data center bills probably. There's going to be a big pullback, or at least people are worried about that, for domestic data center build out. So look to the oceans where no one can stop you. That's in.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：我会做一个。好的。好吧，我要说的是海洋稳定，但对于数据中心来说，除了希望将数据中心发送到外太空之外，Peter Thiel 对一家名为 Panthalassa 的公司进行了大量投资，该公司希望将数据中心放在海洋中并通过波浪为其提供动力。当然，这种加速的原因是民主党现在掌控着数据中心热点德克萨斯州以及整个国会。他们可能会通过各种数据中心法案。国内数据中心建设将会出现大幅回调，或者至少人们担心这一点。因此，放眼大海吧，那里没有人可以阻止你。那是在.

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: Incredible. OK. Mine is Woke 1 versus Woke 2. Does this mean anything to you? Is that what you were going to say? OK. Well, we can talk about it. I feel like last election kind of ... No, no. The one before ... Wait, where was peak Woke 1? OK. So previously, I feel like Woke 1 was not the most humorous. It felt like the right had the, "We're speaking truth to power, we're going to make fun of everything," thing handled and the left liberals were more sanctimonious, I think we can say. One thing that I saw immediately after the election was, I'm calling it Woke 2 humor. I think other people are saying that now, this rise of like, "We're in on the joke. We're going to make jokes about how we love pronouns and inclusivity and DEI and own that storyline in a way." I don't know, X that night, Bluesky that night, I was laughing, were some good ones.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：难以置信。好的。我的是 Woke 1 和 Woke 2。这对你来说有什么意义吗？这就是你想说的吗？好的。好吧，我们可以谈谈。我觉得上次选举有点……不，不。之前的那个……等等，巅峰觉醒1在哪里？好的。所以之前我觉得Woke 1并不是最幽默的。感觉右翼有这样的说法：“我们正在向权力说真话，我们会取笑一切，”事情已经处理完毕，而左翼自由主义者则更加道貌岸然，我想我们可以说。选举后我立即看到的一件事是，我称之为“Woke 2 幽默”。我认为现在其他人都在说，这种崛起就像是，“我们在开玩笑。我们将开玩笑说我们如何热爱代词、包容性和 DEI，并以某种方式拥有这个故事情节。”我不知道，X那天晚上，Bluesky那天晚上，我在笑，是一些好东西。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: So good. Libbing out is in. Millennial optimism is back.
paras.zh: 利亚·费格：太好了。自由主义盛行。千禧一代的乐观主义又回来了。

paras.en: Zoë Schiffer: Wow. The gift that keeps on giving.
paras.zh: 佐伊·希弗：哇。不断赠送的礼物。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: So what's in is this is a bit more predictive. I think this is more a to come than we're experiencing so far. What's in is blaming your lame duck president. Donald Trump is officially a lame duck president, entirely shielded from all of his decisions by members of his own party, by members of the content creator community that rallied behind him and helped get him elected. He is now a lame duck. We already reported that people in the same content creator community, that other politicians are starting to throw him under the bus as they should. They need to for 2028. What happened here has tanked so many people's careers and everyone just needs to claw right out of it. So he has spent the last few years not experiencing the blame game, but it's here for him and I can't wait to see where this goes.
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：所以这更具预测性。我认为这比我们迄今为止所经历的更有可能发生。内容是责怪你们的跛脚鸭总统。唐纳德·特朗普在官方意义上是一位跛脚鸭总统，他的所有决定完全不受他所在政党成员以及团结在他身后并帮助他当选的内容创作者社区成员的影响。他现在是一只跛脚鸭。我们已经报道过，同一内容创作者社区中的人们，其他政客正开始像他们应该的那样把他扔到公共汽车下。他们需要在 2028 年做到这一点。这里发生的事情已经让很多人的职业生涯陷入困境，每个人都需要摆脱困境。所以他在过去的几年里没有经历过指责游戏，但这对他来说就在这里，我迫不及待地想看看这会发生什么。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: I'll say what's out, I'm going to add out, is whatever technolibertarian political views you had as a CEO before the election are by and large out, manifestos are out ...
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特（Brian Barrett）：我想说的是，我要补充的是，无论你在选举前作为首席执行官所持有的技术自由主义政治观点，基本上都已经消失了，宣言也已经消失了......

paras.en: Leah Feiger: Manifestos are out. I don't want to read another 20,000 word manifesto from a technolibertarian 22-year-old that's telling me that Peter Thiel actually is the person who should be in charge of my Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. Out.
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：宣言已经出来了。我不想再读一个 22 岁的技术自由主义者的 20,000 字宣言，它告诉我彼得·泰尔实际上是应该负责我周一、周二、周三的人。出去。

paras.en: Brian Barrett: They're out. And instead we have a delightful tweet from Sam Altman just after the election saying, "People should always be in control of the future." And we have Palantir CEO Alex Karp saying that he's always been ... He thinks of Palantir as progressive technology.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：他们出去了。相反，我们在选举结束后收到了山姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 的一条令人愉快的推文，他说：“人们应该永远掌控未来。” Palantir 首席执行官 Alex Karp 表示，他一直……他认为 Palantir 是一种进步技术。

paras.en: Leah Feiger: I think of anyone that works with ICE as progressive. That's always been the case, right?
paras.zh: Leah Feiger：我认为任何与 ICE 合作的人都是进步的。一直都是这样，对吧？

paras.en: Brian Barrett: Yeah. They're progressing toward something. Yeah.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·巴雷特：是的。他们正在朝着某事取得进展。是的。

articles.title: Climate Change Has Pushed the World's Ice Out of Its Safe Zone
articles.author: Brian Kahn

paras.en: The world is no longer safe for frozen H2O.
paras.zh: 对于冰冻的水来说，世界不再安全。

paras.en: New research published in Science on Thursday shows that the conditions that have kept ice, frozen soil, and snow stable are slipping away due to the burning of fossil fuels—and the implications are grave for the entire globe.
paras.zh: 周四发表在《科学》杂志上的新研究表明，由于化石燃料的燃烧，使冰、冻土和雪保持稳定的条件正在消失，这对整个地球的影响是严重的。

paras.en: The climate of the past 12,000 or so years has been remarkably steady. That’s allowed for all kinds of wonderful things to happen, like human civilization flourishing. But rising temperatures are pushing the climate outside that envelope, and the new research looks at what the team behind the new findings has called the “safe operating space” for the icy, snowy landscape known as the cryosphere.
paras.zh: 过去一万二千年左右的时间里，气候一直非常稳定。这使得各种美好的事情发生，比如人类文明的繁荣。但不断上升的气温正在将气候推向极限，新的研究着眼于新发现背后的团队所称的冰雪景观的“安全操作空间”，即冰冻圈。

paras.en: The scientists looked at changes to polar sea and land ice, mountain glaciers, permafrost, and snow cover over the past 12 millennia to analyze conditions that have allowed both civilization and other ecosystems to thrive. They then identified boundaries on those conditions that, if crossed, would upend the stability and safety humans have enjoyed for millennia.
paras.zh: 科学家们研究了过去 12000 年来极地海洋和陆地冰、山地冰川、永久冻土和积雪的变化，以分析文明和其他生态系统繁荣发展的条件。然后，他们确定了这些条件的界限，如果跨越这些界限，将颠覆人类数千年来享有的稳定和安全。

paras.en: The results show an “accelerating and partly irreversible loss of cryospheric integrity.” Arctic and Antarctic sea ice have both fallen outside the safe operating threshold, as have snow cover and the area of permafrost—frozen soil laden with carbon. While land ice hasn’t yet fallen out of its safe space, it’s on the brink. And because of warming that’s already been locked into the climate system, it’s likely to also fall outside the threshold in the coming centuries.
paras.zh: 结果显示“冰冻圈完整性正在加速且部分不可逆转地丧失”。北极和南极海冰都已超出安全运行阈值，积雪和永久冻土区（富含碳的冻土）也是如此。虽然陆地冰尚未脱离其安全空间，但已处于边缘。由于气候变暖已经被锁定在气候系统中，未来几个世纪它也可能会超出阈值。

paras.en: While it may feel like the Antarctic ice sheet or permafrost covering Alaska are distant concerns, they’re anything but. The West Antarctic Ice Sheet, which a growing body of evidence shows is nearing the brink of irreversible decline, has enough ice to raise sea levels by 11 feet (3 meters). Permafrost, meanwhile, holds trillions of tons of carbon dioxide. Any degradation means that CO2, as well as even more potent methane, could end up in the atmosphere, accelerating global warming even further. Other examples of major risks abound, including how melting Greenland land ice could slow down or even collapse the ocean conveyor belt that helps keep Europe temperate.
paras.zh: 虽然人们可能感觉南极冰盖或覆盖阿拉斯加的永久冻土是遥远的问题，但事实并非如此。越来越多的证据表明，南极西部冰盖正接近不可逆转的衰退边缘，其冰量足以使海平面上升 11 英尺（3 米）。与此同时，永久冻土层蕴藏着数万亿吨二氧化碳。任何降解都意味着二氧化碳以及更有效的甲烷最终可能进入大气中，进一步加速全球变暖。其他重大风险的例子比比皆是，包括格陵兰岛冰层融化可能会减缓甚至崩溃有助于保持欧洲气候的海洋传送带。

paras.en: “The consequences of a changing cryosphere extend beyond regions where ice and snow are disappearing,” says Albert Noström, a climate researcher at the Stockholm Resilience Center who co-authored the new paper.
paras.zh: 斯德哥尔摩复原力中心的气候研究员阿尔伯特·诺斯特伦（Albert Noström）是这篇新论文的合著者，他说：“冰冻圈变化的影响超出了冰雪消失的地区。”

paras.en: Dipping outside the safe operating space doesn’t mean that the world will see 11 feet of sea level rise in the next year, a trillion-ton CO2 eruption, or a Day After Tomorrow scenario. But it does mean that the odds of crossing dangerous tipping points are rising.
paras.zh: 超出安全操作空间并不意味着世界将在明年看到海平面上升 11 英尺、万亿吨二氧化碳喷发或后天场景。但这确实意味着跨越危险临界点的可能性正在上升。

paras.en: “As we scratch 1.5 [degrees Celsius] and go above it, we are just really gambling with potentially triggering some of these Earth system tipping points,” Noström says. The safe operating space framework also “takes a broader perspective” that assesses slower changes over time and “how far, in this case, the cryosphere is moving away from the conditions that have supported a relatively stable Earth system,” he adds.
paras.zh: “当气温上升到 1.5 摄氏度并超过它时，我们实际上是在赌博，可能会触发一些地球系统的临界点，”诺斯特罗姆说。他补充说，安全运行空间框架还“采取更广泛的视角”，评估随着时间的推移而缓慢的变化，以及“在这种情况下，冰冻圈正在远离支持相对稳定的地球系统的条件”。

paras.en: Cutting emissions is the most obvious and straightforward way to stop the cryosphere from sliding further outside our comfort zone. But there are a growing number of proposals to pursue more radical interventions that could protect the world’s ice. Scientists have already draped glaciers in the Alps in blankets during the summer to prevent melting. Other researchers have explored techniques to pump cold sea water to the surface to help thicken ice and modeled whether a manmade barrier could stabilize the West Antarctic Ice Sheet.
paras.zh: 减少排放是阻止冰冻圈进一步滑出我们的舒适区的最明显、最直接的方法。但越来越多的提案要求采取更激进的干预措施来保护世界的冰层。科学家们已经在夏季给阿尔卑斯山的冰川盖上了毯子，以防止融化。其他研究人员探索了将冷海水泵送到地表以帮助加厚冰层的技术，并模拟了人造屏障是否可以稳定西南极冰盖。

paras.en: These geoengineering approaches have the potential to be costly, and there’s no guarantee they would work. They’d also do nothing to stop the root cause of warming: burning fossil fuels. Noström says emissions cuts are the most urgent way to protect ice and snow (and ourselves), but with the cryosphere sliding into a more dangerous space, “in principle, we shouldn't put the lid on” research for more far-flung interventions.
paras.zh: 这些地球工程方法可能成本高昂，而且不能保证它们会起作用。他们也没有采取任何措施来阻止变暖的根本原因：燃烧化石燃料。诺斯特罗姆表示，减排是保护冰雪（以及我们自己）的最紧迫方法，但随着冰冻圈滑向更危险的空间，“原则上，我们不应该限制”更广泛干预措施的研究。

paras.en: “The safe operating space is a precautionary framework,” he says. “It ensures that we try to stay as far downstream from the point where these really potentially existential or huge consequences and risks can happen.”
paras.zh: “安全操作空间是一个预防框架，”他说。 “它确保我们尽量远离这些真正潜在的存在或巨大的后果和风险可能发生的地方。”

articles.title: Major Microsoft Outlook Outage Leaves People With Email Jobs Unable to Email
articles.author: Andrew Couts

paras.en: It’s not just you. Microsoft’s 365 business and enterprise services suffered a major outage on Thursday, preventing users of its popular cloud suite from accessing their accounts.
paras.zh: 不只是你。微软的 365 商业和企业服务周四遭遇严重中断，导致其流行云套件的用户无法访问其帐户。

paras.en: Around 10:40 am ET on Thursday morning, Microsoft posted on its 365 status page on X that it was “investigating reports of users experiencing issues when accessing or using Microsoft Teams functionality in North America.” By just before 1pm ET, it said it was aware of “issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas.”
paras.zh: 美国东部时间周四上午 10:40 左右，微软在 X 的 365 状态页面上发布消息称，它正在“调查北美用户在访问或使用 Microsoft Teams 功能时遇到问题的报告”。就在美国东部时间下午 1 点之前，该公司表示已意识到“在美洲通过多种连接方法访问 Exchange Online 邮箱时出现问题”。

paras.en: Microsoft later said that its network was also “experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, which is likely contributing to the connectivity errors,” but that the issue was related to servers going offline, not due to increased traffic.
paras.zh: 微软后来表示，其网络“多个区域的负载增加，这可能会导致连接错误”，但该问题与服务器离线有关，而不是由于流量增加所致。

paras.en: Around an hour later, Microsoft said it had “begun redistributing connection traffic across our broader worldwide infrastructure to help balance the load” and was “aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact.”
paras.zh: 大约一个小时后，微软表示，它已“开始在更广泛的全球基础设施中重新分配连接流量，以帮助平衡负载”，并“积极寻求所有途径来减少影响”。

paras.en: “We've paused all deployments. We're moving additional traffic off the affected infrastructure, and we're restarting affected servers to return them to service,” Microsoft wrote.
paras.zh: “我们已经暂停了所有部署。我们正在将额外的流量从受影响的基础设施上移走，并重新启动受影响的服务器以使它们恢复服务，”微软写道。

paras.en: In an update on its status page, Microsoft said impacted services may include Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Copilot 365, and Microsoft Defender XDR.
paras.zh: 微软在状态页面的更新中表示，受影响的服务可能包括 Exchange Online、Microsoft Teams、SharePoint Online、Microsoft Copilot 365 和 Microsoft Defender XDR。

paras.en: “We are aware and investigating reports of users experiencing issues with Microsoft 365 services, primarily issues with Exchange Online,” a Microsoft spokesperson tells WIRED in a statement. “We appreciate our customer's patience while we work to restore services as soon as possible."
paras.zh: 微软发言人在一份声明中告诉《连线》杂志：“我们注意到并正在调查用户遇到 Microsoft 365 服务问题的报告，主要是 Exchange Online 问题。” “我们感谢客户的耐心等待，我们正在努力尽快恢复服务。”

paras.en: Outage reports on the service uptime tracking website Downdetector began falling around 1:15 pm ET after a large spike in users reporting issues with Outlook and other Microsoft 365 products around noon.
paras.zh: 中午前后，报告 Outlook 和其他 Microsoft 365 产品问题的用户大幅增加，导致服务正常运行时间跟踪网站 DownDetector 的中断报告在美国东部时间下午 1:15 左右开始下降。

paras.en: It is currently unclear when the outage may be over or what its cause may be. In a status update on X posted just before 3 pm ET, Microsoft said “a problem” was “causing servers to fail automated health checks and become unavailable” but that it’s attempting to reboot its systems to hopefully bring them back online.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚停电何时结束或停电原因是什么。在美国东部时间下午 3 点之前发布的 X 状态更新中，微软表示，“一个问题”是“导致服务器无法自动运行状况检查并变得不可用”，但它正在尝试重新启动系统，希望能让它们重新上线。

paras.en: Outages in cloud services occur frequently, and their causes can vary. Configuration errors, resolution issues with the Domain Name System, and cyberattacks can all cause connection errors. There is currently no indication that a cyberattack caused the current Microsoft outage.
paras.zh: 云服务中断频繁发生，其原因也各不相同。配置错误、域名系统解析问题以及网络攻击都可能导致连接错误。目前没有迹象表明网络攻击导致了当前的 Microsoft 服务中断。

paras.en: While major Microsoft outages are relatively rare, they are far from unprecedented. In July 2024, a corrupted update from the security firm Crowdstrike knocked out Microsoft Azure services for hours, causing untold millions of dollars in lost revenue due to companies’ inability to function as normal.
paras.zh: 虽然微软的重大宕机事件相对罕见，但绝非史无前例。 2024 年 7 月，安全公司 Crowdstrike 的一个损坏的更新导致 Microsoft Azure 服务瘫痪数小时，由于公司无法正常运行，造成了数百万美元的收入损失。

paras.en: Updated 11/12/2026 at 3:05 pm ET: Added comment from Microsoft.
paras.zh: 东部时间 2026 年 11 月 12 日下午 3:05 更新：添加了 Microsoft 的评论。

articles.title: Trump shifts Vance's focus from Iran to corruption in Democratic areas

paras.en: Nov. 12 (UPI) -- U.S. President Donald Trump said he is pulling U.S. Vice President JD Vance from negotiating with Iran to focus on investigating alleged fraud in Democratic-led areas.
paras.zh: 11 月 12 日（UPI）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将让美国副总统万斯退出与伊朗的谈判，以专注于调查民主党领导地区涉嫌欺诈的情况。

paras.en: Trump's announcement on social media Thursday comes just over a week after Vance said the ongoing war with Iran led to the Democratic landslide in the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 就在特朗普周四在社交媒体上宣布这一消息的一周多前，万斯表示，与伊朗的持续战争导致民主党在 11 月 3 日中期选举中获得压倒性胜利。

paras.en: "We don't need a deal with Iran," Trump said. "Those days have long since passed."
paras.zh: 特朗普表示：“我们不需要与伊朗达成协议。” “那些日子早已过去了。”

paras.en: "I have asked Vice President Vance to focus his complete and total attention on the Massive Corruption and Crime taking place in Democrat run Cities and States throughout the U.S.," he wrote. "The Blue States, such as Minnesota, California, Illinois, and many more, are all poorly run, corrupt disasters. Billions of Dollars is being stolen each and every month."
paras.zh: 他写道：“我已要求副总统万斯将全部注意力集中在美国民主党统治的城市和州发生的大规模腐败和犯罪上。” “明尼苏达州、加利福尼亚州、伊利诺伊州等蓝州都是经营不善、腐败的灾难。每个月都有数十亿美元被盗。”

paras.en: Vance chairs the Task Force to Eliminate Fraud, which was created earlier this year by Trump through an executive order.
paras.zh: 万斯担任消除欺诈工作组主席，该工作组是特朗普今年早些时候通过一项行政命令创建的。

paras.en: Vance reportedly had expressed his opposition to going to war with Iran, but he was tasked with leading peace talks with Tehran over the eight-month conflict. In April, Vance travelled to Pakistan and met with Iranian leaders in a lengthy session that ended without any agreement.
paras.zh: 据报道，万斯曾表示反对与伊朗开战，但他的任务是领导与德黑兰就长达八个月的冲突进行和平谈判。 4月，万斯前往巴基斯坦并与伊朗领导人举行了长时间的会议，但没有达成任何协议。

articles.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who admonished him at Arlington

paras.en: Nov. 12 (UPI) -- Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Thursday awarded a medal to the soldier who reprimanded him and members of his staff for talking and laughing during a somber Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery.
paras.zh: 11 月 12 日（UPI）——国防部长皮特·赫格斯周四向在阿灵顿国家公墓举行的退伍军人节仪式上斥责他和他的幕僚有说有笑的士兵颁发了一枚奖章。

paras.en: Army Spc. Thomas Iglesias received the Joint Service Commendation Medal at the Pentagon, a day after he told Hegseth and his entourage to remain silent while visiting the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
paras.zh: 陆军特种部队。托马斯·伊格莱西亚斯在五角大楼获得了联合服役嘉奖章，一天前，他告诉赫格塞斯和他的随行人员在参观无名烈士墓时保持沉默。

paras.en: Hegseth welcomed members of the 3rd U.S. Infantry Regiment, known as the Old Guard, to recognize Iglesias for performing his duties at the tomb on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周三，赫格塞斯欢迎美国第三步兵团（被称为“老卫士”）的成员认可伊格莱西亚斯在坟墓履行的职责。

paras.en: The incident happened when Hegseth and several members of his staff stopped to take photographs following a wreath-laying ceremony.
paras.zh: 这起事件发生在赫格斯和他的几名工作人员在献花仪式结束后停下来拍照时。

paras.en: As members of the group laughed and talked, Iglesias, who was guarding the tomb, stopped his patrol.
paras.zh: 当这群人说说笑笑时，守卫坟墓的伊格莱西亚斯停止了巡逻。

paras.en: "All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times," Iglesias said.
paras.zh: 伊格莱西亚斯说：“所有访客将始终保持沉默和尊重的气氛。”

paras.en: The group included Hegseth's wife, Jennifer, chief of staff Ricky Buria, deputy chief of staff Patrick Weaver and senior adviser Tami Radabaugh.
paras.zh: 该小组成员包括赫格斯的妻子詹妮弗、幕僚长瑞奇·布里亚、副幕僚长帕特里克·韦弗和高级顾问塔米·拉达博。

paras.en: It was unclear who in Hegseth's group was responsible for the noise.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚赫格斯团队中的谁对噪音负责。

paras.en: Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell defended the soldier's actions Wednesday, saying he had "correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to maintain decorum."
paras.zh: 五角大楼发言人肖恩·帕内尔周三为这名士兵的行为进行了辩护，称他“正确且尊重地提醒每个人保持礼仪”。

paras.en: The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier honors unidentified American service members killed in combat. Soldiers from the Old Guard have maintained a continuous watch over the memorial since 1948.
paras.zh: 无名烈士墓是为了纪念在战斗中阵亡的身份不明的美国军人。自 1948 年以来，老卫兵的士兵一直在看守纪念碑。

paras.en: The recognition comes two days after House Republicans blocked an effort to impeach Hegseth over his handling of the war in Iran and U.S. military strikes against suspected drug-smuggling vessels in the Caribbean and Pacific.
paras.zh: 两天前，众议院共和党人阻止了弹劾赫格斯的努力，原因是他处理伊朗战争以及美国对加勒比和太平洋地区涉嫌毒品走私船只的军事打击。

paras.en: The House voted 211-204 Tuesday to remove the impeachment resolution from floor consideration and send it to a committee, where it is unlikely to advance.
paras.zh: 众议院周二以 211 票对 204 票投票决定将弹劾决议从众议院审议中删除，并将其提交给一个委员会，该委员会不太可能推进该决议。

paras.en: Hegseth dismissed the impeachment effort as a "political spectacle."
paras.zh: 赫格斯将弹劾努力视为“政治奇观”。

paras.en: "It's a farce, and it's a stunt, and everybody knows it," Hegseth said Tuesday.
paras.zh: “这是一场闹剧，也是一个噱头，每个人都知道，”赫格斯周二说。

articles.title: Microsoft reports widespread Outlook outages in United States

paras.en: Nov. 12 (UPI) -- Microsoft said Thursday users of its Outlook email product have been unable to connect to their mailboxes.
paras.zh: 11 月 12 日 (UPI)——微软周四表示，其 Outlook 电子邮件产品的用户无法连接到他们的邮箱。

paras.en: The potentially affected connection methods include Outlook on the web, messaging API, exchange ActiveSync and representational state transfer, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，可能受影响的连接方法包括 Outlook 网页版、消息 API、交换 ActiveSync 和代表性状态传输。

paras.en: "We're investigating reports of users experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas. More details can be found in the Microsoft 365 admin center under EX1550543," Microsoft 365 Status said in a post on X.
paras.zh: Microsoft 365 Status 在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示：“我们正在调查有关美洲用户通过多种连接方法访问 Exchange Online 邮箱时遇到问题的报告。更多详细信息可以在 Microsoft 365 管理中心的 EX1550543 下找到。”

paras.en: Outage tracker Downdetector showed a spike in reports for Microsoft 365 services starting after 12 p.m. ET, with 22,323 users reporting outages by 12:55 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 中断跟踪器 DownDetector 显示，从中午 12 点之后开始，Microsoft 365 服务的报告出现激增。东部时间，截至中午 12:55，有 22,323 名用户报告网络中断。等。

paras.en: Outlook had nearly 83,000 reported outages just before 1 p.m. ET, while 2,000 reported issues with Teams and 4,400 reported disturbances to CoPilot.
paras.zh: 就在下午 1 点之前，Outlook 报告了近 83,000 个中断事件。 ET 期间，有 2,000 人报告了 Teams 问题，4,400 人向 CoPilot 报告了干扰。

articles.title: Israeli Strikes on Gaza Hospital Kill 6 and Injure Dozens, Health Officials Say
articles.author: Abu Bakr Bashir and Ephrat Livni

paras.en: The Israeli military struck a hospital in the southern Gaza Strip on Thursday, killing at least six people and injuring 28 more, according to local health officials.
paras.zh: 据当地卫生官员称，以色列军方周四袭击了加沙地带南部的一家医院，造成至少 6 人死亡、28 人受伤。

paras.en: Dr. Ahmed al-Farra, general director of Nasser Hospital, said in a news conference on Thursday that two missiles had hit the facility and that among the dead was Rezeq Abu Shaira, 52, a doctor.
paras.zh: 纳赛尔医院院长艾哈迈德·法拉 (Ahmed al-Farra) 医生在周四的新闻发布会上表示，两枚导弹击中了该医院，死者中有 52 岁的医生雷泽克·阿布·沙伊拉 (Rezeq Abu Shaira)。

paras.en: Health officials reached in Gaza by phone said that a man called Khaled Abu Anza had also been killed. A spokeswoman for the Israeli military, speaking on condition of anonymity in line with protocol, said that Mr. Abu Anza was a Hamas operative.
paras.zh: 加沙卫生官员通过电话表示，一名名叫哈立德·阿布·安扎的男子也被杀。以色列军方一位不愿透露姓名的女发言人表示，阿布·安扎是哈马斯成员。

paras.en: The Israeli security agency and military said in a joint statement on Thursday that they had targeted Muhammad Abu Ismail, whom they identified as a Hamas commander “responsible for holding numerous hostages captive” during the Gaza war.
paras.zh: 以色列安全机构和军方在周四的一份联合声明中表示，他们的目标是穆罕默德·阿布·伊斯梅尔，他们认为他是哈马斯指挥官，“对加沙战争期间扣押了大量人质负有责任”。

paras.en: The Israeli authorities said that Hamas had established a command center at the hospital complex to stage operations against Israeli forces and was storing weapons there. They added that steps had been taken to mitigate harm to civilians.
paras.zh: 以色列当局表示，哈马斯在医院大楼内设立了指挥中心，对以色列军队采取行动，并在那里储存武器。他们补充说，已采取措施减轻对平民的伤害。

paras.en: Hamas said the Israeli claim that the hospital was used for military activity was a “blatant attempt to justify a heinous crime targeting a civilian medical facility.” Residents of Gaza have said that officials affiliated with Hamas-run Gaza government and security forces sometimes use the enclave’s hospitals as offices.
paras.zh: 哈马斯表示，以色列声称该医院被用于军事活动，这是“公然试图为针对民用医疗设施的令人发指的犯罪行为辩护”。加沙居民表示，哈马斯控制的加沙政府和安全部队的官员有时会使用飞地的医院作为办公室。

articles.title: In Moscow, Witkoff and Kushner Ask Putin to Include Europe in Peace Talks
articles.author: Ivan Nechepurenko

paras.en: President Trump’s envoys went to Moscow on Thursday to seek agreement from President Vladimir V. Putin to bring Europe into talks on the war in Ukraine, as the Kremlin pushes to widen the negotiations to overhaul European security arrangements.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统的特使周四前往莫斯科，寻求总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京(Vladimir V. Putin)同意让欧洲参与有关乌克兰战争的谈判，同时克里姆林宫正在推动扩大谈判以彻底改革欧洲安全安排。

paras.en: The envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, arrived in Russia one day after mediating peace talks in Abu Dhabi between Russian and Ukrainian representatives, who spoke directly for the first time in nine months. After meeting with Mr. Putin in the Kremlin, they were scheduled to travel to Dublin to meet with President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳在阿布扎比调解俄罗斯和乌克兰代表之间的和平谈判一天后抵达俄罗斯，这是九个月来首次直接发言。在克里姆林宫会见普京后，他们计划前往都柏林会见乌克兰总统泽连斯基。

paras.en: Mr. Witkoff and Mr. Kushner are pressing to involve Europe in the talks as Russia makes clear that it will not consider a cease-fire until its broader demands to redraw Europe’s security architecture are addressed.
paras.zh: 威特科夫和库什纳正在敦促欧洲参与谈判，因为俄罗斯明确表示，在其重新规划欧洲安全架构的更广泛要求得到解决之前，不会考虑停火。

paras.en: The Trump administration, seeking a foreign policy win after Republicans’ drubbing in the midterm elections, is making another push for peace even as Russia gives no indication that it will stop the war anytime soon, and in fact appears to be hardening some positions.
paras.zh: 共和党在中期选举中惨败后，寻求外交政策胜利的特朗普政府正在再次推动和平，尽管俄罗斯没有表示将很快停止战争，而且事实上似乎正在强化某些立场。

paras.en: Russia has intensified attacks on Ukrainian cities ahead of a winter bombing campaign, taking advantage of Ukraine’s lack of air defenses. On Thursday, Mr. Zelensky said that Ukraine’s armed forces again faced restrictions on Starshield, the military version of the satellite internet network Starlink, and had asked U.S. officials for information.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯利用乌克兰缺乏防空系统的优势，在冬季轰炸行动之前加强了对乌克兰城市的袭击。周四，泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰武装部队再次面临对卫星互联网网络“星链”的军事版本“星盾”的限制，并已向美国官员询问信息。

articles.title: A Key Paris Agreement Goal Is Dead. What Now?
articles.author: David Gelles

paras.en: It was the climate movement’s unifying slogan for the past decade: “Keep 1.5 Alive.”
paras.zh: 这是过去十年气候运动的统一口号：“Keep 1.5 Alive”。

paras.en: The tagline referred to the central ambition of the 2015 Paris climate agreement, in which almost every country pledged to try to limit global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius.
paras.zh: 标语提到了 2015 年巴黎气候协议的核心目标，其中几乎每个国家都承诺努力将全球变暖限制在 1.5 摄氏度。

paras.en: Now, just 11 years after the target was set, 1.5 is effectively dead.
paras.zh: 现在，距离目标设定仅 11 年，1.5 实际上已经死亡。

paras.en: Scientists now say that without drastic efforts to reduce greenhouse gases, it is very likely that the planet will warm at least 2.6 degrees Celsius, or 4.7 degrees Fahrenheit, by the end of the century.
paras.zh: 科学家现在表示，如果不大力减少温室气体排放，到本世纪末，地球很可能变暖至少 2.6 摄氏度（即 4.7 华氏度）。

paras.en: At COP31, the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, diplomats who spent so long championing the 1.5 degree target lamented the abrupt setback.
paras.zh: 在土耳其安塔利亚举行的第 31 届联合国气候变化大会 (COP31) 上，长期以来一直致力于实现 1.5 度目标的外交官们对这一突然挫折表示遗憾。

paras.en: “The world has no chance of holding to 1.5 degrees,” said Chris Bowen, Australia’s minister for climate change and energy, who is leading the negotiations.
paras.zh: “世界没有机会将气温控制在 1.5 度之内，”主持谈判的澳大利亚气候变化和能源部长克里斯·鲍文 (Chris Bowen) 表示。

paras.en: Scientists for years have warned that allowing global average temperatures to rise 1.5 degrees Celsius, or 2.7 degrees Fahrenheit, above preindustrial levels would result in a profoundly more dangerous world. Extreme heat will become more common and more intense. Storms will become more powerful and destructive. Sea levels will rise. And poor countries will bear the brunt of the damage.
paras.zh: 多年来，科学家们一直警告说，如果全球平均气温比工业化前水平上升 1.5 摄氏度（即 2.7 华氏度），将会导致世界变得更加危险。极端高温将变得更加普遍、更加强烈。风暴将变得更加强大和更具破坏性。海平面将会上升。贫穷国家将首当其冲受到损害。

paras.en: That scenario is already playing out around the world. In recent months, wildfires have raged from Canada to Indonesia. The collapse of a glacier in Nepal killed thousands and wiped away towns. Floods and mudslides devastated Brazil. And a European heat wave killed an estimated 50,000 people.
paras.zh: 这种情况已经在世界各地上演。近几个月来，从加拿大到印度尼西亚，野火肆虐。尼泊尔冰川崩塌造成数千人死亡，城镇被夷为平地。洪水和泥石流摧毁了巴西。欧洲热浪估计导致 5 万人死亡。

articles.title: Pitbull Shares the Stories Behind ‘On the Floor,’ ‘Feel This Moment’ & More | Chart History
articles.author: Katie Cao

paras.en: Pitbull looks back on the stories behind some of his biggest hits, from “On the Floor” with Jennifer Lopez to “I Know You Want Me (Calle Ocho)” and “Give Me Everything” to “Timber” and “I Like It.” He shares how collaborations with artists such as Ne-Yo, Kesha, Lil Jon and Enrique Iglesias came together, why artists should fight for their song-publishing percentages, and how music can cross genres and bring people together. Plus, Mr. Worldwide reflects on the teacher who believed in him, and the schools he’s helping build to create opportunities for the next generation.
paras.zh: Pitbull 回顾了他一些热门歌曲背后的故事，从詹妮弗·洛佩兹 (Jennifer Lopez) 的《On the Floor》到《I Know You Want Me (Calle Ocho)》、《Give Me Everything》、《Timber》和《I Like It》。他分享了如何与 Ne-Yo、Kesha、Lil Jon 和 Enrique Iglesias 等艺术家合作，为什么艺术家应该争取歌曲出版百分比，以及音乐如何跨越流派并将人们聚集在一起。此外，环球先生还回顾了相信他的老师，以及他帮助建立的为下一代创造机会的学校。

paras.en: Pitbull: I said, “This is gonna be one big mother f–king record.” That’s what I kept saying, “This a big mother f–king. Oh, this is gonna be a big motherf–king.”
paras.zh: Pitbull：我说，“这将是一张他妈的大唱片。”这就是我一直说的：“这是一个大王。哦，这将是一个大王。”

paras.en: Leila Cobo: Last time you were here 10 years ago, you know that? Today we’re gonna talk a lot about music.
paras.zh: Leila Cobo：你上次来这里是 10 年前，你知道吗？今天我们要聊很多关于音乐的话题。

paras.en: It was your first track that broke the top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100.
paras.zh: 这是你第一首突破 Billboard Hot 100 前 10 名的歌曲。

paras.en: “I Know You Want Me” — very, very special record. But one, I wanna say thank you to Team Pitbull, and I got Robby Robb here, which is the person that sent me over the beat. It was, I believe, 75 Street Brazil was the name of the record. So he sends me over the beat. I’m driving around listening to the song, and I just listened to … I was on tour, and we were listening to Omega and El Cata. And then El Cata has a song, eh, I know you want me, you know I want ya. So he had that song, and I said, “OK, let me try it on,” and boom, I do it on there.
paras.zh: “我知道你想要我”——非常非常特别的唱片。但有一点，我想对比特犬团队说声谢谢，还有罗比·罗伯（Robby Robb）来到这里，是他让我超越了节奏。我相信这张唱片的名字就是《75 Street Brazil》。所以他就给我发了节奏。我开车到处听这首歌，我只是听……我在巡演，我们在听 Omega 和 El Cata。然后 El Cata 有一首歌，呃，我知道你想要我，你知道我想要你。所以他有那首歌，我说，“好吧，让我试一下，”然后，我就这么做了。

paras.en: Now, Omega with the mambo and the whole nine is where we came up with little different things as far as how to get slick on the record. Here’s the most important part of this, especially for anybody here that’s trying to get in the music business: Make sure, numbers are numbers, you get me? Add, multiply, do add. I got that part. But when you’re talking percentages, that’s a different conversation. So make sure that you get your percentages on these records, ’cause that in turn is what’s gonna help you in the future. That’s gonna help your family. That’s called generational wealth. Triple G, generating to generate for generations.
paras.zh: 现在，欧米茄与曼波和整个九是我们想出一些不同的东西，就如何在记录上变得光滑。这是其中最重要的部分，特别是对于任何想进入音乐行业的人来说：确保，数字就是数字，你明白我的意思吗？加，乘，加。我得到了那部分。但当你谈论百分比时，那就是另一回事了。因此，请确保您获得这些记录的百分比，因为这反过来会对您将来有所帮助。这会对你的家人有帮助。这就是所谓的世代财富。 Triple G，世代相传。

paras.en: El Cata, I, when I call him up, and I have a conversation with him, I say, “Cata, look, I’m going to give you a percentage of the song.” He says, “No, I don’t want that, bro. What I want is cash. Look, what I want is cash.” I say, “Look, I’m going to give you cash and I’m going to give you a percentage of the song.” He gets to Opa-locka and he’s telling me that I haven’t given him anything because this and that.
paras.zh: El Cata，当我打电话给他并与他交谈时，我说，“Cata，听着，我会给你这首歌的一部分。”他说：“不，我不想要那个，兄弟。我想要的是现金。看，我想要的是现金。”我说：“听着，我会给你现金，还会给你这首歌的一定比例。”他到了奥帕洛卡，他告诉我我没有给他任何东西，因为这样那样。

articles.title: Latin Grammys 2026: Full List of Winners (Updating)
articles.author: Sigal Ratner-Arias

paras.en: The Latin Grammys have arrived, with winners starting to be announced at 3 p.m. ET — hours before Thursday’s (Nov. 12) telecast — at the Premiere, a non-televised event where most of the trophies are handed out.
paras.zh: 拉丁格莱美颁奖典礼已经到来，获奖者名单将于下午 3 点开始公布。东部时间——周四（11 月 12 日）电视转播前几个小时——在首映式上，这是一场非电视转播的活动，大部分奖杯都是在该活动中颁发的。

paras.en: This year, Edgar Barrera tops the list of nominees with 10 nods. The acclaimed Mexican songwriter and producer appears in the general categories of record of the year, album of the year and song of the year — mostly for his work on projects by Karol G and Carín León — as well as songwriter of the year, an honor he has won for the past three consecutive years.
paras.zh: 今年，埃德加·巴雷拉 (Edgar Barrera) 以 10 项提名位居提名名单之首。这位广受赞誉的墨西哥词曲作者和制作人出现在年度唱片、年度专辑和年度歌曲的综合类别中（主要是因为他在 Karol G 和 Carín León 的项目中所做的工作）以及年度词曲作者，这是他在过去连续三年获得的荣誉。

paras.en: CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, Jorge Drexler, Karol G and Rosalía follow with seven nominations each, while Silvana Estrada and Mon Laferte have six. All of them are vying for album of the year, alongside Anitta, Carín León, Milo J and Rawayana. Most also compete for song and record of the year.
paras.zh: CA7RIEL 和 Paco Amoroso、Jorge Drexler、Karol G 和 Rosalía 分别获得七项提名，而 Silvana Estrada 和 Mon Laferte 则获得六项提名。他们所有人都在与 Anitta、Carín León、Milo J 和 Rawayana 一起争夺年度专辑。大多数人还争夺年度歌曲和年度唱片。

paras.en: Rosalía’s eclectic album LUX appears in fields including pop, alternative music, and Portuguese language music, in addition to album of the year. The Spanish superstar has already won the night’s top award twice before — in 2019 for El Mal Querer and in 2022 for Motomami — and she is once again widely considered a favorite.
paras.zh: Rosalía 不拘一格的专辑《LUX》除了年度专辑之外，还出现在流行音乐、另类音乐和葡萄牙语音乐等领域。这位西班牙超级巨星之前已经两次获得当晚最高奖项——2019 年凭借《El Mal Querer》和 2022 年凭借《Motomami》——她再次被广泛认为是最受欢迎的。

paras.en: At just 19 years old, Argentine singer and rapper Milo J arrives with five nominations, including in the three main categories, with a folk album. In addition, the album received a sixth nod, for best recording package.
paras.zh: 年仅 19 岁的阿根廷歌手兼说唱歌手 Milo J 凭借一张民谣专辑获得了五项提名，其中包括三个主要类别的提名。此外，这张专辑还第六次获得最佳录音包奖。

paras.en: Other contenders with multiple nominations include Arath Herce, with four; and BRUSES, Feid, Héctor Mazzarri, Jennifer Mosello and Eden Muñoz with three each. Artists such as Rauw Alejandro, Anitta, Bad Gyal, Beéle, Bizarrap, Ryan Castro, Daddy Yankee, Kany García, Joaquina, Juanes and Carín León, among others, received two nods.
paras.zh: 其他获得多项提名的竞争者包括 Arath Herce，获得四项提名； BRUSES、Feid、Héctor Mazzarri、Jennifer Mosello 和 Eden Muñoz 各三人。 Rauw Alejandro、Anitta、Bad Gyal、Beéle、Bizarrap、Ryan Castro、Daddy Yankee、Kany García、Joaquina、Juanes 和 Carín León 等艺术家获得了两项提名。

paras.en: Daddy Yankee is set to take the stage as the Latin Recording Academy’s 2026 Person of the Year, a day after he was celebrated at a traditional dinner-concert by his peers. The coveted Latin Grammy for best new artist will be contested by Delilah, Fabian, Loulu Gilberto, Arath Herce, Macario Martínez, Maye, Sofia Monroy, Kendall Peña, Dora Sanches, Aria Vega and Zeca Veloso.
paras.zh: 洋基老爹将登上舞台，成为拉丁唱片学院 2026 年度人物，一天前，他在一场传统的晚宴音乐会上受到了同龄人的庆祝。令人垂涎的拉丁格莱美最佳新人奖将由 Delilah、Fabian、Loulu Gilberto、Arath Herce、Macario Martínez、Maye、Sofia Monroy、Kendall Peña、Dora Sanches、Aria Vega 和 Zeca Veloso 角逐。

paras.en: The 27th Annual Latin Grammy Awards will be broadcast live from Las Vegas starting at 8 p.m. ET on TelevisaUnivision platforms. The Premiere began at 3 p.m. ET on the official digital platforms of the Latin Recording Academy, including its Latin Grammys channels on YouTube, Facebook and X.
paras.zh: 第 27 届拉丁格莱美颁奖典礼将于晚上 8 点在拉斯维加斯现场直播。 ET 在 TelevisaUnivision 平台上。首映式于下午3点开始。 ET 在拉丁唱片学院的官方数字平台上发布，包括 YouTube、Facebook 和 X 上的拉丁格莱美频道。

articles.title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
articles.author: Colin Stutz

paras.en: As part of our continuing efforts to serve the music industry and its creators, Billboard Pro now features a music industry events calendar for readers.
paras.zh: 作为我们为音乐行业及其创作者提供服务的持续努力的一部分，Billboard Pro 现在为读者提供了音乐行业活动日历。

paras.en: The calendar will act as music’s most complete summary major national and international industry events, from conferences to festivals to networking mixers and more. Just as Billboard is music’s must-read source for news, charts and analysis, now it also is the go-to for business happenings.
paras.zh: 该日历将作为音乐最完整的主要国内和国际行业活动的总结，从会议到节日到社交混音器等等。正如 Billboard 是音乐界必读的新闻、图表和分析来源一样，现在它也是商业活动的首选。

articles.title: Duran Duran’s Roger Taylor Retires From Group After Tinnitus Diagnosis: “I Must Now Listen to My Body and My Doctors”
articles.author: Ethan Millman

paras.en: Duran Duran drummer Roger Taylor is retiring from the band, and from drumming, the group announced on Thursday, after Taylor was recently diagnosed with tinnitus.
paras.zh: 杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 鼓手罗杰·泰勒 (Roger Taylor) 在泰勒最近被诊断出患有耳鸣后，周四宣布，该乐队将从乐队和鼓手中退休。

paras.en: “This is one of the hardest decisions I’ve ever had to make,” Taylor said in a statement shared on Duran Duran’s social media on Thursday. “Playing drums in this band has been the joy of my life, and I’ll never be able to properly thank the fans for the love they’ve shown us over the years. But the truth is that my tinnitus has been getting steadily worse, and I’ve reached the point where I must now listen to my body and my doctors.
paras.zh: “这是我做过的最艰难的决定之一，”泰勒周四在杜兰·杜兰的社交媒体上分享的一份声明中说道。 “在这个乐队中打鼓是我一生的乐趣，我永远无法正确感谢歌迷们多年来对我们的爱。但事实是，我的耳鸣越来越严重，我现在必须听从我的身体和医生的意见。

paras.en: ‘I couldn’t have asked for a better final chapter, with so many special moments that I’ll treasure forever,” he continued. “I move on with enormous pride, and with nothing but love for Simon, Nick and John.”
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“我无法要求一个更好的最后一章，其中有这么多我将永远珍惜的特殊时刻。”“我带着巨大的自豪感继续前进，除了对西蒙、尼克和约翰的爱之外，什么也没有。”

paras.en: Taylor first joined Duran Duran during the group’s early days in 1978, appearing on the band’s first three albums before leaving the group in 1985. He officially rejoined in 2001 and was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame with the group in 2022. “I couldn’t have asked for a better final chapter, with so many special moments that I’ll treasure forever,” Taylor said. “I move on with enormous pride, and with nothing but love for Simon, Nick and John.”
paras.zh: 泰勒于 1978 年在杜兰·杜兰乐队成立初期首次加入，并出现在乐队的前三张专辑中，然后于 1985 年离开乐队。他于 2001 年正式重新加入，并于 2022 年随乐队一起入选摇滚名人堂。“我无法要求更好的最后一章，有这么多我将永远珍惜的特殊时刻，”泰勒说。 “我带着极大的自豪继续前进，除了对西蒙、尼克和约翰的爱之外，什么也没有。”

paras.en: As Duran Duran members Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes and John Taylor said in a statement: “Roger is our brother. His drumming helped define the sound of Duran Duran from the very beginning and having him back with us since 2001 has been incredibly important to us all. We completely support his decision and wish him health and happiness. He will always be part of this family, while we continue exploring new and exciting projects with the band.”
paras.zh: 正如 Duran Duran 成员 Simon Le Bon、Nick Rhodes 和 John Taylor 在一份声明中所说：“Roger 是我们的兄弟。他的鼓声从一开始就帮助定义了 Duran Duran 的声音，自 2001 年以来他回到我们身边对我们所有人都非常重要。我们完全支持他的决定，并祝他健康快乐。他将永远是这个家庭的一部分，而我们将继续与乐队一起探索新的、令人兴奋的项目。”

articles.title: ‘Love Trapped’ Podcast Coming to TV as Peacock Docuseries
articles.author: Jackie Strause

paras.en: Love Trapped is getting the TV treatment as a docuseries at Peacock.
paras.zh: 《爱情被困》正在《Peacock》电视连续剧中播出。

paras.en: The hit podcast from Glass Podcasts and iHeartPodcasts quickly became a sensation after first releasing in February. Love Trapped was initially a 10-episode weekly release; however the series expanded to 18 episodes, along with several mini “bonus” episodes, to track what has become a bizarre three-year ordeal chronicling the criminal case against Laura Owens, the Arizona woman who attempted to entrap former The Bachelor star Clayton Echard with paternity fraud.
paras.zh: Glass Podcasts 和 iHeartPodcasts 的热门播客自二月份首次发布后迅速引起轰动。 《Love Trapped》最初是每周播出 10 集；后来又推出了《Love Trapped》。然而，该剧增至 18 集，并附有几集迷你“奖励”剧集，以追踪长达三年的离奇磨难，记录了亚利桑那州妇女劳拉·欧文斯 (Laura Owens) 的刑事案件，她试图以亲子欺诈的方式诱骗前《单身汉》明星克莱顿·埃查德 (Clayton Echard)。

paras.en: The final episode released on Thursday timed to the announcement, with a bonus episode to the 18th episode, “The Bitter End,” teasing the doc.
paras.zh: 周四发布的最后一集与该消息同步发布，第 18 集的额外一集“苦涩的结局”戏弄了医生。

paras.en: After Love Trapped became a top Apple podcast of the year, The Hollywood Reporter reported in a feature that the audio story had become a hot Hollywood property, and that Glass Podcasts, which has had a string of recent podcast-to-TV adaptations, had been in talks about bringing Love Trapped to television.
paras.zh: 《Love Trapped》成为苹果年度最佳播客后，《好莱坞报道》在一篇专题报道中报道称，该音频故事已成为好莱坞的热门产业，而最近将播客改编成电视节目的 Glass Podcasts 一直在讨论将《Love Trapped》搬上电视。

paras.en: Now the news is official: Peacock will adapt the story into a four-part docuseries titled Love Trapped: The Case of Laura Owens (wt).
paras.zh: 现在官方消息是：皮科克将把这个故事改编成一部四集纪录片，名为《爱情受困：劳拉·欧文斯案》(wt)。

paras.en: Based on the podcast hosted by Stephani Young, the documentary will chronicle “the extraordinary story of former Bachelor star Clayton Echard and his tumultuous relationship with a woman named Laura Owens, which began with a brief encounter and, following her pregnancy claim, spiraled into a years-long legal battle that captivated social media and sparked widespread public fascination.”
paras.zh: 这部纪录片根据 Stephani Young 主持的播客改编，将记录“前学士明星克莱顿·埃查德 (Clayton Echard) 的非凡故事，以及他与一位名叫劳拉·欧文斯 (Laura Owens) 的女人的混乱关系。这段关系从一次短暂的邂逅开始，在她声称怀孕后，演变成一场长达数年的法律斗争，吸引了社交媒体并引发了公众的广泛关注。”

paras.en: Through exclusive interviews — including with Owens herself, speaking for the first time (she did not participate in the podcast) — the documentary brings together Echard, his legal team, Owens’ mother Jan Black, other men who were targeted by Owens, Young and the online detectives who helped unravel the story that shockingly extends far beyond one relationship.
paras.zh: 通过独家采访——包括对欧文斯本人的首次采访（她没有参加播客）——这部纪录片汇集了埃查德、他的法律团队、欧文斯的母亲简·布莱克、其他被欧文斯瞄准的男人、杨以及帮助揭开这个远远超出一段关系的故事的在线侦探。

paras.en: The doc is executive produced by Glass Podcasts founder and CEO Nancy Glass, Emmy-winning documentarian Erin Lee Carr, and Keayr Braxton for Glass Entertainment Group, along with Danny Passman for Crybaby Media. Braxton is director.
paras.zh: 该纪录片由 Glass Podcasts 创始人兼首席执行官 Nancy Glass、艾美奖获奖纪录片制作人 Erin Lee Carr、Glass Entertainment Group 的 Keayr Braxton 以及 Crybaby Media 的 Danny Passman 担任监制。布拉克斯顿是导演。

paras.en: The description continues: “Love Trapped: The Case of Laura Owens (wt) follows an astonishing story when Laura meets Clayton through a potential real estate deal and after their short connection, she tells him she’s pregnant with his twins. Their private dispute erupts into a nationally followed story fueled by citizen sleuths and social commentators that join the media firestorm that implodes into a shocking trail of deception, legal threats and public humiliation. The deeper the investigation goes, the more unbelievable the revelations become, while raising a disturbing question: when does the desire to be loved turn into an obsession?”
paras.zh: 描述继续说道：“爱情被困：劳拉·欧文斯案（wt）讲述了一个令人震惊的故事，劳拉通过潜在的房地产交易认识了克莱顿，在短暂的交往后，她告诉他，她怀上了他的双胞胎。他们的私人纠纷爆发为全国关注的故事，公民侦探和社会评论员加入媒体风暴，引发了一系列令人震惊的欺骗、法律威胁和公开羞辱。调查越深入，这些揭露变得更加令人难以置信，同时提出了一个令人不安的问题：对被爱的渴望什么时候变成了痴迷？”

paras.en: On Oct. 23, Owens, who pleaded guilty in August to four felony counts for falsely claiming she was pregnant with Echard’s twins, was sentenced to one month in jail and seven years of supervised probation. If she violates the terms of her probation, Owens could be sent to prison for more than 15 years.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日，欧文斯因谎称怀上了埃查德的双胞胎而于 8 月承认四项重罪，被判处一个月监禁和七年监督缓刑。如果她违反缓刑条款，欧文斯可能会被判处 15 年以上监禁。

paras.en: In the Nov. 12 final episode of Love Trapped, Echard reflected on being disappointing in Owens’ sentencing, telling Young, “Does there always have to be a happy ending? Or maybe this is just one of these circumstances where there isn’t one, and that’s just life. This is where I think if you want a happy ending it’s, what do you do with that disappointment? I can let go of the pain and the anger and anything that doesn’t serve me because I ultimately won. And I did. I beat Laura head to head.”
paras.zh: 在《爱情陷阱》11 月 12 日的最后一集中，埃查德反思了对欧文斯判决的失望，他告诉杨，“总是有一个幸福的结局吗？或者也许这只是其中一种没有幸福结局的情况，而这就是生活。我想，如果你想要一个幸福的结局，你会如何处理这种失望？我可以放弃痛苦、愤怒和任何对我没有帮助的事情，因为我最终赢了。并且我确实打败了劳拉。”

paras.en: Young concluded the podcast by saying that she “realized now that my questions are useless” and threw away the questions she had for Owens, who never participated on the podcast. “Even if I could ask them, I don’t think she’d be honest,” she said. “Laura will always be living in her own reality, but at least at the time I’m recording this, the truth is, that Clayton Echard finally gets to move on with his life. And Laura Owens woke up this morning in jail as a convicted felon.”
paras.zh: 杨在播客结束时表示，她“现在意识到我的问题毫无用处”，并抛弃了她向从未参加过播客的欧文斯提出的问题。 “即使我可以问他们，我认为她也不会诚实，”她说。 “劳拉将永远生活在她自己的现实中，但至少在我录制这段视频的时候，事实是，克莱顿·埃查德终于开始了他的生活。劳拉·欧文斯今天早上在监狱里醒来，发现自己是一名被定罪的重罪犯。”

articles.title: Fanatics Studios’ Next Big Media Play Is the NBA All-Star Game
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: Fanatics Studios is set to play ball with the NBA and NBC.
paras.zh: Fanatics Studios 将与 NBA 和 NBC 合作。

paras.en: The studio, a joint venture between Fanatics (founded by Michael Rubin) and OBB (founded by Michael D. Ratner), has been named creative and event production partner for the NBA All-Star Weekend. The multiyear deal tips off in 2027 in Phoenix, Arizona, with Fanatics Studios developing in-arena events, competitions and original content connected to the weekend.
paras.zh: 该工作室是 Fanatics（由 Michael Rubin 创建）和 OBB（由 Michael D. Ratner 创建）的合资企业，已被指定为 NBA 全明星周末的创意和活动制作合作伙伴。这份多年期协议将于 2027 年在亚利桑那州凤凰城开始，Fanatics Studios 将开发与周末相关的场内活动、比赛和原创内容。

paras.en: The studio will work with the NBA and media rightsholder NBC Sports through the deal, working on production and developing new event programming.
paras.zh: 通过这笔交易，该工作室将与 NBA 和媒体版权持有者 NBC Sports 合作，进行制作和开发新的赛事节目。

paras.en: “NBA All-Star is one of those moments where sports and culture collide, and getting to work with the NBA, the players and NBC Sports on what comes next is incredibly exciting,” said Ratner. “There’s already so much about the weekend that fans love. Our job is to build on that, take some big swings and bring new ideas into the mix. This announcement is just the beginning, and we’re so excited for everything ahead.”
paras.zh: 拉特纳表示：“NBA 全明星赛是体育与文化碰撞的时刻之一，与 NBA、球员和 NBC Sports 合作开展接下来的活动是非常令人兴奋的。” “这个周末已经有很多球迷喜爱的事情了。我们的工作就是在此基础上，采取一些重大举措，并将新的想法融入其中。这一宣布只是一个开始，我们对未来的一切感到非常兴奋。”

paras.en: Fanatics Studios of course has already built some event bona fides thanks to Fanatics Fest, where the top NBA players (and NFL players, and MLB players, and celebrities) congregate each summer in New York. Now the company will bring some of that magic (and social content) to the NBA All-Star Game.
paras.zh: 当然，Fanatics Studios 已经通过 Fanatics Fest 举办了一些真诚的活动，顶级 NBA 球员（以及 NFL 球员、MLB 球员和名人）每年夏天都聚集在纽约。现在，该公司将把一些魔力（和社交内容）带入 NBA 全明星赛。
